kyoto_gion_yamaoka.gf_detail: Ask. Seasonal kappo with dashi and soy, sashimi and shabu-shabu; no gluten information is published (reviews).
kyoto_gion_yamaoka.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses of crab, fish and meat (reviews).
kyoto_gion_yamaoka.hours_raw: 19:00–24:00; closing days vary (Tabelog). Cards and e-money accepted (Tabelog). An 8-seat counter; non-smoking, with a smoking area (Tabelog). On Gion-machi Minamigawa south of Shijo (Tabelog). About ¥20,000–40,000 a head (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_yamaoka.notes: [Kappo · Gion south of Shijo, eight-seat counter] An intimate eight-seat counter where a smiling, bow-tied chef lets top ingredients speak with minimal seasoning — matsuba crab sashimi, nodoguro shabu-shabu, a hot pot with hana-sansho. About ¥20,000–40,000; from 7 pm.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers (2025–2026) describe a bow-tied chef with a ready smile, humble and charming, cooking live at the counter in a stylish, calm room.

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 guest singled out the small hot pot with hana-sansho.
A February 2026 cook of ten years praised its “seasoning by subtraction”.
A March 2026 diner had the last matsuba crab of the season as sashimi.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 祇園山岡、日本料理、京都市東山区祇園町南側570-246、19:00〜0:00、定休日不定、カード・電子マネー可、カウンター8席、禁煙 (喫煙所あり)、予算30,000〜40,000円ほど。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 蝶ネクタイの笑顔の大将、花山椒の小鍋、肉の火入れ、引き算の味付け、菜の花と山椒のいか、鯛と赤貝のお造り、松葉蟹の刺身、のどぐろのしゃぶしゃぶ、落ち着いたおしゃれな店内、1人20,000〜40,000円ほど。

cultural_comfort.note: Eight-seat counter; book ahead.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through March 2026.

kyoto_gion_sushi_faro.gf_detail: Ask. An April 2026 reviewer says the brothers accommodate gluten-free requests; mention it when booking, as soy sauce and seasonings are not otherwise described (review B525889708).
kyoto_gion_sushi_faro.hours_raw: 16:00–23:00 (last food order 21:00, drinks 22:00) Monday–Saturday, holidays, holiday eves and the day after a holiday (Tabelog); Sunday is not stated. Course only (April 2026). Cards (incl. UnionPay); no e-money (Tabelog). A 10-seat counter; non-smoking (Tabelog). Prime Building 2F, Gion-machi Kitagawa, a short walk from Gion-Shijo (Tabelog; May 2026). Opened 1 November 2025 (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_sushi_faro.notes: [Sushi · Gion north of Shijo, brothers’ omakase] A sleek ten-seat counter opened in November 2025 by two Tokyo-trained brothers who speak English and Spanish: a ¥15,000 omakase with uni and caviar, 8–10 nigiri, and a ¥4,500 sake pairing from a sake sommelier. Gluten-free requests accommodated, per a review — ask when booking.

chef_bio.background: Opened in November 2025 (Tabelog) by two brothers who trained at a well-known Tokyo sushi restaurant and speak English and Spanish; one is a sake sommelier (April and May 2026 reviews).

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 solo diner took the ¥15,000 course with the ¥4,500 sake pairing and noted the gluten-free accommodation.
A May 2026 guest began with an uni “cocktail” of top-grade sea urchin.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 祇園鮨FARO、寿司・天ぷら・すき焼き、京都市東山区祇園町北側347-153 プライムビル2F、月〜土・祝日・祝前日・祝日の翌日 16:00〜23:00 (料理L.O.21:00、ドリンクL.O.22:00)、カード (銀聯も)、電子マネー不可、カウンター10席、禁煙、2025年11月1日オープン。口コミ (2026年、英語): 東京の名店で修業した兄弟、英語とスペイン語が堪能、コースのみ、雲丹とキャビアの特選おまかせ15,000円 (前菜、刺身、雲丹のカクテルなど季節の一品、握り8〜10貫、お椀、雲丹は蟹に替えられる)、日本酒ペアリング4,500円、利き酒師、京都の日本酒とワイン、グルテンフリーにも対応。

cultural_comfort.note: The chefs speak English and Spanish (2026 reviews).

existence.note: Tabelog listing (opened 1 November 2025); reviews dated April and May 2026.

kyoto_manina.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Risottos are rice-based, but the menu also has lasagna, sandwiches, chiffon and lemon cakes and granola (2023–2025 reviews).
kyoto_manina.vegan_detail: Ask. An April 2024 reviewer had an avocado sandwich labelled vegan; most other dishes use cheese, cream, eggs, sausage or meat sauce.
kyoto_manina.hours_raw: Tabelog: Wed–Sun 11:00–19:00 (food L.O. 17:00); closed Monday and Tuesday. No reservations. Mainly a grocery shop selling ingredients, sauces, frozen risottos and sweets from the Italian restaurant cenci, with eat-in at one table for about 6–7 (2023–2024 reviews). Cards and e-money. Also an online shop. On Nijo-dori east of Kawabata, about 8 min from Keihan Sanjo or Jingu-Marutamachi.
kyoto_manina.notes: [Grocery café · Kawabata-Nijo, cenci's shop and table] The bright grocery shop of the acclaimed Italian restaurant cenci: browse its pantry goods, then sit at the one big table for a generous risotto, lasagna or cacao chiffon with coffee or natural wine. An avocado sandwich has been labelled vegan. About ¥1,500–3,000. Closed Mon and Tue.

chef_bio.background: A shop run by the Italian restaurant cenci (kyoto_cenci_shogoin in this guide), selling the ingredients, sauces and sweets used there; a December 2025 reviewer calls it cenci's second shop. A November 2023 visitor from Tokyo was served by the wife of cenci's chef Sakamoto, who opened on a closed day for her. A December 2022 reviewer credits the cacao chiffon to cenci's pâtissier Nakatsuka.
chef_bio.specialty: cenci's risottos, sauces and cacao sweets.

anecdotes.text: August 2023: "While the restaurant's course meal includes smaller portions of risotto, I believe the dine-in servings at manina are about 2 to 3 times larger—definitely enough for a full meal."
April 2024: "I tried the avocado sandwich labeled as vegan… Despite its simple seasoning, it was delicious."
June 2025: "It's not really a place for lingering."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: manina、その他、左京区難波町211-5、京阪三条・市役所前・神宮丸太町から徒歩8分、水〜日11:00〜19:00 (料理L.O.17:00)、月・火休み、予約不可、7席、カード・電子マネー可。口コミ (2022年12月〜2025年12月、英語): イタリア料理店cenciの食材店で、店内で食事もできる (大きなテーブル1卓)、れんこんのボロネーゼのリゾットとスープ、ソーセージのリゾット、ラザニア、ホットサンド、ヴィーガン表示のアボカドのサンド (2024年4月)、アマゾンカカオのシフォンケーキ900円、レモンケーキ、イートンメス、カカオ餅のモンブラン1,200円、丹波栗のモンブラン、自然派ワイン、cenciのシェフSakamoto氏の妻が接客 (2023年11月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Mostly a shop; one shared table; staff explain the products.

positives: An April 2024 reviewer had an avocado sandwich labelled vegan.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated 2025 to March 2026.

kyoto_aozora_hanten.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles (nira soba, chuka soba, tantanmen), gyoza, spring rolls, fried bread and soy-based sauces (2026 reviews).
kyoto_aozora_hanten.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken-and-pork broths, chashu, gyoza, shrimp and pork dishes; even the fried eggplant comes from a meat-heavy kitchen (2026 reviews).
kyoto_aozora_hanten.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Sat and public holidays 15:00–24:00 (L.O. food 23:00, drinks 24:00); closed Sunday; hours may change. October 2026 reviewers came at lunch for a newly added lunch set (ramen and a mini chashu bowl), so check Instagram for lunch days. Charge: 「無し、ただしワンドリンク必須（＝フードのみの利用不可）」 (no charge, but one drink per person is required — food-only orders are not allowed; Tabelog Japanese original). Prices shown before tax (April 2026). Counter and tables; smaller "just-size" portions of many dishes (November 2026). Cards: JCB (Tabelog); QR codes. Tabelog says no reservations, though a May 2026 reviewer booked ahead and found it full. In a renovated old house in the old Gojo-Rakuen quarter, near the Ume-yu bathhouse; 7 min from Kiyomizu-Gojo.
kyoto_aozora_hanten.notes: [Neighbourhood Chinese · Gojo-Rakuen, a late-night machi-chuka] A buzzy, nostalgic-style Chinese diner in an old house near the Ume-yu bathhouse, open to midnight: heaps-of-chives nira soba, gyoza with house chili oil, tomato-egg stir-fry and chili-shrimp fried rice, many in small portions. One drink each required. About ¥2,000–3,500. Some dishes run salty. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 17 March 2026 (March 2026 review). A May 2026 reviewer writes that the owner of the popular Gojo café "Kissa Jani" opened it in a renovated old house, recreating an old-style neighbourhood Chinese diner, and that older regulars from the nearby bathhouse drop in for gyoza and beer. A November 2026 diner counted a staff of four.
chef_bio.specialty: Nira soba; gyoza; late-night Chinese plates.

anecdotes.text: May 2026: "Kissa Jani's owner has taken the next step by opening a local Chinese restaurant that stays open late into the night."
November 2026: "We topped the fried rice with the leftover chili shrimp sauce—This was mind-blowingly delicious!"
September 2026: "The Sweet and Sour Pork and Mapo Tofu were too salty, overshadowing the natural flavors of the ingredients… In contrast, the Tenshinhan had a perfect balance."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: あおぞら飯店、ラーメン・中華料理、下京区菊屋町317、清水五条から徒歩7分、月〜土・祝日15:00〜24:00 (L.O.料理23:00・飲み物24:00)、日曜休み、予約不可の表示、チャージ「無し、ただしワンドリンク必須（＝フードのみの利用不可）」、カウンターあり、カード (JCB)・QR可。口コミ (2026年3〜11月、英語): 2026年3月17日開店、Kissa Janiの店主の町中華、古い家を改装、梅湯の近く、にらそば950円、特製中華そば1,000円、餃子と自家製ラー油、春巻き、なすの素揚げ、トマトと卵の炒め物、かにとレタスのチャーハン、エビチリ、オムライス、担々麺、税抜き表示、ハーフサイズあり、10月には昼のセットも、塩辛い料理があるとの声 (2026年5月・9月)、カツカレーは物足りない (2026年4月)。

cultural_comfort.note: One drink per person required; small portions available; open late.

existence.note: Tabelog listing (opened March 2026) with reviews dated March to November 2026.

kyoto_teuchi_soba_inoue.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the soba is ni-hachi — 80% buckwheat, 20% wheat flour (December 2024, December 2025) — plus tempura bowls and soy-based dipping sauce.
kyoto_teuchi_soba_inoue.vegan_detail: Not vegan: soba in broth or with dipping sauce, chicken nanban soba, duck soba, oyakodon and charcoal yakitori (2022–2026 reviews); no vegan information.
kyoto_teuchi_soba_inoue.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Sat 17:30–22:00 (L.O. 21:30), open on public holidays; closed Sunday, the 3rd Monday and the 5th Saturday of the month; closes early when the soba sells out; occasional temporary closures. 2022 reviewers ate weekday lunch here, but current Tabelog hours are evenings only. Reservations taken. 24 seats; non-smoking. Cards, e-money and PayPay. A soba izakaya: soba plus charcoal yakitori and small dishes at night. Orders can take 30+ minutes (March 2026). Down a lantern-lit alley off Matsubara-dori east of Shinmachi; about 10 min walk from Gojo or Shijo stations.
kyoto_teuchi_soba_inoue.notes: [Soba izakaya · Matsubara-Shinmachi, handmade soba and yakitori] A lantern-lit alley doorway leads to a roomy, regular-filled soba house: start with a drink and charcoal yakitori, then finish with crisp ni-hachi zaru soba (¥1,080) or duck soba. About ¥3,000–5,000 at night. Evenings only; closed Sundays. Can be slow when busy.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a shop full of regulars and kind staff — one lent a guest an umbrella in the rain (May 2022) — with soba made on site in a visible soba-making room (December 2025). One March 2026 diner waited over 30 minutes for food; others find it a little pricey but worth it.

anecdotes.text: December 2025: "The well-prepared ni-hachi soba (80% buckwheat, 20% wheat flour) is delightful… The dipping sauce leans towards Edo-style, but rather than being sharp, it emphasizes a lingering umami flavor."
May 2022: "On my way back, it started to rain, and the kindness of the staff who offered me an umbrella was heartwarming."
March 2026: "The downside was that I had to wait over 30 minutes from ordering to receiving my food."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 手打ち蕎麦 井上、そば・居酒屋・日本料理、下京区松原通新町東入中野之町168-2、四条・五条駅から徒歩15分 (五条から440m)、月〜土17:30〜22:00 (L.O.21:30)、祝日は通常営業、日曜・第3月曜・第5土曜休み、そばがなくなり次第終了、臨時休業あり、予約可、24席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・PayPay可。口コミ (2022年5月〜2026年3月、英語): 二八そば、ざるそば1,080円、おろしそば1,100円、鴨ねぎのつけそば、天ぷら丼、鶏南蛮そば、刻み揚げと九条ねぎのそば、ミニ親子丼、そばがき、炭火焼き鳥 (もも・ハツ・砂肝・つくね・せせり)、そば焼酎、常連客が多い、2022年は昼も営業、提供まで30分以上 (2026年3月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Regulars' soba izakaya; evenings only.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated December 2025 to March 2026.

kyoto_teppan_dining_lajitto.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: teppan courses end with French toast, and include soups, a seafood foil bake and Japanese-style ankake (2024–2026 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_teppan_dining_lajitto.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Miyazaki beef and jidori chicken teppanyaki courses with sea bream, seafood and roast beef (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_teppan_dining_lajitto.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun 11:30–15:00 (L.O. food 14:00) and 17:30–22:00 (L.O. food 21:00); closed Wednesday. Reservations taken; message plates for celebrations free on request (March 2026). Lunch courses about ¥3,500–4,000+; dinner courses around ¥10,000. 24 seats: counter on the 1st floor, tables on the 2nd, private rooms for 2–8. Children's plate available (November 2024). Non-smoking; wheelchair accessible. Cards and QR codes. In a converted house by Yanagibanba-Nijo, 6 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae.
kyoto_teppan_dining_lajitto.notes: [Teppanyaki · Yanagibanba-Nijo, Miyazaki beef in a townhouse] A calm house-turned-teppan bar where the chef grills Miyazaki beef and seasonal fish at the counter, finishing with temari sushi or garlic rice and a famous French toast. Lunch courses from ¥3,500, dinner about ¥10,000. Free message plates for celebrations. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a hidden teppan restaurant in a private house, with a 1st-floor counter and 2nd-floor tables (November 2024), chefs who explain each dish (February 2025) and regulars who return every year for birthdays. One April 2025 diner found the temari sushi bland and hoped the service would match the food.

anecdotes.text: January 2025: "The sea bream carpaccio wasn't just a thin slice; it was thick and satisfying sashimi… And the meat was truly outstanding!"
March 2026: "I had requested a message on a dessert plate in advance, and it was beautifully presented… (And it was a complimentary service!)"
April 2025: "The temari sushi was adorable and a delight to the eyes, but it was flavorless."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: Teppan Dining L’ajitto、ステーキ・鉄板焼き・日本料理、中京区柳馬場二条西入ル等持寺町1-7、京都市役所前から徒歩6分、月・火・木〜日11:30〜15:00 (料理L.O.14:00)・17:30〜22:00 (料理L.O.21:00)、水曜休み、予約可、24席、個室 (2〜8名)、禁煙、車いす可、カード・QR可、適格請求書の登録番号T2130001044337 (国税庁の公表サイトでは株式会社アイセラ、京都市下京区)。口コミ (2024年11月〜2026年8月、英語): 民家の鉄板焼き、1階カウンター・2階テーブル、宮崎牛、昼のコース3,500円から、手まり寿司、ガーリックライス、フレンチトースト、10,000円のコースに鯛のカルパッチョ・海鮮のホイル焼き・地鶏、デザートのプレートにメッセージ (無料)、持ち帰りのハンバーグサンド、手まり寿司は味が薄いとの声 (2025年4月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Chef cooks in front of you and explains each dish; celebration plates on request.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated 2025 to August 2026.

kyoto_cafe_sunaba.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a bread breakfast — salt bread, chocolate and raisin breads (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_cafe_sunaba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: breads served with butter and jam (February 2025); no vegan item sourced.
kyoto_cafe_sunaba.hours_raw: Breakfast daily except Wednesday 7:00–11:00; Friday also 18:00–23:00; closed Wednesday; may change (Tabelog). Cards and e-money (Tabelog). Up narrow stairs to a bright second-floor room in what looks like an ordinary house; easy to miss without the sign (December 2024, February 2025). English-speaking staff (February and May 2026). Near Sanjo Keihan (Tabelog).
kyoto_cafe_sunaba.notes: [Breakfast café · near Sanjo Keihan] The upstairs breakfast room of the bakery Le bac a sable (listed separately): from 7:00, a ¥600 set of two breads — salt, chocolate or raisin — with butter, jam and coffee or cocoa, in a bright wooden room with English-speaking staff. Mornings only, plus Friday evenings; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews: a café opened 21 November 2024 as the sister shop of the Higashiyama bakery Le bac a sable (December 2024, February and September 2025).

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 early riser climbed the narrow stairs for the ¥600 set — salt bread with chocolate bread and salt bread with raisin bread, coffee, jam and butter.
A September 2025 visitor took the owner’s advice of salt bread, then agonised between chocolate chip and raisin before choosing raisin.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ、左京区菊鉾町297-6、月火木土日7:00〜11:00、金7:00〜11:00・18:00〜23:00、水曜休み、カード・電子マネー可、2024年11月21日オープン。口コミ (2024年12月〜2026年5月、英語): 東山のパン屋 Le bac a sable (ルバカサブル) の姉妹店、フランス人のオーナー、狭い階段で2階へ、普通の家のような外観、パン3種から2つとドリンクの朝食セット600円 (塩パン、チョコ、レーズン、バターとジャム)、ココア、英語を話すスタッフ。

cultural_comfort.note: English-speaking staff (February and May 2026). Look for the sign — the café is upstairs in a house.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through May 2026.

kyoto_cafe_sunaba.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260302/26042614/ (35.011531, 135.775129); cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市左京区菊鉾町297番地 (lot) 60m; 2026-11-08

kyoto_cafe_karin_chionin.gf_detail: Ask. The spice curry comes with vegetables and multigrain rice (March 2025, February 2026), but the curry base is not described; cakes are wheat (October 2026). No allergen information.
kyoto_cafe_karin_chionin.vegan_detail: Some vegan options: a vegan spice curry with a plate of vegetable sides (March and April 2025). Whether the 2026 spice curry is the same vegan recipe is not stated — ask. Soft serve and cakes are not vegan.
kyoto_cafe_karin_chionin.hours_raw: Daily 8:30–19:30; may change (Tabelog). Self-service: order at the counter (February 2026). Eat in or take away (2021 review). 32 seats (Tabelog). On the ground floor of 和順会館, Chion-in’s lodging, beside its souvenir shop, facing the Sanmon gate; the temple itself closes at 17:00 (February 2026); café described on the shop site.
kyoto_cafe_karin_chionin.notes: [Café · Chion-in] A self-service café in Chion-in’s Wajun Kaikan facing the great Sanmon gate, open from 8:30 to 19:30: a vegan spice curry with vegetable sides, cake sets, soft serve, coffee and matcha beer — a handy stop before or after the temple.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop site and reviews: the café of 和順会館, the lodging of Chion-in, head temple of the Jodo sect, beside its souvenir shop (2024–26 reviews).

anecdotes.text: A March 2025 lunch visitor chose the vegan curry, topped with assorted vegetables and served with a plate of sides — light enough for a small appetite.
An April 2025 visitor, starving at 16:30 before a meeting, had the vegan spiced curry with a matcha beer.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ、東山区林下町400 知恩院 和順会館1F、毎日8:30〜19:30、32席。口コミ (2025年3月〜2026年10月、英語): 知恩院の三門の前、和順会館の土産物売り場の横、セルフサービス、ヴィーガンのスパイスカレーと野菜の副菜、雑穀米のスパイスカレー、ソフトクリーム、チョコレートケーキとチーズケーキのセットと抹茶ラテ、ブレンド500円、抹茶ビール、寺は17時に閉まる。

kyoto_the_bridge_cafe.gf_detail: Ask. Most food is wheat — muffins, hot sandwiches, toast, pizza, pasta — but a rice-flour carrot cake is served (December 2025, March 2026); whether it is wheat-free is not stated.
kyoto_the_bridge_cafe.vegan_detail: Not vegan: ham-and-cheese breakfast sets with egg and yogurt, pork curry, cheesecake (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_the_bridge_cafe.hours_raw: Tue–Sat 7:30–16:00 (food last order 14:30, drinks 15:30); Sunday 7:30–12:00 (food last order 9:30); closed Monday (Tabelog). Order and pay at the counter first (December 2025). Power outlets at many seats (December 2024, February 2026). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). A renovated machiya with a courtyard at Muromachi-Takatsuji, just west of Karasuma (October 2025, February 2026).
kyoto_the_bridge_cafe.notes: [Machiya café · Muromachi-Takatsuji] A spacious renovated machiya with a courtyard and power outlets, open from 7:30 for muffin, hot-sandwich and toast breakfast sets, then spice curry, pasta and pizza at lunch, and a warm rice-flour carrot cake. Run by a church. Closed Monday; Sundays to noon.

chef_bio.background: Per reviews: a café in a renovated Kyoto townhouse, run by the HPC church (December 2025); the curry comes from another curry shop (June 2025).

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 couple, searching for the nearest early breakfast, found it opened at 7:30 and had ham-and-cheese hot sandwich and muffin sets with salad, half an egg and yogurt.
A March 2026 visitor praised the ¥650 carrot cake, served slightly warmed so the inside stayed fluffy.

kyoto_common_bal_gojo.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: fried chicken (yurinchi, chicken nanban, tulip chicken), gyoza, spring rolls, curry and craft beer (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_common_bal_gojo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a meat-focused menu — fried chicken, sausages, gyoza; set meals with miso soup (2025–26 reviews).

Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 27 seats at tables, partitioned four-seat tables by the door (Tabelog; August 2025). Busy at the lunch peak (June 2026). Ground floor of a building with a co-working space upstairs, about five minutes from Gojo Station (August 2025, June 2026).
kyoto_common_bal_gojo.notes: [Meat & craft beer · Gojo-Karasuma] A casual meat-and-craft-beer bar near Gojo-Karasuma: weekday set-meal lunches — yurinchi, chicken nanban, curry, daily special — with rice, miso soup and salad, then gyoza, spring rolls, sausages and tulip chicken with beer in the evening. Formerly Common Dining; the long-time chef left in May 2026.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop site and reviews: run by 共栄商事株式会社; formerly コモンダイニング (Common Dining), whose long-time chef left in May 2026 (May 2026 review); renamed common bal.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the shop site: 「「いつもの」がある場所」 — a place for your usual.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 regular, usually on the daily special, recommends the chicken nanban or special curry sets, each with rice, miso soup, a side and salad.
An October 2026 evening diner singled out the shrimp spring rolls and tulip chicken dressed with bonito flakes.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 運営は共栄商事株式会社、「いつもの」がある場所、こだわりの肉料理とシェフ自慢の創作料理、平日11:00〜14:00・17:00〜22:00、土日・祝日15:00〜22:00。食べログ: バル・肉バル・居酒屋、下京区玉津島町294 1F、L.O.は昼13:30・夜21:00、休みは不定、サービス料＋チャージ料なし、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、27席、旧店名コモンダイニング。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年10月、英語): 油淋鶏、チキン南蛮、特製カレー、日替わり、ご飯・味噌汁・小鉢・サラダ付き、2026年5月に長年のシェフが退く、2階はコワーキングスペース、五条駅から徒歩約5分、夜は海老の春巻き、餃子、ソーセージ、かつお節のチューリップ。

cultural_comfort.note: Come just before or after the noon peak for lunch. No English evidence found.

kyoto_hiiragi_nijo.gf_detail: Not GF for most dishes: cream croquettes, beef cutlet, omurice with demi-glace and fried ayu involve wheat (2025–2026 reviews). Carpaccio and grilled pork may suit — ask.
kyoto_hiiragi_nijo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: meat, seafood and egg dishes (2025–2026 reviews).

SD Building 2F, up a narrow spiral staircase; 8 min walk from Karasuma-Oike Stn (Tabelog; November 2025). Opened 17 February 2025 (Tabelog).
kyoto_hiiragi_nijo.notes: [Yoshoku and wine · Nijo-Yanaginobamba] Up a spiral stair to a bright, airy room where a solo chef turns out creative yoshoku — crab cream croquettes, Sasuke pork, beef cutlet, a fluffy demi-glace omurice at lunch — with organic wine. Solo-friendly counter. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: a Western-style restaurant opened 17 February 2025 on the second floor of the SD Building, where the chef — named Inoue by a September 2026 regular — runs the kitchen alone (November 2025), cooking seasonal ingredients with care.
chef_bio.philosophy: Creative Western dishes of seasonal ingredients, carefully prepared (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 regular, back for a girls’ night, was won over again by Chef Inoue’s generous appetiser platter and Seiko crab cream croquettes.
A November 2025 lunch guest read a book while the solo chef prepared a beef-tendon demi-glace omurice.
A February 2026 solo traveller chose it over a wine bar the night before a sushi booking.

kyoto_watanabeya_oshikoji.gf_detail: Ask. Plain-grilled offal may suit, but sauces and the motsunabe broth likely use soy, and ramen is wheat (2018–2026 reviews). No gluten information.
kyoto_watanabeya_oshikoji.vegan_detail: Not vegan: yakiniku and beef-offal hot pot (2018–2026 reviews).
kyoto_watanabeya_oshikoji.hours_raw: Weekdays 18:00–24:00; Sunday and holidays 17:30–23:00; closed the 1st and 3rd Tuesday; hours may change (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog). 12 seats per Tabelog (a May 2025 reviewer counted three tables of four and two of two); smoky, Showa-era room (Tabelog; November 2018). On a corner with a red lantern, 3 min walk from Karasuma-Oike Stn (May 2025).
kyoto_watanabeya_oshikoji.notes: [Yakiniku and motsunabe · Oshikoji-Karasuma, cash only] A tiny, smoky Showa-style corner under a red lantern: grill some horumon, then move on to the house motsunabe, finishing with ramen and zosui in the broth. Fills up fast. Cash only.

chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: a long-running, compact yakiniku shop on an Oshikoji corner near Karasuma-Oike, with a nostalgic Showa feel and a motsunabe many prefer to the grill (2017–2026 reviews).

anecdotes.text: An April 2018 first customer of the night started the tecchan-nabe for two and snacked on raw senmai while it heated.
A May 2025 diner who counted 16 seats said it really does fill up, and preferred the motsunabe to the grilled meat.
An August 2026 first-timer ended the motsunabe with both ramen and zosui.

kyoto_shoraku_nishinotoin.notes: [Udon · Nishinotoin-Bukkoji, lunch only] A small couple-run udon shop with a gentle Kyoto dashi and chewy handmade noodles — niku udon with kayaku rice, nabeyaki, curry udon — and warm, attentive service. Expect a queue. Closed Tuesday and Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: a long-loved lunchtime udon shop run by a couple, praised for warm hospitality and good ingredients, now drawing queues of visitors from abroad (March–August 2026).

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 retiree travelled back after three years for the niku udon and kayaku rice, calling it the best in Kansai.
A March 2026 last-meal-in-Kyoto waited nearly 30 minutes in a queue of overseas visitors and wondered why.
A May 2026 regular found the old kara-age and ginger-pork sets gone, and had a mini oyakodon set instead.

kyoto_tsukitokage_shinmachi.notes: [Tempura and oden · Sanjo-Shinmachi] A friendly, good-value izakaya where tempura is fried by the piece at the counter — shrimp, lotus root, chestnut — alongside oden, homemade satsuma-age and a signature fried tofu, with plenty of sake. Smoking allowed. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site and reviewers: the tempura izakaya of ツキトカゲ, a two-shop name whose main shop serves charcoal yakitori near Tomikoji-Nijo (tsukitokage.com); a friendly owner and a counter where guests watch tempura being fried (October 2025; September 2026).

anecdotes.text: A December 2024 diner who loves red-ginger tempura found it here, with eggplant, for just ¥30.
A January 2025 visitor chose it over a nearby oden shop on a cold Friday, drawn by the charming roadside sign.
A September 2026 regular brings family and friends to sit at the 1F counter and watch the tempura fried.

kyoto_shubo_nana_yatacho.notes: [Izakaya · back-alley red lantern, run single-handed] A small, old-school red-lantern izakaya down a quiet side alley, where the owner cooks and serves alone: obanzai, sashimi, salt-grilled wagyu, tamagoyaki and fried chicken, with easy conversation at the counter. kyoto_ippodo_honten_kaboku.gf_detail: Ask. Teas in the Kaboku tea room come with a Japanese sweet chosen from a box of about four kinds; no ingredient information for the sweets (2026 reviews).
kyoto_ippodo_honten_kaboku.vegan_detail: Ask. Matcha, gyokuro, sencha and hojicha are plant-only, but the accompanying wagashi are not described as vegan (2026 reviews).
kyoto_ippodo_honten_kaboku.hours_raw: Shop and Kaboku tea room 10:00–17:00 (tea room last orders 16:30); closed the second Wednesday of each month and over New Year (own site; Tabelog). Cards and e-money; no QR (Tabelog). Non-smoking; parking (Tabelog). Takeaway drinks for strolling (own site). Tea-brewing classes upstairs (own site; Tabelog). Product prices revised in October and November 2026 (own site). On Teramachi-dori north of Nijo, about 6 min on foot from Kyoto-Shiyakusho-mae (own site; August 2026).
kyoto_ippodo_honten_kaboku.notes: [Tea room · Teramachi-Nijo, tea merchant since 1717] The historic main shop of Ippodo, in business since 1717, with its Kaboku tea room beside the sales floor: matcha, gyokuro or hojicha brewed for you and served with a seasonal sweet, plus takeaway drinks and tea leaves to buy. Busy with visitors; staff explain the teas. Closed second Wednesdays. Flagged: one family company with other shops and department-store counters.

chef_bio.background: Founded in 1717 as the tea and pottery shop 近江屋 by 渡辺利兵衛 (reading not sourced) from 近江; given the name 一保堂 by 山階宮 (reading not sourced) in 1846; moved to the present Teramachi-Nijo site after the shop burned in 1864; turned from tea exporter to retailer in the Taisho era; the Kaboku tea room opened in 1995 with four tables. The site says successive heads of the house have carried the shop on (own site).
chef_bio.philosophy: The name means “to keep to tea alone” (own site).

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 visitor buying for a tea-loving friend in America was walked through gyokuro and sencha by a staff member and left with several teas.
An October 2026 family tried koicha, gyokuro and hojicha in the tea room, each served with a sweet.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 一保堂茶舗 京都本店／喫茶室 嘉木、10:00〜17:00 (喫茶L.O. 16:30)、毎月第2水曜定休、年末年始は別営業、テイクアウトあり、喫茶室は奥の間・カウンター席・寺町の間、2階でお茶の教室、2026年10月・11月に価格改定。歩み: 享保2年 (1717) 近江出身の渡辺利兵衛が「近江屋」を創業、弘化3年 (1846) 山階宮より「一保堂」の屋号を賜る、元治元年 (1864) 蛤御門の変で焼失後に寺町通二条上ルの現在地へ、明治は輸出問屋、大正に小売へ、昭和27年 阪神百貨店へ出店、平成7年 (1995) 喫茶室 嘉木オープン、代々の当主が店を受け継ぐ。食べログ: 中京区二条上ル常盤木町52、カード・電子マネー可、QR不可、禁煙。口コミ (2026年、英語): 薄茶「Kyogoku no Mukashi」と和菓子1,760円、濃茶、玉露、ほうじ茶、冷たい抹茶、テイクアウトのほうじ茶と「Frozen Uji Shimizu」、本店限定の Special Sencha 90g 3,402円、「Masaike no O」80g 1,296円、くき茶1,188円、いり番茶。

cultural_comfort.note: Many overseas visitors; staff explain the teas.

existence.note: Own site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated June to October 2026.

kyoto_viva_takka_karasuma_oike.gf_detail: Ask. Pasta, lasagna, pizza, focaccia, fried gnocco and a salmon cutlet, alongside teppan-grilled meats and salads; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_viva_takka_karasuma_oike.vegan_detail: Ask. Organic vegetables from Ishii Farm and a build-your-own pasta with a choice of sauce and vegetables, but nothing is described as vegan (2026 reviews).
kyoto_viva_takka_karasuma_oike.hours_raw: Daily incl. public holidays: lunch 11:30–15:00 (last orders 14:30), dinner 17:00–23:00 (last orders 22:30) (Tabelog). Opened 22 July 2026 (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 24 seats incl. counter and sofa seats; standing parties up to 40 (Tabelog). Non-smoking, smoking area outside; wheelchair accessible (Tabelog). Near Karasuma-Oike station (August and September 2026).
kyoto_viva_takka_karasuma_oike.notes: [Italian bar · Karasuma-Oike, opened 2026] A casual Italian bar near Karasuma-Oike: pasta lunches from ¥1,400 with a choice of sauce, and in the evening teppan-grilled meat platters, creative small plates with organic vegetables and build-your-own pasta, with wine and cocktails. Open daily. Flagged: third shop of a small local group (京酒場 団らん, ネオ酒場 団らん); operator not found.

chef_bio.background: Opened on 22 July 2026 (Tabelog). A September 2026 reviewer calls it the third shop after the izakaya 京酒場 団らん in Saiin and ネオ酒場 団らん on Nishioji. No operator was found.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner was surprised to find venison alongside beef and pork on the three-meat platter, and enjoyed picking every element of a custom pasta.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: Viva takka、イタリアン、中京区室町通御池下る円福寺町342-1 VOISE21ビル 1F、毎日 11:30〜15:00 (L.O. 14:30)・17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:30)、2026年7月22日オープン、カード・電子マネー・QR (Alipay、WeChat Pay含む) 可、24席、立食40名、禁煙 (店外に喫煙所)、車椅子可。口コミ (2026年、英語): Ishii Farm の有機野菜と鉄板焼きの肉の創作イタリアンバル、パスタランチ1,400〜1,600円 (前菜、サラダ、パン、3種のソースから選ぶ)、前菜の盛り合わせ1,500円、生ハム1,100円とニョッコフリット500円、レアサーモンカツ1,300円、鹿肉入りの3種の肉の盛り合わせ、カスタムパスタ、ピザ、鯛と茄子のタルタル、イチジクとマスカルポーネ、京酒場 団らん (西院)・ネオ酒場 団らん (西大路) に続く3店舗目。

cultural_comfort.note: Casual; many payment options incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; opened July 2026; reviews dated July to November 2026.

kyoto_tokijiku.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; the food is two daily curries with rice and a hamburg curry (2024–2025 reviews), and curry roux often contains wheat.
kyoto_tokijiku.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the curries reviewed are minced-meat and tomato, chicken green curry and hamburg curry (2024–2025).
kyoto_tokijiku.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Wed–Fri 10:00–18:00; Sat 10:00–21:00; closed Tuesday, Sunday and public holidays; hours may change. A gallery café opened 1 June 2024 that also sells bags and interior goods with Yuzen patterns and hosts events and classes; the eating area is open to the gallery. Round tables. In the Loi Krathong Shijo building on Matsubara-dori west of Shinmachi, 490 m from Gojo.
kyoto_tokijiku.notes: [Gallery café · Matsubara-Shinmachi, curry among Yuzen goods] A quiet community café inside a gallery of Yuzen-patterned bags and goods: two home-style curries a day from ¥750 and coffee at ¥500. Under ¥1,500. Closed Tue, Sun and holidays.

chef_bio.background: Opened 1 June 2024 as "Cafe Gallery Tokijiku", a community hub with a café, exhibition gallery, fabric-goods making, events and classes (June 2024 reviews). Only three reviews so far, the newest from April 2025.

anecdotes.text: June 2024: "A gallery that sells bags and interior goods designed with traditional Yuzen patterns. Additionally, it functions as a café where you can enjoy curry rice and coffee."
April 2025: "It's not a gourmet spice curry, but rather has a comforting, home-style flavor."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ときじく、カフェ、下京区松原通新町西入る藪下町31 ロイクラトン四条1F、五条から490m、月・水〜金10:00〜18:00、土10:00〜21:00、火・日・祝日休み。口コミ (2024年6月〜2025年4月、英語、3件): 2024年6月1日開店のギャラリーカフェ、友禅柄のバッグや雑貨の販売、イベントと教室、ひき肉とトマトのカレー750円、チキンのグリーンカレー900円、限定のハンバーグカレー1,200円 (大盛り+100円)、コーヒー500円 (アマテラス・スサノオの2種)。

cultural_comfort.note: Small gallery café; the dining area is open to the shop.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with hours; three reviews, the newest April 2025.

kyoto_toriba_coffee.gf_detail: Ask. A February 2025 reviewer says all the food is vegan and made with rice flour, and a February 2026 reviewer found "many gluten-free options" (canelé, cakes, strawberry daifuku); the katsu sandwich is on bread. Confirm each item and the shared kitchen.
kyoto_toriba_coffee.vegan_detail: Ask — promising. Reviewers say the food is vegan, including a soy-meat katsu sandwich (2025–2026), and staff offered "vegan options" when asked (September 2025). Lattes use milk unless you ask.
kyoto_toriba_coffee.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Wed–Sun 11:00–21:00; closed Tuesday; hours may change. The shop closed for renovation 3–12 March 2026 (March 2026 review). No reservations. Non-smoking. Cards and e-money; no QR codes. Hand-drip coffee about ¥800–1,200; sandwich and coffee set ¥1,500 (March 2025). Service can be slow when busy (April and June 2025). In a long-established former wagashi shop on Nijo-dori near Okazaki, about 10 min from Sanjo Keihan or Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae.
kyoto_toriba_coffee.notes: [Specialty coffee · Nijo-Okazaki, vegan food in an old sweets shop] A Ginza roaster's Kyoto shop in a beautifully kept 100-year-old wagashi building, with kilim sofas and a hidden bar at the back. Hand-drip blends and Kona coffee, and food reviewers describe as all vegan and largely rice-flour — a soy-meat katsu sandwich, canelés. Coffee ¥800–1,200. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: TORIBA COFFEE was founded in Ginza, Tokyo in 2014 and is known for its self-roasted beans and once-famous ¥100 coffee; this Kyoto shop, its second, opened in February 2023 (2025–2026 reviews). It occupies the building of "Kyokado", a wagashi shop of over 100 years that closed in 2022, keeping the old sweets display case and kimono-shop shelving, with photographs by Keiichi Tahara (February 2025). A May 2025 diner saw a man who seemed to be the master and a woman staff member.
chef_bio.philosophy: Its signature blend aims to be "the mildest of all time", adjusted to Kyoto's water (March 2025 review).

anecdotes.text: February 2025: "I also had a canelé (JPY 600). All the food here is vegan, made with rice flour, and it was delightful."
February 2026: "Unfortunately, the lemon cake and strawberry daifuku were sold out, but I was pleased to find many gluten-free options, and the canelé was delicious!"
April 2025: "I also tried to order a canelé, and although I received a 'yes' in response, it was never served."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: TORIBA COFFEE KYOTO、カフェ・喫茶店、左京区難波町226、三条京阪から496m、月・水〜日11:00〜21:00、火曜休み、予約不可、禁煙、カード・電子マネー可、QR不可。口コミ (2025年2月〜2026年3月、英語): 2014年に銀座で創業した自家焙煎のTORIBA COFFEEの2号店 (2023年2月開店)、100年以上の和菓子店「Kyokado」の建物、マイルドブレンド800円、デカフェ1,000円、自社農園のコナ、カフェラテ1,200円、料理はヴィーガンで米粉 (2025年2月)、大豆ミートのヴィーガンかつサンド、カヌレ600円、グルテンフリーの品が多い (2026年2月)、自家製かき氷1,000円、サンザシソーダ、京番茶、2026年3月3〜12日は改装で休業、注文が遅い・忘れられたとの声 (2025年4月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Popular with overseas visitors for its vegan menu (January 2026).

positives: February 2025 review: all food is vegan and made with rice flour.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews to March 2026, when it closed 3–12 March for renovation — check it reopened.

kyoto_gekka_bijin.gf_detail: Not gluten-free as served: the signature mitarashi dango is glazed with a sweet soy-sauce sauce, and some dango are wrapped in a crepe-like batter (2026 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_gekka_bijin.vegan_detail: Ask. Dango with mitarashi, matcha or hojicha may be plant-based, but no ingredient information is given.
kyoto_gekka_bijin.hours_raw: Tabelog lists no hours. A dango and sweet-potato snack shop near Kiyomizu-dera, busy with sightseers and school groups; a line moves quickly (May 2026). A few seats inside; most people eat on the go from a drip-proof cup (August 2026). Cards and e-money; no QR codes. No reservations.
kyoto_gekka_bijin.notes: [Dango · Kiyomizu, giant mitarashi dango to go] A busy little snack shop near Kiyomizu-dera selling big, soft mitarashi dango (¥380) in a cup made for walking, plus matcha and hojicha versions and sweet-potato chips. A few seats inside. Under ¥1,000. Hours not listed.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers (2026) describe a photogenic shop known on social media for its big dango, with a quick-moving line and a few seats; one diner found prices had risen since 2023, and an August 2026 diner thought the ¥750 fruit water weak. The operator is not named in the sources.

anecdotes.text: August 2026: "Each piece is large and filling, wrapped in a crepe-like paper, making it perfect for eating on the go… The container designed for easy eating on the go is almost an invention, as it prevents the sauce from spilling."
May 2026: "Although there is a line, it moves quickly, making the wait feel manageable."
March 2026: "To be honest, I think it might be better to eat it without wrapping it in mochi."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 月下美人、和菓子、東山区桝屋町351-14、祇園四条から1,010m、営業時間の記載なし、予約不可、カード・電子マネー可、QR不可。口コミ (2023年3月〜2026年10月、英語): 清水寺近くの団子と芋のお菓子の店、大きなみたらし団子380円 (2026年8月)、抹茶・ほうじ茶の団子、もち巻き、クレープ状の生地で包んだ団子、芋チップス、アグアフレスカ750円、行列は早く進む、席は少しある、食べ歩き用の容器、値上がりしたとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter; mostly take-away with a few seats.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated March to October 2026.

kyoto_coffee_oshokuji_open.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a classic kissaten menu of toast, katsu curry, fried shrimp, cutlets, kara-age and spaghetti Napolitan (2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_coffee_oshokuji_open.vegan_detail: Not vegan: bacon and eggs, omurice, hamburg steak, pork sauté and fried meats (2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_coffee_oshokuji_open.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 8:30–20:00, closed on some weekends and public holidays; hours may change. Breakfast only in the morning (April 2026), then set meals and café dishes. No reservations. SMOKING ALLOWED throughout — ashtrays on every table (2023–2026 reviews). Cash only: no cards or e-money. About 11 tables; busy at weekday lunch. Run by the older master alone, so food can take a while (March 2026). On the north-east corner of Muromachi and Gojo, 3–6 min from Gojo Station.
kyoto_coffee_oshokuji_open.notes: [Kissaten · Muromachi-Gojo, a 1964 coffee shop] A friendly, old-school coffee shop on the Gojo corner since 1964, where the master cooks alone: ¥840 bacon-and-egg breakfasts, omurice, kara-age and fried platters for under ¥1,100, Beatles on the stereo. Smoking at every table. Cash only.

chef_bio.background: The sign outside reads "SINCE 1964" (March 2022); a May 2026 regular counts 62 years. July 2025 and July 2026 reviewers say the older master runs the shop by himself; reviewers call him kind and the room calm and full of regulars, with The Beatles or Yumi Matsutoya playing. One May 2025 diner found the katsu curry salty and the promised soup never came.

anecdotes.text: July 2025: "The restaurant is run solely by the owner… Having this along with a drink at such a reasonable price is truly delightful!"
October 2023: "A charming old-fashioned café with the Beatles playing in the background… The egg was fluffy and rolled just right."
May 2025: "The curry was quite salty; if they toned down the salt a bit, it could be really delicious—what a shame."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: コーヒー・お食事 OPEN、喫茶店、下京区室町五条東北角、五条駅から徒歩6分、毎日8:30〜20:00 (土日・祝日に休みあり)、予約不可、喫煙可、カード・電子マネー不可。口コミ (2022年3月〜2026年7月、英語): 「SINCE 1964」の看板、年配のマスターがひとりで営む、ビートルズが流れる昭和の喫茶店、モーニング (ベーコンエッグかハムチーズトーストとオムレツ、飲み物付き840円)、オムライス850円、アイスコーヒー480円、唐揚げ定食850円、ポークソテー930円、ミックスフライ定食、和風カツカレー (塩辛いとの声、2025年5月)、ナポリタン、全席に灰皿、提供に時間がかかることも。

cultural_comfort.note: Smoking at every table; cash only; one-man kitchen.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated 2025 to July 2026.

kyoto_shigure_maruyama_park.gf_detail: Ask. Yudofu with condiments that include bonito flakes, vegetable tempura and yuba (December 2025 review); soy and dashi are likely.
kyoto_shigure_maruyama_park.vegan_detail: Ask. The yudofu bento has tofu, yuba and vegetable tempura (December 2025 review), but the condiments include bonito flakes and dashi is likely.
kyoto_shigure_maruyama_park.hours_raw: Tue–Sun and holidays 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:00); closed Mondays (Tabelog). No cover charge (Tabelog Japanese original 「無し」). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 86 seats: 16 at tables and 70 on tatami; private rooms with tables; non-smoking (Tabelog; December 2025 review). Booking through the website (April 2026 review). Inside Maruyama Park beside Yasaka Shrine, 8 min from Gion-Shijo (Tabelog).
kyoto_shigure_maruyama_park.notes: [Kyoto cuisine · Maruyama Park] A large traditional restaurant inside Maruyama Park by Yasaka Shrine, serving colourful Kyoto bentos, yudofu sets and courses with park and cherry-blossom views; tatami rooms and private rooms with chairs. Lunch about ¥3,000–5,000.

chef_bio.background: A Kyoto restaurant inside Maruyama Park, used for sightseeing lunches and family gatherings (2025–26 reviews).

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 guest in kimono booked a private room with chairs and turned the bento's vegetable tempura into a mini tempura bowl over the rice.
A January 2026 diner was offered free rice refills and, it being New Year, free ozoni.
A March 2026 visitor came in cherry-blossom season for tempura and a small hot pot with the blossoms outside.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 志ぐれ、日本料理・鍋、東山区祇園町北側 円山公園内、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩8分、火〜日・祝日 11:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:00)、月曜休み、チャージなし、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、86席 (テーブル16、座敷70)、禁煙。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 円山公園の中、八坂神社の近く、湯豆腐の弁当、湯豆腐の定食3,000円 (2026年2月)、Shigure の弁当、ご飯のおかわり無料、京料理のコース、桜の季節。

cultural_comfort.note: Private rooms with chairs available (December 2025 review).

existence.note: Tabelog listing and own site; reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_nature_curry_soryu.gf_detail: Ask. Spice curries with cumin rice and fried vegetables (2025–26 reviews); whether the curries contain flour is not stated.
kyoto_nature_curry_soryu.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork curry and a keema of beef, pork and soy meat (February 2026 review).
kyoto_nature_curry_soryu.hours_raw: Tue and Wed 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:30); Sat and Sun 11:30–17:00 (L.O. 16:30); closed Mon, Thu, Fri and holidays (Tabelog). Bookings are released to the next guest if late (Tabelog). PayPay only — no cards or e-money (Tabelog). 10 seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). 5 min from Higashiyama Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_nature_curry_soryu.notes: [Curry · Higashiyama-Sanjo] A bright ten-seat spice-curry counter near Awata Shrine: gentle, vegetable-rich pork and keema curries on cumin rice, cardamom cheese pudding, and an owner fond of jokes. About ¥1,600; PayPay only; open four days a week.

chef_bio.background: The owner serves with jokes (March 2025 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Healthy, gentle spice curry with lots of vegetables (2025–26 reviews).

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 hiker came down from Daigonzan starving and had the three-curry plate with craft cola.
A March 2025 goshuin collector added chicken confit to the curry and got the owner's jokes as a side.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: NATURE CURRY 創龍、カレー・インドカレー、東山区稲荷町南組575、地下鉄東山駅から徒歩5分、火・水 11:30〜15:00、土・日 11:30〜17:00、月・木・金・祝日休み、PayPay のみ、カード・電子マネー不可、10席、禁煙。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 3種のカレー、2種の盛り合わせ1,600円、国産豚のポークカレー、牛肉、豚肉、大豆ミートのキーマ、クミンライス、野菜の素揚げ、カルダモンのチーズプリン、冗談好きの店主。

cultural_comfort.note: PayPay only (Tabelog).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through February 2026.

kyoto_kushiden_teramachi_oike.gf_detail: Ask. Oden broth and fish cakes such as chikuwa and satsuma-age usually contain wheat or soy; kushiage is battered (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_kushiden_teramachi_oike.vegan_detail: Not vegan: oden of egg and fish cakes, chicken liver, sausage (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_kushiden_teramachi_oike.hours_raw: Daily 17:30–22:30; irregular closures (Tabelog). Cards; no e-money (Tabelog). 30 seats with counter and sunken seating, private rooms for 6–8; smoking allowed (Tabelog; May 2026 review). Basement of the Bain Oak Mets building on Teramachi north of Oike, behind City Hall, 2 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae (Tabelog; May 2026 review).
kyoto_kushiden_teramachi_oike.notes: [Oden & kushiage · City Hall] A retro basement izakaya behind Kyoto City Hall for broth-soaked Kyoto oden, freshly fried skewers and obanzai, with summer oden too. Smoking allowed; about ¥3,000–7,000.

chef_bio.background: A May 2026 reviewer heard the owner is a cooking YouTuber.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 diner went back for seconds of the onion satsuma-age after the broth-soaked egg and chikuwa.
An August 2024 visitor, already full, was stunned by a sausage the size of a giant Schärfe Wurst.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京都串でん、串揚げ・居酒屋・鍋、中京区上本能寺前町470 バインオークメッツ B1F、京都市役所前駅から徒歩2分、毎日 17:30〜22:30、不定休、カード可、電子マネー不可、30席、個室あり、喫煙可、6月から夏のおでん (紹介文、英訳)。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 京都らしいおでん、卵、ちくわ、玉ねぎのさつま揚げ、味噌おでん、小松菜のおひたし、黒いだし巻き、店主は料理の YouTuber と聞いた (2026年5月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Smoking allowed inside (Tabelog; May 2026 review).

existence.note: Tabelog listing and own site; reviews dated February and May 2026.

kyoto_mameya_genzo.gf_detail: Ask. Tofu, yuba and soy-milk hot pot are the core, but nama-fu (wheat gluten), miso and yuba tempura appear on the courses (2026 reviews).
kyoto_mameya_genzo.vegan_detail: Ask. Tofu-centred courses of yuba, sesame tofu and soy-milk hot pot (2026 reviews), but they also include sashimi, eel and roast beef, and dashi is likely.
kyoto_mameya_genzo.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–14:30 and 17:00–22:00; closing days not fixed (Mondays) (Tabelog). One drink per person; same-day cancellations, date changes and fewer guests are charged in full — tell the shop by 3 pm the day before (Tabelog). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 60 seats, 30 of them on the Kamo River deck in season; counter, tatami and terrace; non-smoking (Tabelog). On Kiyamachi by the Takase River, in a building that keeps traces of a former teahouse and inn, 3 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae (Tabelog; ozmall; August 2026 review).
kyoto_mameya_genzo.notes: [Tofu kaiseki · Kiyamachi] A Kiyamachi house in a former teahouse building serving house-made tofu, yuba and soy-milk hot pot as Kyoto courses, on a Kamo River deck in summer. About ¥7,700–15,000; strict cancellation policy.

chef_bio.background: Opened 1 August 2010 (Tabelog), in a building that keeps traces of a former teahouse and inn, making its own tofu, yuba and miso (ozmall).
chef_bio.philosophy: Kyoto cuisine built on soybeans — house-made tofu, yuba and miso (ozmall).

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 party celebrated a friend's 70th birthday on the river deck as the sky cleared after a typhoon.
An August 2026 couple started indoors because of heavy rain, and the staff moved the table outside when the weather cleared.
A May 2026 visitor was given a blanket as the river grew chilly at sunset and remembered the nama-fu dengaku most.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 豆屋源蔵、日本料理・豆腐料理、中京区上樵木町490-1、京都市役所前駅から徒歩3分、毎日 11:30〜14:30・17:00〜22:00、不定休 (月曜)、ワンドリンク制、当日キャンセル・日時変更・人数減は100%、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、60席 (納涼床30席)、禁煙、2010年8月1日オープン。オズモール: 自家製の豆腐、湯葉、味噌の京料理、元お茶屋と旅館の名残の建物、鴨川の納涼床。口コミ (2026年、英語): 豆腐のコース7,700円、生麩の田楽、胡麻豆腐、豆乳鍋、湯葉の揚げ物。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; full charge for late changes (Tabelog).

existence.note: Tabelog listing and ozmall; reviews dated May–September 2026.

kyoto_la_boucle_anekoji.gf_detail: Ask. French bistro dishes with sauces, pâté en croûte, bread and butter; no gluten information is published (reviews).
kyoto_la_boucle_anekoji.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a game-meat and fish bistro; a reviewer wished for more vegetable dishes (April 2026).
kyoto_la_boucle_anekoji.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:30) and dinner 18:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Courses by reservation only, otherwise à la carte; booking ahead recommended (Tabelog; March 2026). One drink per person (May 2024). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and e-money; no service or table charge (Tabelog) — a May 2024 reviewer heard cards were only taken for bills over ¥10,000. 18 seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). ION Building 1F at the corner of Anekoji and Gokomachi, about 3 minutes from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae (Tabelog; August 2024). Opened 1 November 2016 (Tabelog).
kyoto_la_boucle_anekoji.notes: [French bistro · Anekoji-Gokomachi, game meat and jazz] A small jazz-playing bistro near City Hall that does game well — venison pâté en croûte, boar ham, venison steak — plus fish soup and a moreish garlic-shrimp butter. Lunch from ¥2,200; courses by reservation; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened in November 2016 on the corner of Anekoji and Gokomachi (Tabelog). Reviewers (2018–2026) describe a calm room with jazz, a piano and guitar on display, and cooking that takes the gaminess out of game.
chef_bio.philosophy: Fresh seasonal vegetables and fish, hearty meat, and a glass of wine to music (Tabelog shop text).

anecdotes.text: An August 2024 diner recommended the venison pâté en croûte — just ask for bread.
A January 2026 lunch guest found the ¥2,200 lunch outstanding, especially the garlic-shrimp butter.
A July 2026 group of lunchtime drinkers returned for duck and boar ham, beef tartare and venison steak.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ラ・ブークル、フレンチ・ダイニングバー・ビストロ、京都市中京区御幸町姉小路大文字町340-1 IONビル1F、月・水〜日 11:30〜15:00 (L.O.14:30)、18:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、火曜定休、カード・電子マネー可、サービス料・チャージなし、18席、禁煙、2016年11月1日オープン、姉小路通と御幸町通の角のビストロ、アラカルト中心、コースは予約のみ、旬の野菜と魚、ボリュームのある肉料理、音楽とワイン。口コミ (2018〜2026年、英語): ジビエ (鹿、鴨、猪)、鹿のパテアンクルート、カンパチのコンフィ、鴨と猪のハム、とうもろこしのムース、魚のスープ、牛のタルタル、鹿のステーキ、小海老とにんにくのバター、鴨胸肉、真鯛のポワレ、ランチ2,200円、フルコース3,850円、1人1ドリンク、ジャズ、ピアノとギター、予約がおすすめ、カードは1万円以上のみと聞いたという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; one drink per person.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through July 2026.

kyoto_nandemoya_ajikatsu.gf_detail: Ask. Oden, ponzu dishes, dashimaki and fried rice with dashi and soy; no gluten information is published (reviews).
kyoto_nandemoya_ajikatsu.vegan_detail: Not vegan: oden in dashi, offal, fish and egg dishes (reviews).
kyoto_nandemoya_ajikatsu.hours_raw: 19:00–03:00 Monday–Saturday; closed Sunday and holidays (Tabelog). No e-money or QR (Tabelog). 10 seats: a 6-seat counter and two small raised tables; non-smoking (Tabelog). Ground floor, east of Hanamikoji on Shinbashi-dori, at the north end of Gion, down an atmospheric approach from the street (Tabelog; January 2023).
kyoto_nandemoya_ajikatsu.notes: [Izakaya · north Gion, a late-night couple-run diner] A ten-seat Gion izakaya run by an older couple and open until 3 am, its walls lined with dishes — oden, katsuo tataki under onion salad, mentaiko dashimaki, jako fried rice. A favourite late stop of regulars; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers (2019–2026) describe a late-night izakaya run by an older couple whose warm smiles make it cosy; the owner and the owner’s wife do all the cooking, and regulars and other restaurateurs drop by after work.

anecdotes.text: A January 2023 visitor spotted the owner of another Gion restaurant there on a break.
A June 2023 diner was amused to find the katsuo tataki hidden under a mound of onion salad.
A May 2026 guest made it the fifth stop of the night.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: なんでもや 味勝、居酒屋、京都市東山区林下町422-83 サンピアザビル1F、月〜土 19:00〜翌3:00、日曜・祝日定休、電子マネー・QR決済不可、10席 (カウンター6、小上がり2人×2)、禁煙。口コミ (2019〜2026年、英語): 花見小路新橋東、祇園の北の端、通りからの路地の雰囲気、年配のご夫婦の店、壁の品書き、おでん、みのポン、とろろご飯、すいかとなすのサラダ、玉ねぎの下のかつおのたたき、鱧、生麩、生からすみ、じゃこ炒飯、明太だし巻き、激辛の明太子、深夜の食堂、常連が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Ten-seat late-night counter; menu on the walls.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through May 2026. mom_and_pop: “This charming izakaya is run by an elderly couple” (January 2025 review B504018954), which adds that the owner and the owner’s wife prepare everything.

kyoto_gion_toto_maru.gf_detail: Ask. Fish-led izakaya dishes with soy, plus meats and vegetables; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_gion_toto_maru.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood izakaya; vegetables and rare greens are on the menu but alongside fish and meat (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_toto_maru.hours_raw: 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:00) Tuesday–Saturday (Tabelog); Sunday and Monday are not stated. Cards, e-money and QR payments (Tabelog). 22 seats, including a raised area for up to 12 — call for parties of 9 or more; non-smoking (Tabelog). Ground floor on Gion-machi Kitagawa (Tabelog). Opened 5 February 2026 (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_toto_maru.notes: [Seafood izakaya · Gion north of Shijo, fisherman-direct fish] A friendly new (February 2026) Gion izakaya whose fish comes straight from fishermen, bled on the boat: generous sashimi platters with chu-toro and abalone, seared ishidai, live sea urchin and sea pineapple, with Japanese sake.

roles: Head chef and owner not named
chef_bio.background: Opened in February 2026 (Tabelog) after long training, aiming to be a casual place for fisherman-direct fish (Tabelog shop text). Reviewers (2026) describe a calm, gentle room and a friendly head chef and owner; maiko have visited.
chef_bio.philosophy: Guests who chose this place out of thousands should leave fully satisfied (Tabelog shop text).

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 guest tried ishidai fin for the first time and loved the seared ishidai.
An August 2026 visitor was shown the whole red snapper before it went into the sashimi platter.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 酌と野菜と小皿と。祇園とと◯、居酒屋・日本料理・海鮮、京都市東山区祇園町北側347-16 祇園東ビル1F、火〜土 17:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:00)、カード・電子マネー・QR決済可、22席 (小上がりは12名まで、9名以上は電話で)、禁煙、2026年2月5日オープン、漁師から直送の船上で血抜き・処理した魚、活け雲丹、天然のほや、珍しい野菜、上質な肉、修業を経て気軽な店に。口コミ (2026年、英語): 宮崎の漁船から直送の刺身 (かんぱち、あじ、石鯛、海ぶどう)、石鯛のひれ、炙りの石鯛、7種の刺身盛り (中トロ、鮑、くらげ)、丸ごとの真鯛を見せてから、日本酒、舞妓さんも来る、気さくな料理長と店主。

cultural_comfort.note: Call for groups of 9 or more.

existence.note: Tabelog listing (opened 5 February 2026); reviews dated May and August 2026.

kyoto_kitakaze_to_taiyo.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: pasta, bread and risotto are central; lunch courses are built around pasta (2025–26 reviews). Staff accommodated one regular’s dietary restrictions (October 2026) — ask.
kyoto_kitakaze_to_taiyo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: duck, roast beef, oysters, Camembert, sausages and boudin noir (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_kitakaze_to_taiyo.hours_raw: Mon, Thu–Sun 11:30–23:30 (food last order 22:30, drinks 23:00); Tue–Wed 15:00–23:30 (Tabelog). Lunch courses 11:30–14:30 (Tabelog). A wine event once a month, announced on Instagram (Tabelog). Tabelog’s reservation note mentions a private-room fee: 10% for two guests, 5% for three, none for four or more. Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 28 seats: counter, tables and private rooms (Tabelog; June 2026). Basement of AMI Shijo Karasuma, through a heavy door at the foot of the stairs (June 2026), on Ayanokoji west of Muromachi.
kyoto_kitakaze_to_taiyo.notes: [Italian & wine · Shijo-Muromachi] A calm basement Italian dining bar near Shijo-Karasuma, open from lunch through to late on most days: good-value pasta lunch courses, then duck carpaccio with sansho foam, ajillos, roast beef and seasonal plates, each served split per person, with wine pairings. Private rooms carry a small fee for two or three. Tuesday and Wednesday from 15:00.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an Italian dining bar opened 4 December 2023 in the basement of AMI Shijo Karasuma.
chef_bio.specialty: Duck carpaccio with sansho foam; per-person plating of à la carte dishes.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 solo visitor, expecting a casual bistro behind the heavy basement door, found glasses and napkins laid and dishes timed to the diner’s pace like a course — corn soup, duck, bonito and boudin noir with three glasses of wine.
A November 2026 regular on a fourth visit came for à la carte and was offered a course built to taste instead, with a financier wrapped to take home when full.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ダイニングバー・ビストロ、下京区綾小路通室町西入る善長寺町139 AMI四条烏丸 B1F、月木金土日11:30〜23:30 (料理L.O.22:30・ドリンクL.O.23:00)、火水15:00〜23:30、ランチコース11:30〜14:30、月1回のワインイベント、個室料 (2名10%・3名5%・4名以上無料)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、28席、2023年12月4日オープン。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年11月、英語): 鴨のカルパッチョ山椒の泡、ローストビーフ、牡蠣やカマンベールのアヒージョ、牡蠣と九条ねぎのアヒージョ、ワイン蒸しをリゾットに、ブーダンノワール、ランチ1,400円から (サラダ、パスタ、パン)、太陽コース、料理は一人ずつ取り分けて出す、ワインのペアリング、オーナーシェフ、地下の重い扉。

cultural_comfort.note: Book the sofa or private seats ahead; à la carte dishes come split per person. Tell staff your budget for wine. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_chokatsu_okami_labo.gf_detail: Ask. Set meals of fermented, koji-seasoned dishes with aged brown rice, plus a fermented curry (2025–26 reviews); koji seasonings and soy-based ones are not described for wheat. No allergen information.
kyoto_chokatsu_okami_labo.vegan_detail: Ask. Many seasonal vegetable sides, but the mains are meat or fish (pork shabu-shabu, sawara with plum, chicken gratin) and no vegan option is sourced (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_chokatsu_okami_labo.hours_raw: Breakfast 8:00–9:30 and lunch/café 11:30–18:00; closed Thursday; may change (Tabelog). Seats fill soon after lunch opens on Saturdays — reservations advised (December 2025). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Staff speak English and Japanese (September 2026). On the main street near Higashiyama Station (November 2024, August 2025). The shop also offers abdominal massage treatments (shop site; 2024–25 reviews).
kyoto_chokatsu_okami_labo.notes: [Fermented-food set meals · Higashiyama] A bright café near Higashiyama Station built around fermented food: set lunches of a meat or fish main with three chosen seasonal sides and aged brown rice, a fermented curry, koji sweets, and Japanese or Western breakfasts from 8:00. English spoken. Closed Thursday.

roles: Owner (unnamed), who runs it with a daughter (April 2025)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews: a café opened 25 May 2024 near Higashiyama Station, serving fermented-food meals; the shop also offers abdominal massage treatments (May 2024, June 2025).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the shop’s name and reviews: meals of fermented foods and seasonal vegetables for gut health (June 2025).

anecdotes.text: An April 2025 traveller liked the breakfast enough to come back the same trip for lunch, glad of the vegetables, served by the owner and daughter.
A December 2025 Saturday diner arrived at opening to find the seats filling fast, and had sawara simmered with plum among three chosen sides.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ、東山区西海子町47、朝8:00〜9:30・昼11:30〜18:00、木曜休み、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、2024年5月25日オープン。口コミ (2024年5月〜2026年10月、英語): 腸活ごはん、肉か魚の主菜に6〜8種から小鉢3品、熟成玄米、腸活定食 (肉) 1,540円、鰆の梅煮、豚しゃぶときのこと水菜、発酵カレー、麹のスイーツ、酒かすのスムージー、和洋の朝食、お腹のマッサージの施術も、店主と娘さん、英語と日本語で対応、土曜は予約がおすすめ、東山駅の近く。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff explain the menu in English and Japanese (September 2026). Book for Saturday lunch.

existence.note: Shop site; Tabelog reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_chokotto_shiki.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: gyoza, tempura, karaage, shrimp pasta, curry and dashi dishes (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_chokotto_shiki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sea bream, tuna, chicken, beef tendon, dashi throughout (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_chokotto_shiki.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:00) and 17:00–23:00 (food last order 22:00, drinks 22:30); closing days vary (Tabelog). 「単品料理ご注文の方のみお通し代400円（税込み）」 — a ¥400 appetizer charge applies only when ordering à la carte, not on courses (Tabelog). Cards and QR; no e-money (Tabelog). 22 seats: a counter and private table rooms for four, which join for eight (Tabelog; March and May 2025). Small sign at the building entrance, just south of the Rokkaku–Muromachi crossing, near Karasuma Oike (March 2025).
kyoto_chokotto_shiki.notes: [Izakaya · Muromachi-Rokkaku] A calm small-plates izakaya with a counter and private rooms, opened in 2025 near Karasuma Oike: set lunches such as sea-bream dashi curry or karaage, and in the evening a ¥3,300 mini course — dashimaki, beef tendon, gyoza, tempura — or sashimi and sea-bream chazuke, with dishes split per person. ¥400 appetizer charge on à la carte orders only.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews: an izakaya opened 1 March 2025 on the ground floor of Ramblas Muromachi Rokkaku, serving Japanese, Western, Chinese and Italian dishes (March 2025).

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 diner tried the ¥3,300 mini course of six dishes and was most struck by the dashimaki and the gyoza with three dips.
A July 2026 pair asked for no cucumber in the salad; the staff remade and re-plated it, and the two came back the next day.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋、中京区鯉山町507 ランブラス室町六角 1F、毎日11:00〜15:00 (L.O.14:00)・17:00〜23:00 (料理L.O.22:00・ドリンクL.O.22:30)、不定休、単品料理ご注文の方のみお通し代400円 (税込み)、カード・QR 可、電子マネー不可、22席、2025年3月1日オープン。口コミ (2025年3月〜2026年11月、英語): 和洋中伊の料理、カウンターと個室、昼は唐揚げ1,000円、野菜のスープカレー1,300円、鯛だしカレー、オムライス、鯛めし、夜はミニコース3,300円 (Yamato somen、だし巻き、牛すじと大根、かぼちゃのムース、餃子、天ぷら)、刺身、鯛の漬け、鯛茶漬け、海老のパスタ、料理を取り分けて出す、六角室町の少し南。

cultural_comfort.note: Order a course to skip the ¥400 à la carte appetizer charge. Mention dislikes — the staff adjust dishes. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_kaeru_coffee.vegan_detail: Not vegan: butter chicken curry, cheese toast, carrot cake with whipped cream (2026 reviews). Black coffee is the plant-based choice.
kyoto_kaeru_coffee.hours_raw: Mon, Wed–Sun 9:00–18:00; closed Tuesday and some irregular days (Tabelog). Cards and e-money; no QR (Tabelog). Fills by mid-afternoon on weekdays (February 2026). Faces a small park, just south of Gojo near Takakura, close to Gojo Station (March, May and July 2026).
kyoto_kaeru_coffee.notes: [Coffee · south of Gojo] A wood-panelled café facing a small park just south of Gojo, roasting its own beans and full of frog figurines: single origins and blends picked from a taste chart, cheese toast for breakfast, butter chicken curry, warm carrot cake and banana bread. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews: a café opened 2 May 2018 south of Gojo, roasting its own beans (February 2026).

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 regular, posting for the first time, chose an iced fruity blend from the menu’s bitterness–acidity chart to go with the long-standing butter chicken curry, and came back the next weekend.
A February 2026 visitor spent the visit spotting the frogs hidden around the room over a café latte with coffee jelly.

kyoto_tempura_tomi_gojo.gf_detail: Not GF: tempura in wheat batter is the core of the courses (2024–2025 reviews).
kyoto_tempura_tomi_gojo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seafood tempura, sashimi and sushi (2024–2025 reviews).
kyoto_tempura_tomi_gojo.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday and holidays 17:00–22:30 (last food order 21:30); closed Monday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and advised for the small room (Tabelog; January 2024). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 14 seats: 6 at the 1F counter and an 8-seat tatami room upstairs; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). In a former sushi shop, 3 min walk from Gojo Stn exit 5 (Tabelog; December 2024). Opened 12 January 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_tempura_tomi_gojo.notes: [Tempura · near Gojo Stn] A small, smart tempura counter in a former sushi shop: courses of seasonal vegetables and seafood fried before you, with sashimi, grilled dishes and a bite of sushi at the end, and a friendly chef. Book. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: a tempura restaurant opened 12 January 2024 in a former sushi shop near Gojo, run by a smiling, attentive chef who asks whether each drink is as the guest likes it (January–December 2024; October 2026).

anecdotes.text: A diner on only the second day after opening in January 2024 found two courses, ¥5,500 and ¥8,800, and a friendly, approachable chef.
A December 2024 group of five had the counter to themselves; the manager checked the strength of a shochu mix.
A January 2025 diner was pleased to be offered sushi after the tempura.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 天ぷら、下京区橋詰町133-4、五条駅5番出口から3分、火〜日・祝日 17:00〜22:30 (L.O.料理21:30)、月曜休み、予約可、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX・Diners・銀聯) 可、電子マネー・QR 不可、14席 (1階カウンター6席、2階8名の座敷)、禁煙、子ども可、2024年1月12日開店。口コミ (2024年1月〜2026年10月、英語): 5,500円と8,800円のコース (2024年1月)、目の前で揚げる旬の野菜と魚介の天ぷら、焼き物や刺身、最後に寿司 (2025年1月)、元は寿司屋、笑顔の店主の気配り。

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter; book; cards accepted.

kyoto_saami_maruyama.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Kyoto kaiseki with dashi and soy throughout (official site; 2024–2026 reviews). No gluten information.
kyoto_saami_maruyama.vegan_detail: Not vegan: kaiseki of fish and dashi, e.g. hamo and matsutake dobin-mushi (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_saami_maruyama.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–15:00 (last order 13:30) and 17:00–21:30 (last order 19:30); closed over the New Year (Tabelog). The official site lists the lunch Hana Gozen from 11:00 to 14:00. Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Official prices include tax and service charge (official site). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and QR; no e-money (Tabelog). 300 seats in private rooms from 2 to 30+ with tatami and sunken seating; wheelchair accessible; non-smoking; children welcome with a kids’ menu; parking for about 2 cars (Tabelog). Above Maruyama Park, east of Yasaka Shrine (Tabelog; 2025 reviews). A November 2026 guest heard the management had changed.
kyoto_saami_maruyama.notes: [Kaiseki ryotei · above Maruyama Park] A historic ryotei up the hill from Yasaka Shrine — a hermitage from 1615, a restaurant since 1849 — serving seasonal Kyoto kaiseki in private rooms with views over the city and the autumn leaves. Popular for family ceremonies. Prices include tax and service.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the 左阿彌 hermitage dates to Genna 1 (1615), and it became a ryotei in Kaei 2 (1849); the site tells how 織田頼長, son of 織田有楽斎 (Oda Nagamasu), retired here as a tea practitioner. Reviewers describe being greeted by the owner (October 2024) and, in November 2026, hearing that the management had changed.
chef_bio.philosophy: Kaiseki rooted in the tea ceremony (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 grandparent returned after two years for a second grandchild’s okuizome, glad of a roomy space for a toddler to run in.
An October 2026 party came after a memorial service at Otani Sobyo for the Shinobu Gozen and autumn leaves from the window.
A March 2024 guest delayed by traffic was given extra time so the party could still catch the train home.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 「東山の庵に左阿彌が誕生したのは、元和元年のこと」、「左阿彌が料亭を始めたのは嘉永二年。」、織田頼長は「織田信長の弟である織田長益（有楽斎）の第２子（嫡子）」、お昼の華御膳 (午前11時より午後2時まで) 11,385円、お昼の京懐石13,915円から、京懐石16,445〜63,250円、披露宴の膳、ご法事 偲ぶ御膳、「※料金は税・サービス料込です。」。食べログ: 日本料理、東山区八坂鳥居前東入ル円山町7-3 (円山公園内)、毎日 11:30〜15:00 (L.O.13:30)、17:00〜21:30 (L.O.19:30)、年末年始休み、予約可、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX・Diners)・QR 可、300席、個室、車いす可、禁煙、子ども可・子どもメニュー、駐車場2台ほど。口コミ (2024年3月〜2026年11月、英語): 嘉永2年 (1849年) 創業、円山公園の上、市内と紅葉の眺め、お食い初め、法事、土瓶蒸し (鱧と松茸)、経営が変わったとの声 (2026年11月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; private rooms; prices include service.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog; reviews through November 2026.

kyoto_inotsuchi_yoshoku.gf_detail: Not GF: hamburg steak (usually bound with breadcrumbs), breaded cutlets, fried shrimp and demi-glace (2026 reviews).
kyoto_inotsuchi_yoshoku.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a meat and fried-food yoshoku lunch (2026 reviews).
kyoto_inotsuchi_yoshoku.hours_raw: Monday and Wednesday–Sunday 11:00–15:30 (last order 15:00); closed Tuesday; hours may change (Tabelog). Lunch only. Reservations accepted (Tabelog). No cards; e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). Ordering by smartphone (June 2026). Counter and tables; non-smoking (Tabelog; July 2026). Moved across Nijo-dori to the south side, entrance at the side of the building, opening here on 24 November 2025 (Tabelog; June–October 2026). Near Okazaki, about 7 min walk from Sanjo Keihan.
kyoto_inotsuchi_yoshoku.notes: [Yoshoku · Nijo near Okazaki, lunch only] A friendly owner-run yoshoku lunch spot, newly moved across Nijo-dori: sizzling teppan hamburg with your choice of sauce, fillet cutlets and fried shrimp, each with a soup, and a homemade shiso juice. Handy before the Okazaki museums. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: a yoshoku restaurant whose owner runs the kitchen, reopened on 24 November 2025 in a larger room on the south side of Nijo-dori after moving from across the road; its teppan hamburg was featured on a Kansai TV programme (May 2026).

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 diner came after seeing the teppan hamburg on a Kansai information programme the month before, with a chilled carrot-potato soup.
An October 2026 visitor on the way to the Ghibli exhibition at the Kyocera Museum loved the homemade shiso juice, which is not sold separately.
A June 2026 pair reunited over the fried shrimp and fillet-cutlet set, impressed by the roomier new shop.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 洋食、左京区新間之町通二条下ル頭町337-79 忍性寺北棟、三条京阪から490m、月・水〜日 11:00〜15:30 (L.O.15:00)、火曜休み、予約可、カード不可、電子マネー・QR 可、カウンター、禁煙、2025年11月24日開店。口コミ (2026年5〜10月、英語): 二条通の向かいから南側へ移転、入口は建物の横、店主が厨房、スマートフォンで注文、鉄板ハンバーグ定食1,500円 (デミグラス200円、照り焼き、ハニーマスタード、おろし、目玉焼き200円)、エビフライとヒレカツの定食、ヒレカツプレート1,800円、ハンバーグとチキン南蛮、冷たいにんじんとじゃがいものスープ・かぼちゃ・じゃがいものポタージュ、自家製のしそジュース、関西のテレビで紹介 (2026年5月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Smartphone ordering; no cards (e-money and QR OK); lunch only.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reopened here November 2025; reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_karasuma_sakaba_matsuri.gf_detail: Not GF: kushikatsu, okonomiyaki, yakisoba and kara-age (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_karasuma_sakaba_matsuri.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken-heavy izakaya menu, motsu-ni and fried skewers (2025 reviews).
kyoto_karasuma_sakaba_matsuri.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday and holidays 17:00–24:00 (last orders food 23:00, drinks 23:30); closed Sunday; may close on the last day of long holidays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; all-you-can-drink party courses from ¥3,500 (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR (Tabelog). 36 seats at the counter and tables; smoking allowed — reviewers found the smoke strong (Tabelog; March 2026). Free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). 1 min walk from Gojo Stn exit 6. Opened 2 May 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_karasuma_sakaba_matsuri.notes: [Izakaya · by Gojo Stn, smoking allowed] A lively, good-value Kansai izakaya a minute from Gojo station: kushikatsu, yakisoba, motsu-ni and kara-age, with all-you-can-drink party courses from ¥3,500 and chatty staff. Smoky. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: a Kansai-style izakaya opened 2 May 2024 by Gojo station, popular for parties and with overseas visitors, where friendly staff remember returning guests (April–November 2025).

anecdotes.text: Two friends back in November 2025 were remembered by the chef and enjoyed chatting at the counter.
A December 2025 group on the ¥4,000 all-you-can-drink course watched an empty room fill up fast.
A March 2026 diner liked every dish but found the cigarette smoke too strong to stay long.

kyoto_furlan_ebisugawa.gf_detail: Ask when booking — Tabelog asks guests to state allergies with the reservation. Courses include pasta, choux pastry and bread (Tabelog; 2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_furlan_ebisugawa.vegan_detail: Ask when booking. Courses are vegetable-rich but include cheese, cream, meat and fish (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_furlan_ebisugawa.hours_raw: Friday–Wednesday 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:00) and 18:30–21:00; closed Thursday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, practically required for eight seats; state allergies when booking; requests made online may not always be met (Tabelog; July 2025). Service charge 5% (Tabelog original サービス料5％頂いております). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 8 counter seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). Behind large glass windows next to a select shop on Ebisugawa-dori west of Teramachi; the door is easy to miss (February–April 2025). Opened 1 September 2023 (November 2024 review).
kyoto_furlan_ebisugawa.notes: [Italian · Ebisugawa-Teramachi, 8 seats] A tiny counter where chef Kenta Mizutani, trained in Trieste, cooks delicate seasonal Italian with Friulian touches — savoury éclairs, heaped salads, fine pastas — solo and with charm. Book; tell allergies when reserving. 5% service. Closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: owner-chef Kenta Mizutani trained in Trieste and named the restaurant after the Friulian language; it opened on 1 September 2023 and the chef cooks, serves and changes cutlery for each course single-handed (November 2024; October 2025; June 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Bring out ingredients’ natural flavours with light seasoning (Tabelog; June 2026).

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 pair turned away elsewhere wandered in from the select shop next door without a booking, and the chef kindly fitted the pair in.
A February 2025 visitor who mistook it for a café was shown to the counter on a cold day and served warm jasmine tea.
A March 2026 first dinner found all seven counter seats full for a course from cauliflower mousse to sakura-shrimp pasta.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタリアン、中京区夷川通寺町西入ル丸屋町693 ハオスハウゼ 1F、市役所前駅から徒歩10分、金〜水 11:30〜14:00 (L.O.13:00)、18:30〜21:00、木曜休み、予約可 (アレルギーは予約時に)、サービス料5％頂いております、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX・Diners) 可、電子マネー・QR 不可、カウンター8席、禁煙、紹介文 (英訳): 旬の食材のイタリアンと店名の由来のフリウリの料理、おまかせのコース。口コミ (2024年11月〜2026年6月、英語): Kenta Mizutani シェフ、トリエステで修業、2023年9月1日開店、一人で調理と給仕、昼のコース3,500円ほど (キャベツとリコッタのエクレア、サーモンののった山盛りサラダ、2種のパスタ、ジェラート)、夜はカリフラワーのムース、馬肉のタルタル、Yoro 豚の春野菜のスープ、桜えびのパスタ。

cultural_comfort.note: Book; state allergies when reserving; 5% service charge.

staff_allergy_handling: Tabelog asks guests to state allergies when booking

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through June 2026.

kyoto_wine_highball_fujiya.gf_detail: Ask. Wine, whisky highballs and Japanese small plates; no food or gluten details beyond an appetizer with the cover charge (Tabelog; January 2026).
kyoto_wine_highball_fujiya.vegan_detail: Ask. No information on the dishes (Tabelog; January 2026).
kyoto_wine_highball_fujiya.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 19:00–02:00 (last orders 1:30); closed Sunday (Tabelog). Cover charge ¥600 incl. tax, with an appetizer (Tabelog, original チャージ料600円（税込）(おつきだし付); the English page mistranslates it as “soup stock”). Cards and QR; no e-money (Tabelog). 10 counter seats (Tabelog; January 2026). A minute east of Nishinotoin-Takatsuji (January 2026). Open since 1 May 2019 (Tabelog).
kyoto_wine_highball_fujiya.notes: [Bar · Nishinotoin-Takatsuji, late] A ten-seat counter bar a minute from Nishinotoin-Takatsuji, open till 2:00, for wine, highballs and small Japanese plates, where the owner looks after regulars and newcomers alike. ¥600 cover with an appetizer. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: The receipt invoice number on Tabelog belongs to 佐藤雄大, an individual (NTA register). A January 2026 reviewer describes a master whose thoughtful service makes regulars and first-timers mix easily.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 regular came for a New Year drink and spent the evening chatting with three other regulars at the counter.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ワインとハイボール ふじ屋、ワインバー・居酒屋・日本料理、下京区堀乃内272-4、月〜土 19:00〜翌2:00 (L.O. 1:30)、日曜定休、2019年5月1日オープン、チャージ料600円 (税込、おつきだし付)、カード・QR可、電子マネー不可、10席。適格請求書: 佐藤雄大 (個人)。口コミ (2026年1月、英語): 西洞院高辻から東へ1分、カウンターのみ、常連と新しい客が交わる、マスターの気配り、美しく盛られたお通しと水割り。

cultural_comfort.note: Small regulars’ counter; ¥600 cover with an appetizer.

kyoto_kissa_poppo_niomon.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: curry roux, curry udon and toast (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kissa_poppo_niomon.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 7:00–14:00; closed Sunday (Tabelog). The sign may read “preparing” while it is open (April 2026). About four counter seats and two tables for two (April 2026). Smoking allowed; no smartphones or Wi-Fi — newspapers, magazines and TV instead (July 2026). On Higashioji, southeast of the 仁王門 crossing (Tabelog).
kyoto_kissa_poppo_niomon.notes: [Kissaten · Higashioji, Showa era] A tiny old coffee shop for neighbourhood regulars, run alone by an elderly owner: morning toast sets from 7:00, good coffee, and a beef curry with chunks of A4 beef for ¥750. No phones or Wi-Fi; smoking allowed. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: A July 2026 reviewer describes an elderly owner who runs everything alone; an April 2025 reviewer found the owner friendly with first-timers. No operator was found.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 couple skipping hotel breakfast found the sign set to “preparing”, saw customers inside, and were served curry and a ¥450 toast set among the regulars.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 喫茶ポッポ、カレー・喫茶店、左京区北門前町 (東大路仁王門南東)、月〜土 7:00〜14:00、日曜定休。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 常連の多い店、気さくなマスター、A4ランクの牛肉のカレー750円、辛めのカレー、モーニングのトーストセット450円、コーヒー、カウンター4席と2人掛けテーブル2卓、昼はカレーライスとカレーうどんのみ、スマホとWi-Fi禁止、テレビと新聞・雑誌、喫煙可、年配の店主が一人で切り盛り。

cultural_comfort.note: Regulars’ coffee shop; no phones; smoking allowed.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated April 2025 to July 2026.
