kyoto_nijo_takakura_ui.gf_detail: Ask. Creative Japanese small plates (appetizer platter, sashimi with ponzu jelly, miso-butter stir-fry, corn tempura, fried rice); no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_nijo_takakura_ui.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sea bream, hamo, salmon, duck, wagyu and chicken; dashi-based dishes (2026 reviews).
kyoto_nijo_takakura_ui.hours_raw: Monday–Friday 17:00–23:00; Saturday, Sunday and public holidays 14:00–23:00 (last orders 22:00); days off irregular (Tabelog). Seat charge ¥330 from 17:00, none with a course (Tabelog, original お席料330円（17時～）※コースの場合はなし). Cards and e-money (Tabelog). 18 seats at tables for 2–4 and a counter (Tabelog; October 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). QR-code ordering (October 2026). Opened 1 June 2026 in the former 日本酒食堂 しずく (Tabelog; June and October 2026). 5–6 min on foot from Karasuma-Oike (July and October 2026).
kyoto_nijo_takakura_ui.notes: [Sake and small plates · near Karasuma-Oike, opened 2026] A quiet new sake bar near Karasuma-Oike from an owner who is both sommelier and barista and ran a restaurant in Gion: creative Japanese plates, a generous appetizer platter for one, and sake by the 60 ml glass. Opens 14:00 at weekends. ¥330 seat charge from 17:00.

chef_bio.background: A June 2026 reviewer says the owner previously managed a restaurant in Gion and has gone independent here; a September 2026 reviewer describes the owner as a sommelier and barista. No operator was found.
chef_bio.specialty: Creative Japanese small plates with sake.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 solo traveller, not very hungry, made a meal of the appetizer platter and four 60 ml pours of sake.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 二条高倉 うい、居酒屋・創作料理・バル、中京区瓦町540、月〜金 17:00〜23:00、土日祝日 14:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:00)、不定休、2026年6月1日オープン、お席料330円 (17時〜、コースの場合はなし)、カード・電子マネー可、18席、禁煙。口コミ (2026年、英語): 日本酒食堂 しずくの跡、店主は祇園の店を任されていた、ソムリエでバリスタ、前菜の盛り合わせ1人前1,500円 (鯛のポン酢ジュレ、鴨のロースト、鮭の南蛮漬け、燻製大根のポテサラ)、アスパラと舞茸の味噌バター950円、淡路の鱧の造り950円、とうもろこしの天ぷら650円、すぐきとじゃこの炒飯650円、和牛のバルサミコ、トリュフ塩のフライドポテト、鮭の西京焼き、せせりと九条ねぎ、日本酒は60ml・100ml・徳利、QRで注文。

cultural_comfort.note: QR-code ordering; ¥330 seat charge after 17:00.

kyoto_cafe_kaneya_gojozaka.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: lunch mains include yaki udon and curry udon (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_cafe_kaneya_gojozaka.vegan_detail: Ask. Vegetable-rich curry udon and shiratama sweets, but nothing is described as vegan (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_cafe_kaneya_gojozaka.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday–Sunday 10:30–18:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Cards: AMEX (Tabelog). 24 seats (Tabelog). On the slope up to Kiyomizu-dera (December 2025; May 2026).
kyoto_cafe_kaneya_gojozaka.notes: [Café lunch · Gojo-zaka, Kiyomizu slope] A calm Japanese-style café on the slope up to Kiyomizu-dera, good for a break: lunch sets of about ¥1,500 with salad, soup and a little dessert, yaki udon, curry udon full of vegetables, and shiratama sweets. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: No operator or owner details were found.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 visitor walking down from Kiyomizu-dera stopped in for vegetable-packed curry udon and loved the shiratama.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ かねや、カフェ、東山区五条通東大路東入白糸町570、月・火・木〜日 10:30〜18:00、水曜定休、カードはAMEX、24席。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 清水寺への坂の和風カフェ、サラダ・スープ・小さなデザート付きのランチ約1,500円、4種から選べる (焼うどんなど)、野菜たっぷりのカレーうどん、白玉。

cultural_comfort.note: Sightseeing-route café.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated December 2025 and May 2026.

kyoto_kyo_yakuzen_natsume.gf_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists gluten-free options, but the courses include xiaolongbao and noodles to finish, and lunch is ramen and rice bowls (2025–2026 reviews). Say so when booking and ask which broth and dishes suit.
kyoto_kyo_yakuzen_natsume.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the hot pots come with pork, chicken, beef, seafood and fish balls, and the white broth is a rich stock (2025–2026 reviews); a lunch "yakuzen vegetable bowl" exists but no vegan information is given.
kyoto_kyo_yakuzen_natsume.hours_raw: Tabelog: Tue–Sun and days before and after public holidays — breakfast and lunch 10:00–14:30 (L.O. 14:00), dinner 17:00–22:00 (last entry 20:00; drinks L.O. 21:30; allow about 2 hours for the hot-pot course); public holidays dinner only; closed Monday. Lunch bookings are for courses only. Afternoon tea is served next door at the sister sweets shop "Kyogateau the Marie", by reservation (weekdays 14:00–16:00, weekends and holidays 12:00–16:00). 26 seats; a private room for 2 (¥500 per person, tax incl.); private hire up to 20. Non-smoking. Cards, IC cards and QR codes. Only cake may be brought in for birthdays. At the end of a narrow alley on Fuyacho-dori north of Nijo, opposite the bakery Un Son Doux; 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae.
kyoto_kyo_yakuzen_natsume.notes: [Yakuzen hot pot · Fuyacho-Nijo, Kyoto-style medicinal hot pot] A pretty alley machiya serving Chinese-style "body-friendly" hot pot: pick mushroom, fiery mala or creamy white broth and cook mushrooms, greens and meats, with herbal drinks. Lunch clay-pot ramen from ¥1,000; dinner courses about ¥8,000. The mala is very spicy — staff will make a mild pot. Tabelog lists gluten-free options. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Run by 株式会社雲濤, registered at this address (NTA invoice registry, T4130001073359), together with the sweets shop "Kyogateau the Marie" next door (Tabelog; March 2026 review). The concept is "MADE IN KYOTO Kyo Yakuzen Hot Pot" (2025–2026 reviews). Reviewers praise kind staff who warn about spice and prepared a non-spicy soup on request (November 2026); the 2nd floor has a red room and a pink private room (April 2025). The listing calls this "our Kyoto location", but no other branch is named.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Body-friendly Kyo Yakuzen" with seasonal Kyoto ingredients (September 2025 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Medicinal hot pot; yakuzen afternoon tea.

anecdotes.text: September 2025: "You can choose from three types of medicinal soups: a detoxifying mushroom broth, a fragrant mala broth with a vibrant aroma, and a rich white soup… The mala soup looked spicy, but it was about 15 times spicier than it appeared."
November 2026: "When the staff learned that we couldn't eat spicy food, they kindly informed us… For the hot pot, they prepared a non-spicy herbal soup just for us."
June 2026: "At just JPY 1000, this lunch offers exceptional value!"

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京薬膳なつめ、薬膳・火鍋・中華粥、中京区麩屋町通二条上ル布袋屋町520-3、京都市役所前から徒歩5分、火〜日・祝日の前日・祝日の翌日10:00〜14:30 (L.O.14:00)・17:00〜22:00 (最終入店20:00)、祝日は夜のみ、月曜休み、昼の予約はコースのみ、隣の「Kyogateau the Marie」でアフタヌーンティー (予約制)、26席、2名の個室 (1人500円)、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR可、グルテンフリーメニューあり、登録番号T4130001073359 (国税庁の公表サイトで株式会社雲濤、同住所)。口コミ (2025年4月〜2026年11月、英語): 京都の食材と20種以上の中国の薬膳スパイスの火鍋、きのこ・麻辣・白湯の3種のスープ、コース7,800円 (飲み放題付き)・8,800円、小籠包、杏仁豆腐、昼は土鍋の薬膳ラーメン1,000円・つくね丼1,300円、薬膳アフタヌーンティー7,000円、辛さに配慮してくれるスタッフ。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff explain broths and adjust spice; order tea by smartphone or staff.

staff_allergy_handling: November 2026 review: staff prepared a non-spicy soup and flagged spicy dishes on request.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated 2025 to November 2026.

kyoto_sorekara.gf_detail: Ask. Mostly coffee and tea; the sweets are pound cake, cookies and wagashi (2013–2025 reviews), and no gluten information is given.
kyoto_sorekara.vegan_detail: Ask. Black coffee, tea and herbal tea are available; the cakes and cookies are not described.
kyoto_sorekara.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Fri, Sat, Sun 11:30–19:30 (L.O. 19:00); closed Tuesday to Thursday; hours may change. No credit cards (PayPay accepted in 2020). Shoes off, slippers inside. A large table and a small table for two by a tiny garden. The owner prefers few guests and declines TV and magazine features (2014, 2020 reviews). At the end of a narrow alley off Teramachi-dori, a few doors from Ippodo; look for the small "Sorekara" sign.
kyoto_sorekara.notes: [Antique café · Teramachi, a hidden salon of old porcelain] Down a narrow alley off Teramachi, take off your shoes and sit among Edo-era Imari, Meiji furniture and a tiny garden while the owner brews coffee into Old Noritake cups. Drinks ¥500, cake or wagashi sets about ¥1,000. Quiet and personal — the owner keeps it low-key. Open Fri–Mon only.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers from 2014 to 2025 describe a stylish, friendly gentleman who runs the café alone among antiques for sale — Imari porcelain, Meiji furniture, Old Noritake — with a gallery said to be upstairs (April 2014). He limits guests each day and declines TV and magazine coverage, though he allowed a 2015 reviewer to post on Tabelog.
chef_bio.philosophy: To welcome just a few guests a day and let them relax (2014 and 2020 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Coffee and tea among antiques; wagashi sets.

anecdotes.text: April 2014: "After changing into slippers and stepping inside, you enter a small space filled with Edo-era Imari porcelain, Meiji furniture, and Old Noritake… The master, who runs the café solo, is kind and approachable."
July 2020: "They reportedly decline all TV and magazine coverage to maintain this style… They want to welcome just a few select groups of guests each day."
November 2025: "It seems the gentleman owner runs the place by himself, allowing for a peaceful moment."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: それから、喫茶店、中京区常盤木町46-2、京都市役所前から435m、月・金・土・日11:30〜19:30 (L.O.19:00)、火〜木休み、カード不可。口コミ (2012年10月〜2025年11月、英語): 寺町通の細い路地の奥の骨董と喫茶の店、靴を脱いでスリッパで、江戸の伊万里や明治の家具、オールドノリタケのカップ、小さな坪庭、男性の店主がひとりで営む、コーヒー・紅茶500円、ケーキセット1,000円、週末は「Jukou」の生菓子のセット1,100円、平日はクッキーのセット、テレビや雑誌の取材は断っている、PayPay可 (2020年)。

cultural_comfort.note: Quiet, small and personal; shoes off; cash or PayPay.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated August and November 2025.

kyoto_rengetsu_jaya.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the tofu courses include nama-fu (wheat gluten) and yudofu with a soy-based sauce, plus a tofu gratin (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_rengetsu_jaya.vegan_detail: Not vegan as served: the course starts with crab-miso tofu and includes a tofu gratin (December 2025); no vegan option is mentioned.
kyoto_rengetsu_jaya.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Thu–Sun and public holidays 11:00–14:30 (last entry 13:30) and 17:00–21:00 (last entry 19:30); closed Tuesday and Wednesday; closes when sold out; New Year hours vary. Courses only in the evening (February 2026). Reservations taken — cancellation fees: on the day 100% of the meal; for 7 or more, 50% from two days before. No room or service charge, even in a private room (「なし（個室でお取りした場合でも別途部屋料、サービス料等はいただきません）」, Tabelog Japanese original). 40 seats; private rooms for 3–20. Non-smoking. Cards, IC cards and QR codes. On Jingu-michi north of Chion-in, opposite Shoren-in; 5 min from Higashiyama Station.
kyoto_rengetsu_jaya.notes: [Tofu kaiseki · Chion-in, yudofu courses in private rooms] A gracious old tofu house opposite Shoren-in: ten-odd tofu dishes — Takigawa tofu, fresh yuba, nama-fu dengaku, a tofu gratin and the yudofu itself — often served in a private room at no extra charge. Lunch from about ¥3,740, dinner courses about ¥4,700–5,000. Closed Tue and Wed.

chef_bio.background: A December 2025 reviewer chose it as a restaurant with over 100 years of history; reviewers (2025–2026) praise elegant, friendly staff and value for a private room in this location. A July 2026 diner describes an impressive entrance with noren and warm light across from Shoren-in.

anecdotes.text: December 2025: "The yudofu course included 11 dishes for JPY 4,700 (drinks not included)… The nama-fu (fresh wheat gluten), yuba (tofu skin), and tofu gratin were exceptional."
July 2026: "The tofu gratin was particularly memorable. The creamy tofu paired beautifully with the savory baked crust."
March 2026: "We relaxed in a private room and enjoyed a tofu course with 10 dishes for JPY 3750."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 蓮月茶や、豆腐料理・日本料理、東山区神宮道知恩院北入ル、東山駅1番出口から徒歩5分、月・木〜日・祝日11:00〜14:30 (最終入店13:30)・17:00〜21:00 (最終入店19:30)、火・水休み、売り切れ次第終了、予約可 (当日キャンセルは100%など)、チャージ「なし（個室でお取りした場合でも別途部屋料、サービス料等はいただきません）」、40席、個室 (3〜20名)、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR可。口コミ (2023年12月〜2026年9月、英語): 100年以上の歴史 (2025年12月)、湯豆腐のコース、昼3,520円→3,740円 (2026年1月)、11品4,700円、かに味噌豆腐、Takigawa豆腐のごまだれ、生湯葉、生麩田楽、豆腐グラタン、湯葉巻きの炊き合わせ、ひじきご飯、桜餅、抹茶焼酎、夜はコースのみ、個室でも追加料金なし、Shoren-inの向かい。

cultural_comfort.note: Set courses only; private rooms at no extra charge; strict same-day cancellation fee.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated December 2025 to September 2026.

kyoto_stars_sake_salon.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: spring rolls, a white-sauce gratin, soy-seasoned kinpira and other small dishes (2024–2025 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_stars_sake_salon.vegan_detail: Not vegan: braised pork belly, shrimp, squid, Biwa trout and a seafood gratin (2024–2025 reviews); no vegan information.
kyoto_stars_sake_salon.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Wed, Fri–Sun 15:00–21:00; closed Thursday; hours may change. Reservations by phone only; the counter fills up (February 2026). Prices are not on the menu, but reviewers find them reasonable (2024). Non-smoking. Cards, e-money and PayPay. Counter and tables in a former tempura shop with a small garden, tucked into the back of a residential building on Nijo-dori west of Takakura, 4 min from Karasuma Oike.
kyoto_stars_sake_salon.notes: [Sake bar · Nijo-Takakura, an afternoon sake salon] A calm, spacious hideaway behind a residential building, open from 3 pm, where the owner pours classic and rare sake and sends out beautiful small dishes — smoked burdock kinpira, pork belly, gratin. No prices on the menu but fair. About ¥3,000–10,000. Book by phone. Closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a cheerful woman who runs the bar, mostly by herself with occasional part-time help (December 2024; February–March 2026). An August 2025 regular heard she worked in Ginza for many years; a December 2025 reviewer says she has long experience in the Kanto food business. The bar took over a former tempura shop (August 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Sake pairing; Japanese and Western small plates.

anecdotes.text: November 2024: "My initial thought: 'Well, it's just kinpira.' After trying it: 'Wow, this is amazing!!!' Later on: 'What a perfect pairing with the sake!'"
August 2025: "This restaurant took over a former tempura shop, and the comfortable counter seating makes for a luxurious experience while chatting with the owner."
July 2024: "I felt a bit nervous because I didn't know the prices. It was a calm and soothing atmosphere."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: STARS SAKE SALON (stars' sakesalon)、日本酒バー、中京区二条通高倉西入ル松屋町55-1、烏丸御池から362m、月〜水・金〜日15:00〜21:00、木曜休み、電話予約のみ、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・PayPay可。口コミ (2024年7月〜2026年4月、英語): 住宅の建物の奥、もとは天ぷら屋、小さな庭、明るい女性の店主がほぼひとりで営む (アルバイトがいることも)、銀座で長く働いた (2025年8月)、燻製ごぼうのきんぴら、豚の角煮、えびとアボカドの春巻き、ビワマス、ポテトサラダ、Nanaoのいか、グラタン、白ごま豆腐、春野菜の白和え、珍しい日本酒や京都の酒、サングリア900円、自家製きんかんソーダ、メニューに値段がない。

cultural_comfort.note: Book by phone; no prices on the menu; owner helps choose sake.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated 2025 to April 2026.

kyoto_kyo_yakiniku_kikyo.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: yakiniku with a house dipping sauce, cold noodles, bibimbap with gochujang, katsu (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_kyo_yakiniku_kikyo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: wagyu, yukhoe, clam sundubu, meat daily specials (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_kyo_yakiniku_kikyo.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu–Sat 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00) and 17:30–23:00 (last order 22:00); Sunday and holidays 17:30–23:00; closed Wednesday (moved to the 28th when the 29th is a Wednesday) (Tabelog). Lunch is served upstairs on the second floor and ordered by QR code; busy at noon (September 2024, June and September 2026). 「サ-ビス料、チャ－ジ料なし」 — no service or cover charge (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay or d Barai (Tabelog), but a September 2026 regular says cards are not taken at lunch. 70 seats, with private space (Tabelog). In the 文椿ビルヂング on Sanjo west of Karasuma (Tabelog; September 2024).
kyoto_kyo_yakiniku_kikyo.notes: [Yakiniku · Sanjo-Karasuma] A long-running Kyoto-style yakiniku in the 文椿ビルヂング at Sanjo-Karasuma: good-value weekday lunches upstairs — a ¥900 daily special, wagyu tataki rice bowls, chewy cold noodles with mini bibimbap — and yakiniku, yukhoe and sundubu at night. Closed Wednesday. Bring cash for lunch.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a yakiniku restaurant opened 20 July 2008 in the 文椿ビルヂング at Sanjo-Karasuma.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto-style yakiniku with a house sauce; cold noodles.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 regular on a sixth visit found the daily special with coffee still came to ¥1,000 — rare value for the area — though cards are not taken at lunch.
A June 2026 late-lunch diner ordered by phone upstairs and chose the ¥1,200 special cold noodles with bibimbap, mistaking the gochujang for a pickled plum.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼肉・居酒屋、中京区三条烏丸西入ル御倉町79 文椿ビルヂング 1F-2F、月火木金土11:30〜14:30 (L.O.14:00)・17:30〜23:00 (L.O.22:00)、日・祝日17:30〜23:00、水曜休み (29日が水曜なら28日休み)、サ-ビス料・チャ－ジ料なし、カード・PayPay・d払い可、70席、2008年7月20日オープン。口コミ (2024年9月〜2026年10月、英語): 昼は2階でQRコードで注文、日替わり900円 (コーヒー付き1,000円)、和牛のたたき丼、特製冷麺とミニビビンバ1,200円、夏のトマト冷麺、昼はカード不可との声、夜はユッケ、大根おろしとねぎを巻いた肉、あさりのスンドゥブ、特製のたれ。

cultural_comfort.note: For lunch go up to the second floor and order by QR code; bring cash. No English evidence found.

kyoto_grill_aoi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: fried shrimp, cutlets, cream croquettes, fried oysters, hamburg steak (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_grill_aoi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a yoshoku menu of meat, seafood and fried dishes (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_grill_aoi.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu–Sat 11:30–14:00 and 17:30–20:00; Sunday 17:00–21:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Charges: 「なし」 (none) (Tabelog). Tabelog lists cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), but a November 2025 diner was told cash only — bring cash. 30 seats: a counter with a table behind (Tabelog; October 2026); banquets for 2–25. Will adjust a combination on request (October 2026). On Muromachi-dori just north of Matsubara (April 2026).
kyoto_grill_aoi.notes: [Yoshoku · Muromachi-Matsubara] An old-style yoshoku on Muromachi just above Matsubara, once on Michelin’s Bib Gourmand list: generous combination plates of hamburg steak, head-on fried shrimp, cutlets and cream croquettes with salad and rice, and a ¥3,000 dinner mini course. Closed Wednesday; Sunday dinner only. Bring cash.

chef_bio.background: Per reviews: a long-established yoshoku restaurant on Muromachi-dori, popular when the area was full of kimono shops, keeping its original flavours (April 2026); formerly a Michelin Bib Gourmand pick (November 2026).

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 diner on a trip home singled out the large head-on fried shrimp, prepared so the whole head can be eaten safely.
An October 2026 walk-in wanted hamburg steak and fried shrimp with no matching set; the kitchen made the combination to order, even adjusting the number of shrimp.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 洋食・ステーキ、下京区室町通松原上ル高辻町607-2 関ビル1F、月火木金土11:30〜14:00・17:30〜20:00、日17:00〜21:00、水曜休み、チャージ「なし」、カード可、30席 (宴会2〜25名)。口コミ (2025年7月〜2026年11月、英語): 日替わりの盛り合わせ (海老フライ、ヒレカツ、ハンバーグ) 1,490円、ハンバーグと海老フライ2本と鮭フライ1,595円、頭付きの大きな海老フライ、クリームコロッケ、ローストビーフ、トンテキ、ビーフステーキ、ミニコース3,000円 (コーンスープ、サラダ、アイス、コーヒー)、カキフライ、2025年11月は現金のみとの声、注文に合わせて組み合わせてくれる、以前ミシュランのビブグルマン、呉服の店が多かった頃からの店。

kyoto_muromachi_oendan.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: karaage, tempura, okonomiyaki, motsu nabe with noodles (2023–26 reviews).
kyoto_muromachi_oendan.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fried chicken, sashimi, seafood bowls, motsu nabe (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_muromachi_oendan.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 11:30–13:30 and 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); closed Sunday and holidays (Tabelog). Lunch fills the moment noon arrives — come before 12:00 (April and May 2026). Shoes off; sunken-kotatsu seating and private rooms (January and July 2026). A smoking area (April and October 2026); Tabelog lists smoking allowed. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). 70 seats (Tabelog). Basement of KB Annex Building on Sanjo east of Muromachi (Tabelog).
kyoto_muromachi_oendan.notes: [Izakaya · Sanjo-Muromachi] A basement izakaya with sunken-kotatsu private rooms near Karasuma Oike: hearty, good-value lunch sets of big karaage, sashimi or seafood bowls that fill the room at noon, and all-you-can-drink courses ending in motsu nabe at night. Shoes off; smoking area. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews: an izakaya in the basement of the KB Annex Building near Sanjo-Muromachi, popular with office workers at lunch and for group dinners.
chef_bio.specialty: Karaage set lunch; motsu nabe course.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 regular arrived before noon for once and watched the room fill the instant 12:00 struck, over a ¥1,500 set of sashimi and two large karaage.
A July 2026 couple, scouting the room for an August banquet, had a sunken-kotatsu private room for just the two and a cheerful welcome from the manager.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・海鮮、中京区三条通室町東入ル御倉町64 KBアネックスビル B1F、月〜土11:30〜13:30・17:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、日・祝日休み、カード可、70席 (掘りごたつ)、喫煙可。口コミ (2025年9月〜2026年10月、英語): 昼の男の唐揚げ定食 (ハーフもあり)、刺身と唐揚げ2個の欲張り定食1,500円、海鮮丼、正午に満席、靴を脱いで掘りごたつ、個室、喫煙所あり、夜は飲み放題のコース、しめはもつ鍋に麺かご飯、2杯ずつで一人約3,100円。

cultural_comfort.note: Arrive before noon for lunch; shoes go in a shoe box. There is a smoking area. No English evidence found.

kyoto_new_omon.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: yakisoba, pork buns, sauced horumon and stir-fries from the teppan (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_new_omon.vegan_detail: Not vegan: horumon, lamb, chicken, steak and pork dishes (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_new_omon.hours_raw: Open only one or two weekdays a week, announced on Instagram at the start of the week; 17:00 to about 19:00, last order 18:30 (Tabelog; April 2025, February 2026). The owner has another job (February 2026). No set menu — the owner cooks what the day brings, shared around the teppan; portions shrink as more people come, so it stays cheap (June 2025). 「チャージ料理なし」 as written on Tabelog. Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 15 places: five standing at the teppan, a bench table and a small raised tatami room (Tabelog; February 2026). In a former greengrocer’s on Niomon-dori, about ten minutes from Sanjo Keihan (February 2026).
kyoto_new_omon.notes: [Teppan horumon · Niomon-dori] A legendary part-time teppan spot in an old greengrocer’s on Niomon-dori: one or two evenings a week, announced on Instagram, the owner grills horumon with sansho, lamb, steak and yakisoba for whoever is standing round the hotplate, shared out among everyone. 17:00 to about 19:00; cash only.

roles: Owner (named in a February 2026 review as Maeda), who cooks alone and has another job
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews: a teppan izakaya opened 17 July 2020 in a retro wooden former greengrocer’s on Niomon-dori, its name taken from the street (February 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per reviews: no fixed menu — the owner cooks dishes the owner finds delicious and everyone shares (April 2024, April 2025).

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 first-timer sat at a table without knowing the regulars stand round the teppan — next time, the plan is to claim a spot at the hotplate.
A July 2025 visitor ended up chatting with the next table and sharing three bottles of wine before the 90 minutes were up.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ホルモン・焼肉・焼きそば、左京区和国町370、17:00〜18:30 (L.O.)、不定休 (現在は週1回ほど営業)、チャージ料理なし (原文のまま)、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、15席 (立ち飲み5、ベンチテーブル3、小上がり7)、2020年7月17日オープン。口コミ (2025年4月〜2026年2月、英語): 営業日は週1〜2日、インスタグラムで告知、店主は別の仕事もある、メニューは決まっておらず鉄板で店主が作る料理をみんなで分ける、人が増えると一人の量が減るので安い、山椒とにんにくのホルモン炒め、ステーキ、ラムと野菜の炒め物、大葉と山椒の焼きそば、香港の細麺の焼きそば、大晦日のラム串700円、角煮まん700円、元八百屋の木造の建物、仁王門通、京阪三条から徒歩約10分。

cultural_comfort.note: Check Instagram for the day; arrive at 17:00 and stand at the teppan. Bring cash. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing (open about once a week); reviews dated through February 2026.

kyoto_nakasei_nikuzuki.gf_detail: Ask. The lunch is aged beef simmered sukiyaki-style (soy-based) on rice (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_nakasei_nikuzuki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an aged-beef restaurant run by a butcher (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_nakasei_nikuzuki.hours_raw: Mon, Thu–Sun 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:00) and 18:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:00); closed Tuesdays and Wednesdays; Monday holidays open, closed the next day (Tabelog). Dinner by reservation only, at least two days ahead (Tabelog). Without a booking, lunch is the aged-beef set only; the hamburg steak needs a reservation (October 2025 and May 2026 reviews). Cards and QR; no e-money (Tabelog). 24 seats: 20 at tables and 4 at the counter; non-smoking (Tabelog). On the Shirakawa near Ipponbashi, 7 min from Higashiyama Stn exit 2 through Furukawa-cho arcade (Tabelog; October 2025 review).
kyoto_nakasei_nikuzuki.notes: [Aged beef · Shirakawa] The restaurant of Kyoto aged-meat butcher 京都中勢以, beside the Shirakawa: a ¥1,450 sukiyaki-style aged Tajima beef lunch with onsen egg, and steak and hamburg dinners by reservation. Run by a warm couple.

chef_bio.background: The restaurant of 京都中勢以, a butcher that buys whole Tajima beef and ages it (December 2024 and August 2025 reviews). A couple runs the room and explains each dish (November 2025 and August 2026 reviews). A diner first came over a decade ago, when the lunch menu was wider (October 2025 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Bring out the full potential of the meat through ageing (August 2025 review).

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 guest was shown three ways to eat the beef — over rice, with black pepper, then with the sauce poured on — and the owner quietly suggested a better seat once the table behind had left.
A September 2025 diner, greeted by two smiling staff, watched the Shirakawa flow past and gave it five stars.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京都中勢以の店 (Nikuzuki)、洋食・ステーキ、東山区、地下鉄東山駅2番出口から商店街を通って徒歩7分、月・木〜日 11:30〜15:00 (L.O. 14:00)・18:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:00)、火・水曜休み、夜は予約制、カード・QR 可、電子マネー不可、24席、禁煙。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 精肉店の京都中勢以の店、但馬牛の熟成肉、すき焼き風の熟成肉の御膳1,300円と温玉 (+150円)、白川沿い、夫婦で営む (2025年11月、2026年8月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Popular with visitors; dishes explained (2025 reviews).

existence.note: Tabelog listing and own site; reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_kacchan_magari_shokudo.gf_detail: Ask. Soy-simmered chashu with a seasoning of fried onion and tempura bits (May 2026 review).
kyoto_kacchan_magari_shokudo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork chashu and egg (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kacchan_magari_shokudo.hours_raw: Lunch only; hours and days are not given on Tabelog (2026 reviews describe weekday lunches). A daytime pop-up in Bar Hit Point, which is a bar at night (April, May and October 2026 reviews). Order and pay at the counter (July 2026 review). 4th floor of the Bain Oak Aiina building, by elevator at the back; only an easel sign on the street; west of City Hall on Oshikoji (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_kacchan_magari_shokudo.notes: [Shokudo · City Hall] A lunch-only pop-up in a 4th-floor bar behind City Hall serving one thing well: tender belly and shoulder chashu with a fried egg over rice, ¥1,000 with free extra rice.

chef_bio.background: A lunch pop-up (magari shokudo, "borrowed-room diner") in Bar Hit Point, a bar at night (2026 reviews).

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner, unsure at the "Bar Hit Point" sign by the lift, opened the door to a warm welcome.
A June 2026 regular back on chashu after starting cholesterol medication found the pickled ginger balanced the rich belly.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: かっちゃんの間借り食堂、食堂、中京区橘町612 バインオークAiina 4F、京都市役所前駅から276m。口コミ (2026年、英語): 昼だけの間借り、夜は Bar Hit Point、豚バラと肩ロースのチャーシューと目玉焼きの定食1,000円、ご飯大盛り無料、チャーシュー倍の大盛り、揚げ玉ねぎと揚げ玉の自家製スパイス、マヨネーズ。

cultural_comfort.note: Hard to find: 4th floor by the back elevator (2026 reviews).

kyoto_kaisen_sumiyaki_nagi.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi and charcoal-grilled fish and meat may suit; fried dishes are on the menu (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_kaisen_sumiyaki_nagi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood and charcoal-grill izakaya (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_kaisen_sumiyaki_nagi.hours_raw: Mon–Thu, Sun, holidays and the day after 17:00–23:30 (food L.O. 22:30, drinks 23:00); Fri, Sat and the day before a holiday 17:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:00); irregular closures (Tabelog). Ordering by smartphone (QR or LINE) (November 2025 and April 2026 reviews). Cards and QR; no e-money (Tabelog). 50 seats: counter, tatami and sunken-kotatsu rooms; heated tobacco only in a smoking area (Tabelog). Tucked down an alley west of Karasuma-Bukkoji, 2–3 min from Shijo (Tabelog; May 2026 review).
kyoto_kaisen_sumiyaki_nagi.notes: [Seafood izakaya · Shijo-Karasuma] A lively alley izakaya, open since January 2025, with thick-cut sashimi of fish from ports around Japan, charcoal-grilled fish and yakitori, sunken-kotatsu rooms for groups and smartphone ordering. About ¥4,000–5,000.

chef_bio.background: Opened 25 January 2025 (Tabelog). The chef cuts sashimi at the counter and chats with guests (May and July 2026 reviews).

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 trio shared a seven-kind sashimi platter, and the staff added a third chicken wing to a two-piece order.
A May 2026 counter guest watched the sashimi being cut and rated the chutoro best.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 海鮮と炭焼 凪、居酒屋・魚介料理、下京区烏丸通仏光寺西入ル釘隠町232、地下鉄四条駅から2〜3分、月〜木・日・祝日・祝日の翌日 17:00〜23:30、金・土・祝日の前日 17:00〜24:00、不定休、カード・QR 可、電子マネー不可、50席、掘りごたつ、加熱式たばこのみ喫煙所、2025年1月25日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 各地の港の新鮮な刺身、魚と焼き鳥の炭火焼き、スマホで注文、路地の隠れ家。

cultural_comfort.note: Smartphone ordering (2025–26 reviews).

kyoto_kyosakaba_mitoki.gf_detail: Ask. Obanzai are simmered in dashi and soy; nama-fu (wheat gluten) dengaku is on the menu (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_kyosakaba_mitoki.vegan_detail: Ask. Vegetable obanzai such as fried aubergine in broth, simmered potatoes, dried radish, lotus root and thick fried tofu (March 2026), but dashi is likely.
kyoto_kyosakaba_mitoki.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–01:00 (food L.O. 24:00, drinks 00:30); open year-round (Tabelog). Cover ¥324 (Tabelog Japanese original 「お付き出し：324円」). Phone bookings from 15:00 (Tabelog). Tablet ordering (2025–26 reviews). Cards; no e-money (Tabelog). 31 seats: 6 at the counter, sunken-kotatsu and tatami private rooms and a loft; smoking allowed (Tabelog). Down a stone-paved stair to the basement of the Kawamoto building on Muromachi-Ayanokoji, 2 min from Shijo (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_kyosakaba_mitoki.notes: [Obanzai & sake · Shijo-Karasuma] A long-running basement sake bar reached by a lit stone stair, with homey Kyoto obanzai, creative dishes, private rooms and late hours to 1 am. About ¥4,000–6,000; smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Opened 19 June 2007 (Tabelog). The shop's site links a sister shop (own site).

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 diner, dining with a colleague from years abroad, said no money buys Kyoto obanzai overseas.
A June 2026 guest in a mezzanine private room found the tobiko sushi heaped higher than the tablet photo, served with pickled gourd.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: みとき、居酒屋・日本料理、下京区、室町綾小路、カワモトビル B1F、阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄四条駅から徒歩2分、毎日 17:00〜翌1:00、年中無休、お付き出し324円、カード可、電子マネー不可、31席、個室あり、喫煙可、2007年6月19日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): おばんざいの盛り合わせ、なすの揚げびたし、小芋の煮物、切り干し大根、生麩の田楽、鯛のあら炊き、日本酒、タブレットで注文。

cultural_comfort.note: Tablet ordering; smoking allowed (Tabelog).

existence.note: Tabelog listing and own site; reviews dated through July 2026.

kyoto_nijo_kuriya.gf_detail: Ask. Duck tataki, pickles and omelette may suit, but bruschetta, pasta and braised dishes likely involve wheat (2024–2026 reviews). No gluten information.
kyoto_nijo_kuriya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: meat stews, duck, prosciutto and cheese (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_nijo_kuriya.hours_raw: Wednesday–Monday 18:00–22:30 (last order 22:00); closed Tuesday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations advised — walk-ins have been turned away, and Fridays and Saturdays fill up (October 2024; January 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Counter and tables in a renovated machiya; shoes off at the door (Tabelog; April 2024). Private hire for up to 20 (Tabelog). Between Karasuma-Oike and Marutamachi, about 5 min walk.
kyoto_nijo_kuriya.notes: [Wine bistro · Ainomachi-Nijo] A quiet, shoes-off machiya bistro where a former hotel chef cooks alone: assorted stews, red-wine beef, duck tataki and a perfect omelette, with wine picked to your taste. Book, especially at weekends. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: a wine-dining bistro in a renovated townhouse, run single-handed by an owner who used to cook in a hotel (February 2026), quiet and attentive; regulars kept it going through the pandemic, the owner told a September 2024 guest.

anecdotes.text: A September 2024 regular heard from the owner how loyal customers supported the restaurant through the pandemic.
An October 2024 diner turned away once without a booking came back with a reservation for unpretentious, focused cooking.
A January 2026 diner found the omelette so good it needed no ketchup.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ダイニングバー・イタリアン・フレンチ、中京区間之町二条下ル鍵屋町459-2、烏丸御池から337m、水〜月 18:00〜22:30 (L.O.22:00)、火曜休み、予約可、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX・Diners) 可、電子マネー・QR 不可、カウンター、貸切20名まで、公式サイトあり。口コミ (2022年12月〜2026年2月、英語): 町家を改装したワインダイニング、靴を脱いで上がる、元ホテルの料理人の店主が一人で、煮込みの盛り合わせ、牛肉とじゃがいもの赤ワイン煮、生ハムとクリームチーズのブルスケッタ、鴨のたたき、ピクルス、オムレツ、好みのワインを選んでくれる、予約がないと入れないことも、金・土は混む。

cultural_comfort.note: Shoes off; book ahead; one chef.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through February 2026.

kyoto_min_yoshinagacho.gf_detail: Not GF: gyoza, ramen, yakisoba, fried sets and soy-based sauces (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_min_yoshinagacho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Chinese diner dishes and yakiniku (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_min_yoshinagacho.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 11:00–14:00 and 18:00–22:00; holidays 18:00–22:00; closed Sunday; hours may change (Tabelog). Lunch orders stop before 14:00 (July 2025). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 20 seats incl. a counter; non-smoking (Tabelog; May 2026). At the end of a narrow alley in a residential maze off Nijo-dori; no parking (November 2024; July 2025). About 8 min walk from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn.
kyoto_min_yoshinagacho.notes: [Chinese diner and yakiniku · Kawabata-Nijo east, cash only] A hidden local favourite at the end of an alley: lightly seasoned ramen-and-fried-rice sets, gyoza and tenshin-han at lunch, and Korean yakiniku with kimchi at night, all at old prices. Busy at opening. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: a small, long-loved local restaurant hidden down a narrow alley off Nijo-dori, serving Chinese diner food and Korean barbecue, cheap and lightly seasoned, filling up soon after opening (2024–2026 reviews).

anecdotes.text: An April 2025 visitor following an alley off Nijo-dori was half in disbelief that a restaurant could be there.
A regular since August 2025, on a fifth visit in October 2026, moved on from lunchtime ramen to the recommended yakiniku.
A June 2026 diner arriving at opening watched the seats fill within minutes, then had tenshin-han, gyoza, fried rice and yakisoba.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 中華料理・焼肉・食堂、左京区吉永町275、神宮丸太町駅から506m、月〜土 11:00〜14:00、18:00〜22:00、祝日 18:00〜22:00、日曜休み、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、20席、禁煙。口コミ (2024年11月〜2026年10月、英語): 二条通から路地の奥、住宅街の迷路のような場所、昼は醤油ラーメンと炒飯と餃子のセット、天津飯と餃子、麻婆麺、豚の天ぷらの定食800円、Fu Rong Bai の A セットや揚げ物2種の B セット、餃子300円、炒飯、焼きそば、野菜炒め、夜は韓国の焼肉 (タンなど) とキムチの盛り合わせ、やさしい味、開店直後から満席。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; hard to find down an alley; busy at opening.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_kokodosu_gojozaka.gf_detail: Not GF: tea soba, soba and udon in soy-dashi tsuyu (2020–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kokodosu_gojozaka.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi broths and meat udon; kinako shiratama is a possible sweet — ask (2020–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kokodosu_gojozaka.hours_raw: Tabelog lists no hours, so none are shown; reviewers describe lunchtime and early-evening visits (February 2022; August 2026). Cards (JCB, AMEX) and QR (Tabelog). Discounts for school-trip students (April 2026). On the Gojozaka approach, a little below Kiyomizu-dera (May 2025; August 2026).
kyoto_kokodosu_gojozaka.notes: [Tea soba and udon · Gojozaka] A friendly, good-value stop on the walk up to Kiyomizu-dera: fragrant matcha tea soba, meat or curry udon with kayaku rice, and kinako shiratama to finish. Kind staff; school-trip discounts.

chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: a casual noodle and sweets café on the Gojozaka approach, with notably kind, chatty staff — a manager and an elderly gentleman at the counter (February and August 2024) — and good prices for a tourist area (2020–2026 reviews).

anecdotes.text: A February 2024 visitor on a busy holiday weekend enjoyed a long chat with the friendly manager over meat udon.
An April 2026 diner who dislikes shiitake was won over by the well-seasoned mushroom on the udon, and noted the school-trip discount.
An August 2026 family ate tea soba before walking up to Kiyomizu-dera for street snacks.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 甘味処、東山区五条橋東6-583-33、清水五条から1,030m、営業時間の記載なし、カード (JCB・AMEX)・QR 可。口コミ (2020年11月〜2026年8月、英語): 清水寺の近く、茶そば (冷・温、やや甘いつけ汁としいたけ)、ざるそば、肉うどん850円、カレーうどん、冷やし肉うどん、かやくご飯、きなこ白玉、親切なスタッフ、修学旅行生の割引 (2026年4月)、手ごろ。

cultural_comfort.note: Casual; cards (JCB, AMEX) and QR.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through August 2026.

kyoto_yonaki_marufuku.gf_detail: Not GF: wheat noodles in soy and dashi broths (2026 reviews).
kyoto_yonaki_marufuku.vegan_detail: Not vegan: duck and shrimp broths (2026 reviews).
kyoto_yonaki_marufuku.hours_raw: Thursday–Tuesday and holidays 22:00–2:00; closed Wednesday; other closing days not fixed — check the website or call; closes early when sold out (Tabelog; August 2026). No reservations; queues on weekends (Tabelog; August–September 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, UnionPay) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 20 seats: 12 at the counter, 8 at tables; non-smoking (Tabelog). The night-time ramen counter of the Tempura Marufuku space in the Marufuku hotel building, once Nintendo’s headquarters (1930); the entrance is at the back (September–October 2026). 6 min walk from Keihan Shichijo Stn.
kyoto_yonaki_marufuku.notes: [Late-night ramen · Shomen-Kamogawa, 22:00–2:00] After the tempura service ends, this refined counter in Nintendo’s 1930 former headquarters, now a hotel, serves night ramen — duck nanban chuka soba and a rich shrimp tantanmen — until 2 a.m. or sell-out. Queues at weekends. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: a hotel restaurant in the historic Marufuku building — completed in 1930 as Nintendo’s headquarters and now a hotel — where the Tempura Marufuku counter reopens at night as a ramen shop (September–October 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Duck nanban chuka soba; shrimp tantanmen.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 pair, too early after takoyaki, waited for the 10 p.m. opening and took a taxi from Kyoto Station.
An August 2026 diner arriving at opening found it already busy and heard it closes when the soup runs out.
A September 2026 guest savoured the duck nanban soba in a space that keeps the feel of Nintendo’s old headquarters.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ラーメン、下京区正面通加茂川西入鍵屋町342、京阪七条駅から徒歩6分、木〜火・祝日 22:00〜26:00、水曜休み、不定休 (サイトか電話で確認)、予約不可、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX・銀聯)・PayPay 可、電子マネー不可、20席 (カウンター12、テーブル8)、禁煙、ホテルのレストラン、公式サイトあり。口コミ (2026年8〜10月、英語): 夜は天ぷらの店がラーメン屋に、旧任天堂本社 (1930年) の建物のホテル、入口は裏手、鴨南蛮中華そば1,200円 (鴨の出汁、鴨チャーシュー、白ねぎ、水菜、長崎の Goto Seimen の細麺)、海老担々麺1,200円、売り切れ次第終了、週末は行列。

cultural_comfort.note: From 22:00 until sold out; queue at weekends; entrance at the back.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_poquito_kawaramachi.gf_detail: Ask. Spanish small plates, ham, carpaccio, ajillo, pizza, pasta and fried fish from a blackboard menu; no gluten information is published (reviews).
kyoto_poquito_kawaramachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Spanish dishes of ham, seafood and meat (reviews).
kyoto_poquito_kawaramachi.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 (last food order 22:00, drinks 22:30) Monday, Tuesday and Thursday–Saturday; 17:00–22:00 Sunday (last food order 21:00); closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations by phone; same-day bookings sometimes possible (Tabelog; July 2025). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and QR payments; no e-money (Tabelog). 30 seats: 15 at the counter and 15 at tables, with a private room; non-smoking (Tabelog). Ground floor on Kawaramachi north of Sanjo, 5 minutes from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae (Tabelog). Opened 17 July 2005 (Tabelog).
kyoto_poquito_kawaramachi.notes: [Spanish bar · Kawaramachi north of Sanjo, since 2005] A lively Spanish bar, one of Kyoto’s first, with a counter and a blackboard crowded with the day’s dishes — Iberico bellota, hotaru-ika ajillo, sea-urchin pasta, truffle carbonara. Book by phone; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened in July 2005 (Tabelog); an October 2025 reviewer calls it a pioneering Spanish bar in Kyoto. Reviewers (2024–2026) describe friendly staff and a long blackboard of seasonal specials.

anecdotes.text: An August 2025 guest returned after ten years and started with a well-chilled Heineken on a hot Saturday.
A July 2025 same-day booking ran through Iberico bellota, hamo gazpacho and sole in brown butter, with no room left for the truffle carbonara.
A May 2026 regular and spouse came for sea-urchin pasta heaped with karasumi.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ポキート、スペイン料理・バル・ワインバー、京都市中京区河原町通三条上ル下丸屋町401-10 田中ビル1F、月・火・木〜土 17:00〜23:00 (料理L.O.22:00、ドリンクL.O.22:30)、日 17:00〜22:00 (料理L.O.21:00)、水曜定休、予約は電話で、カード・QR決済可、電子マネー不可、30席 (カウンター15、テーブル15)、個室あり、禁煙、2005年7月17日オープン。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 京都のスペインバルの草分け、黒板にその日のおすすめ、イベリコ・ベジョータ、鱧のガスパチョ、さんまクリームのコカ、舌平目の焦がしバター、タコの春巻き、トリュフのカルボナーラ、ポキートサラダ、カルパッチョ、鴨とフォアグラのテリーヌ、ほたるいかのアヒージョ、雲丹とからすみのパスタ、ピザ、ハイボールのウイスキーも豊富、気さくなスタッフ。

cultural_comfort.note: Book by phone; busy counter.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through May 2026.

kyoto_misokaan_kawamichiya.gf_detail: Not GF: soba noodles (often with wheat), tempura and soy-based dashi; no 100% buckwheat option is described (reviews).
kyoto_misokaan_kawamichiya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: soba in bonito dashi, duck, herring and chicken dishes (reviews).
kyoto_misokaan_kawamichiya.hours_raw: 11:00–16:00 (last order 15:30); closed Wednesday and Thursday, plus occasional days on a monthly schedule (Tabelog). No seat reservations; the signature hot pot (Hokorō) is booked by phone or email up to two days ahead, for 11:00–13:00 or 13:30–15:30 (Tabelog; May 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 28 table seats, including sofa tables; a waiting area inside; a garden at the back; non-smoking (Tabelog; June and August 2026). On Anekoji west of Fuyacho, near Kyoto City Hall (Tabelog). Reopened here on 19 October 2025 after the Edo-period soba house moved (Tabelog; March 2026).
kyoto_misokaan_kawamichiya.notes: [Soba · Anekoji-Fuyacho, an Edo-period soba house reborn] The venerable Kawamichiya soba house, reopened at a new address in October 2025 with old fittings and a garden: duck nanban, herring soba, chilled sudachi soba, and its famous chimney hot pot by reservation. Lunch only; closed Wednesday and Thursday.

chef_bio.background: A Kyoto soba house dating from the Edo period that relocated and renovated, reopening here in October 2025 (Tabelog; March and August 2026 reviews). An August 2026 reviewer notes that the new shop keeps much of the old atmosphere, with old fixtures, a garden at the back and an open kitchen.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto soba; the Hokorō hot pot.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 regular returned after the renovation for duck seiro soba with bamboo shoots, and missed the old room a little.
A May 2026 group had the chimney-centred Hokorō hot pot of yuba, shinjo and Kyoto vegetables, by reservation.
An August 2026 visitor bought the soba tea as a souvenir after herring soba and ginger rice.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 晦庵河道屋、そば、京都市中京区姉小路通麩屋町西入姉大東町556-1、月・火・金〜日・祝日 11:00〜16:00 (L.O.15:30)、水・木定休、月ごとに臨時休業あり、席の予約不可、名物の鍋は2日前までに電話かメールで予約 (11:00〜13:00、13:30〜15:30)、カード可、電子マネー・QR決済不可、28席 (テーブルのみ)、禁煙、2025年10月19日オープン。口コミ (2026年、英語): 江戸時代からの老舗のそば屋が移転、鴨南蛮そば1,600円、季節のご飯350円、鴨せいろ、すだちそば1,600円、にしんそば、生姜ご飯、茶そば、鶏の山椒焼き、天ぷらのセット、中央に煙突のある名物の鍋 (湯葉、しんじょ、ひろうす、鶏、九条ねぎ、椎茸、京野菜)、そば茶を土産に、奥に庭、古い調度、オープンキッチン、ソファのテーブル、店内に待合。

cultural_comfort.note: No seat reservations; hot pot booked 2 days ahead.

existence.note: Tabelog listing (reopened 19 October 2025); reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_wakasa_and_co_lounge.gf_detail: Ask. Afternoon-tea sweets and savouries, bagel sandwiches and cocktails; a rice-flour scone appeared on one tea set (September 2025), but no gluten information is published.
kyoto_wakasa_and_co_lounge.vegan_detail: Ask. Blueberry drinks, smoothies and gin cocktails; the afternoon tea and sandwiches use dairy and meat (reviews).
kyoto_wakasa_and_co_lounge.hours_raw: 10:00–20:00 daily: afternoon tea 10:00–17:00 (90 minutes, reservation), tea lounge 11:00–16:00, bar 12:00–20:00 (Tabelog). Afternoon tea books up days ahead; the bar takes walk-ins (2025 reviews). Order from a menu or QR code; pay at the register (March 2025). Cards and e-money; no service or table charge (Tabelog). 23 seats: 17 at the counter, 4 at tables and 3 on sofas; non-smoking (Tabelog). Second floor of the WAKASA & Co. building of 株式会社わかさ生活 on Karasuma just east of Shijo — a café downstairs, a shrine to eye health on the fifth floor (Tabelog; September 2025). Opened 20 March 2025 (Tabelog).
kyoto_wakasa_and_co_lounge.notes: [Café & bar · Shijo-Karasuma, blueberry afternoon tea] The lounge of a Kyoto blueberry-supplement company’s playful headquarters building: seasonal blueberry afternoon teas (about ¥5,000, book ahead), a cute Buruburu-kun lunch set, and blueberry-gin cocktails at the bar until 8 pm. No charge.

chef_bio.background: Opened in March 2025 (Tabelog) in the WAKASA & Co. building of 株式会社わかさ生活, the Kyoto maker of blueberry supplements, registered at the same address (NTA invoice register; 2025 reviews). The building also holds a ground-floor café, a forest-bathing room and a small shrine to eye health (September 2025).

anecdotes.text: A March 2025 pre-opening visitor tried the bar, ordering from a QR code and paying at the register.
A July 2025 guest found the afternoon tea fully booked three days ahead and settled for a blueberry smoothie.
A September 2025 visitor had a blueberry mojito, then climbed to the fifth-floor shrine to pray for good eyesight.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: WAKASA & CO. LOUNGE、バー・スイーツ、京都市下京区長刀鉾町22 三光ビル2F、毎日 10:00〜20:00、アフタヌーンティー 10:00〜17:00 (90分制)、ティーラウンジ 11:00〜16:00、バー 12:00〜20:00、カード・電子マネー可、サービス料・チャージなし、23席 (カウンター17、テーブル4、ソファ3)、禁煙、2025年3月20日オープン、インボイス T6130001019343 (株式会社わかさ生活)。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): わかさ生活のブルーベリー専門店、昼は予約制のブルーベリーのアフタヌーンティー、夜はバー、QRコードで注文してレジで会計、栗とブルーベリーのアフタヌーンティー5,000円 (米粉のスコーン)、シャインマスカット、ブルブルくんセット (生ハムとクリームチーズのベーグルサンド、サラダ、ブルーベリーティー)、ブルーベリースムージー、京都のブルーベリーのジン「Berry & Berry」のモヒート、1階はカフェ、5階に目の神社、北欧の森林浴の部屋。

cultural_comfort.note: QR-code ordering; book afternoon tea ahead.

existence.note: Tabelog listing (opened 20 March 2025); reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_ryukyu_shokudo_kukuru.gf_detail: Ask. Okinawa soba is a wheat noodle; seasonings for the champuru, rafute and jushi rice are not described, and no gluten information is published (reviews).
kyoto_ryukyu_shokudo_kukuru.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Okinawa soba topped with rafute (braised pork) and pork dishes such as champuru (reviews).
kyoto_ryukyu_shokudo_kukuru.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:15) Monday–Friday; dinner 18:00–23:00 (last food order 22:00, drinks 22:30) Tuesday–Saturday; holidays 12:00–21:00; closed Sunday (Tabelog). Lunch fills up — book ahead (2026 reviews). ¥300 charge at dinner only (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX) and e-money (Tabelog). 30 seats at the counter and tables; non-smoking, ashtray outside (Tabelog). A small shop in a lane opposite Daimaru’s Higashinotoin entrance, 3 minutes from Hankyu Karasuma Exit 18 (official site; Tabelog; June 2026). Opened 28 November 2023 (Tabelog).
kyoto_ryukyu_shokudo_kukuru.notes: [Okinawan · Higashinotoin by Daimaru, Okinawa soba lunches] A small, lively Okinawan diner in a lane by Daimaru: ¥1,000 lunch sets of Okinawa soba with rafute, goya champuru or yushi-tofu soba with jushi rice, and an Okinawan izakaya at night. Book lunch; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Opened in November 2023 (Tabelog) as an izakaya specialising in Okinawan home cooking, opposite Daimaru’s Higashinotoin entrance (official site). Reviewers (2026) describe a bustling room with friendly staff and an Okinawan feel.
chef_bio.philosophy: The real taste of Okinawan home cooking, with a strong line-up of drinks (official site).

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 sixth-time regular finally ordered the last untried lunch, yushi-tofu soba.
A June 2026 first-timer watched the World Cup on the big TV over an Okinawa soba set.
A July 2026 diner nursed a hangover with the gentle soba broth and rafute.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 琉球食堂 KUKURU、沖縄の郷土料理に特化した居酒屋、本場の味、お酒にも力、阪急烏丸駅から徒歩約3分、京都大丸の東洞院口前。食べログ: 琉球食堂 KUKURU 烏丸店、沖縄料理・居酒屋・食堂、京都市中京区東洞院錦小路下ル阪東屋町662-6、月 11:30〜14:30 (L.O.14:15)、火〜金 11:30〜14:30・18:00〜23:00 (料理L.O.22:00、ドリンクL.O.22:30)、土 18:00〜23:00、祝日 12:00〜21:00、日曜定休、ディナーのみチャージ300円、カード・電子マネー可、30席、禁煙 (店外に灰皿)、2023年11月28日オープン。口コミ (2026年、英語): 沖縄そばとじゅーしーのセット1,000円、ラフテー、ゴーヤーチャンプルーのセットに小さな沖縄そば、ゆし豆腐そば、タコライス、日替わり900円、白米かじゅーしーを選べる、昆布の出汁、紅しょうが、ランチは予約がおすすめ、にぎやかで気さくなスタッフ。

cultural_comfort.note: Book lunch ahead; ¥300 charge at dinner.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through July 2026.

kyoto_zucchero.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: pasta, lasagna, ravioli, gnocchi, cutlets and three homemade breads (2024–2026 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_zucchero.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood-led Italian menu with burrata, prosciutto, sea urchin, eel and beef (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_zucchero.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Thu–Sun 18:00–23:00; closed Tuesday and Wednesday; hours may change. An August 2024 reviewer said lunch had started — check. Reservations taken. Mostly à la carte with a long menu and daily specials; half portions on request; courses on request. About 20 seats, counter and tables. Non-smoking. Cards; no e-money or QR codes. On the 2nd floor of the Nishimoto building on Nijo-dori west of Takakura — look for the small sign on the ground floor; there is a lift. 6 min from Karasuma Oike exit 1.
kyoto_zucchero.notes: [Italian · Nijo-Takakura, a fishmonger family's à la carte Italian] A casual 2nd-floor Italian with a huge menu: build a plate of seafood appetizers, then uni risotto, ravioli or eel, with three homemade breads and natural wines by the glass. Half portions on request. About ¥10,000–15,000 with wine. Can be slow. Closed Tue and Wed.

chef_bio.background: Opened around January 2024 (an April 2024 reviewer: "open for about three months"). That reviewer writes the chef came from the Kyoto restaurant "Orto" after working at "Gion Sasaki" and "Rakumi"; a January 2025 diner credits his Japanese-cuisine experience for a rice-flour-battered sweet potato. August and December 2025 reviewers say the owner's family runs a fish shop, hence the fish. A July 2026 reviewer calls it listed in the Michelin Guide.
chef_bio.specialty: Seafood à la carte; uni risotto; homemade breads.

anecdotes.text: December 2025: "Since the owner's family runs a fish shop, there are plenty of fish dishes available. The quality of the fish is outstanding, and each plate is generously portioned."
August 2024: "The portions are quite large… When I mentioned this to the chef, he said they can serve half sizes! Just let them know!"
June 2026: "The uni risotto was a luxurious dish, generously filled with uni (though it was a bit on the salty side)."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: Zucchero、イタリアン、中京区二条通高倉西入松屋町55-1 西本ビル2F、烏丸御池1番出口から徒歩6分、月・木〜日18:00〜23:00、火・水休み、予約可、禁煙、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可。口コミ (2024年1月〜2026年10月、英語): 2024年初めに開店、料理人はOrto出身で、Gion SasakiとRakumiでも働いた (2024年4月)、店主の家は魚屋、アラカルト中心で品数が多い、ハーフサイズ可、前菜の盛り合わせ、うにのリゾット、真鯛のラビオリ、鮎、Amakusaの鰻、ほうじ茶のパン、フォカッチャ、自然派ワイン、ミシュランガイド掲載との声 (2026年7月)、提供がゆっくり、リゾットが塩辛いとの声 (2026年6月)、2024年8月には昼営業も始めたとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff help build an appetizer plate; half portions on request.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated 2025 to October 2026.

kyoto_nota_rokkaku.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the dorayaki are pancake layers of wheat batter (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_nota_rokkaku.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the dorayaki are served with cream, and the pancakes are egg-based (2025–2026 reviews); drinks include matcha and hojicha.
kyoto_nota_rokkaku.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Fri 12:00–17:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–18:00; open every day; hours may change. No reservations; queues at weekends. Food must be ordered — no drinks-only (April 2026). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR codes. Counter on the 1st floor, tables upstairs. One person may be serving at weekends; a September 2026 diner waited over 30 minutes. In the converted storehouse of the Kubo residence, a registered cultural property, down an alley off Rokkaku-dori west of Shinmachi; 5 min from Karasuma, Shijo or Karasuma Oike.
kyoto_nota_rokkaku.notes: [Dorayaki café · Rokkaku-Shinmachi, griddle dorayaki in an old storehouse] Down an alley in the storehouse of a registered cultural-property house: warm, copper-griddled dorayaki stacked like pancakes with bean paste, cream and black syrup, plus matcha or hojicha. Sets about ¥1,450–2,050. Cash only; expect a wait at weekends. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: A May 2025 reviewer reported the original owner — who served pancake-style dorayaki with Japanese black teas — was closing on 31 May 2025. By 2026 it had reopened under a new operator with the same copper-griddled dorayaki but matcha and hojicha in place of the black teas (April 2026), and reviewers say it serves the hanawarabi of 麓寿庵, the café in the main house of the same residence (kyoto_rokujuan in this guide); one May 2026 guest was sent here when 麓寿庵 was full.

anecdotes.text: April 2026: "This cafe has been taken over from the previous owner, and while the Japanese black tea is no longer available, they still offer dorayaki cooked on a copper plate, along with matcha or hojicha!"
May 2026: "These pancakes are a fun twist with four layers of dorayaki! They are filled with sweet red bean paste!"
September 2026: "I waited over 30 minutes for my order without any updates… However, the food was indeed delicious."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: nota、カフェ、中京区六角通新町西入西六角町101、烏丸・四条・烏丸御池から徒歩5分、月〜金12:00〜17:00、土日・祝日11:00〜18:00、年中無休、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、禁煙。口コミ (2024年4月〜2026年10月、英語): 登録有形文化財のKubo家住宅の蔵を改装、銅板で焼くパンケーキ風のどら焼き (4枚重ね、あんこ、クリーム、黒蜜、ナッツ、ベリー)、プレーン・ほうじ茶セット1,450円、抹茶どら焼き・ほうじ茶セット1,650円、季節の桜どら焼き・抹茶セット2,050円、前の店主は2025年5月31日で閉店、その後新しい運営で再開 (和紅茶はなくなった)、麓寿庵の花わらびも、飲み物だけの注文は不可、週末はひとりで対応し30分以上待つことも (2026年9月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; no drinks-only orders; long waits possible at weekends.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reopened under new management, with reviews dated March to October 2026.

kyoto_shokudo_ebisu.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: set meals with fried shrimp and fish, miso soup and soy-simmered dishes, and Chinese noodles at night (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_shokudo_ebisu.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fishmonger's diner — sashimi, grilled and simmered fish, fried shrimp, pork and beef (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_shokudo_ebisu.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Fri 11:00–14:00 and 17:30–21:00; Sat 11:00–14:00; closed Sunday and public holidays; hours may change. Lunch is a single daily set by weekday, served without ordering (Friday: fried shrimp). Evening set meals plus a long handwritten menu. Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR codes. 17 seats: 12 at tables, 5 at the counter; water is self-service. Non-smoking. Styrofoam fish boxes may be stacked at the door. On Ebisugawa-dori west of Teramachi, 6 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae.
kyoto_shokudo_ebisu.notes: [Fish diner · Ebisugawa-Teramachi, a fishmonger family's shokudo] A no-frills 17-seat diner where the fish comes straight from the family business: one ¥880 lunch set a day, evening sets from ¥1,300, and a handwritten menu of sashimi, simmered fish and surprises with beer. Cash only. Closed Sun and holidays; Saturday lunch only.

chef_bio.background: A May 2024 reviewer describes a relaxed, warm place run by siblings, with a daily handwritten menu by the owner; May 2026 reviewers say it is run by a fishmonger and sources from markets and producers. Regulars fill it at lunch; one June 2026 first-timer felt brushed off at the till compared with regulars.
chef_bio.specialty: Daily fish set meals; sashimi platters.

anecdotes.text: May 2024: "The atmosphere, run by siblings, is pleasantly relaxed and warm… Here, ordering the sashimi platter is a must."
October 2026: "They were surprised to see a set meal available at night, especially for just JPY 1300, which includes sashimi and simmered fish!"
May 2026: "For lunch, they only offer a daily special, with a fixed menu for each day of the week… I was amazed by the price—just JPY 880 in this day and age!"

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 食堂ゑびす、海鮮・日本料理、中京区夷川通寺町西入丸屋町695、京都市役所前から徒歩6分、月〜金11:00〜14:00・17:30〜21:00、土11:00〜14:00、日・祝日休み、予約可、17席 (テーブル12・カウンター5)、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR不可。口コミ (2023年1月〜2026年10月、英語): きょうだいで営む (2024年5月)、魚屋が営む食堂、昼は曜日ごとの日替わり定食のみ880円 (金曜はえびフライ)、夜は定食1,300円・2,000円と手書きの品書き、刺身の盛り合わせ、黒酢の酢豚、ほたるいかのしょうゆ漬け、ホワイトアスパラと牛肉、大きなえびフライ、締めの中華そば、熊のすね肉のぽん酢、オムライス、海鮮丼、常連が多い、会計時の対応が素っ気なかったとの声 (2026年6月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Regulars' diner; fixed lunch set; cash only.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated 2025 to October 2026.

kyoto_shokudo_ebisu.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260202/26029008/ (35.014892, 135.766792) offset about 2m south to (35.014874, 135.766792): kyoto_furlan_ebisugawa (丸屋町693, next door) was 4.7m away, now 6.3m clear; GSI lot 京都府京都市中京区丸屋町695番地 about 8m away; 2026-11-08

kyoto_lab_igarashi.gf_detail: Ask when booking. There is no fixed menu: the chef builds each course around the day's ingredients and your preferences, and calls once about the course when you book; sauces are made from scratch. Courses reviewed came with baguette for the sauce (2026 reviews).
kyoto_lab_igarashi.vegan_detail: Ask when booking. Courses are tailored to each guest and use organic vegetables, but the reviewed menus centre on meat, game and fish (2026 reviews); no vegan information.
kyoto_lab_igarashi.hours_raw: Tabelog: Tue–Sun 18:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); closed Monday. Reservations taken; the restaurant calls once to discuss the course; may turn guests away when full, as one chef cooks and serves (June 2026). Short course ¥4,500; omakase from ¥6,000, with game such as venison, wild boar or pigeon when available; à la carte possible; call ahead for specific dishes. 10 seats, counter and tables; private hire up to 20. Non-smoking. Cards, IC cards and QR codes. Opened May 2026. 6 min from Hankyu Karasuma.
kyoto_lab_igarashi.notes: [French · Shijo-Karasuma, a one-chef tasting "lab"] A friendly new 10-seat counter where the chef works alone and plans your course on the phone: from-scratch sauces, organic vegetables and, from ¥6,000, game or milk-fed beef carved in front of you. Short course ¥4,500. Book ahead. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Opened in May 2026 (August 2026 review: "SINCE 2026. Newly opened in May"). Reviewers describe an owner-chef who runs the restaurant single-handed, explains each dish across the counter and enjoys talking with guests (June–October 2026). No source links it to other restaurants named Igarashi.
chef_bio.philosophy: Creating "new encounters" for guests with a course made for each of them (August 2026 review).

anecdotes.text: July 2026: "If you choose a course over JPY 6,000, you can enjoy fresh game such as venison, wild boar, and pigeon, sourced that day… if you call in advance, they will do their best to accommodate requests like 'I'd like to have pâté.'"
June 2026: "Since it's a one-person operation with both table and counter seating, they sometimes have to turn away customers if they are fully booked."
August 2026: "The appetizer was surprisingly corn ice cream, which was unexpectedly delicious."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: Lab.Igarashi、フレンチ、中京区古西町441 シーフレックス錦ビル1F、阪急烏丸駅から徒歩6分、火〜日18:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:00)、月曜休み、予約可 (コースについて一度電話あり)、10席、貸切20名まで、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR可。口コミ (2026年6〜10月、英語): 2026年5月開店、店主の料理人がひとりで営む、決まったメニューはなくその日の食材と好みと予算でコースを組む、ショートコース4,500円、6,000円からのおまかせにジビエ (鹿・猪・鳩)、あんこう、ミルクフェッドの牛肉、ソースも手作り、有機野菜、とうもろこしのアイス、マッシュルームのソースとバゲット。

cultural_comfort.note: Chef explains each dish and plans the course with you; one-person kitchen.

staff_allergy_handling: The restaurant phones once after booking to plan the course around preferences (Tabelog remarks; 2026 reviews).

existence.note: Tabelog listing (opened May 2026) with reviews dated June to October 2026.

kyoto_magokoro_nishinotoin.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi, ponzu dishes, dashi-based plates, tempura, dashimaki and rice bowls; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_magokoro_nishinotoin.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sashimi, sea bream, sanma, pork, jidori and dashi throughout (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_magokoro_nishinotoin.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday lunch 11:30–14:00 (last orders 13:30), dinner 17:30–22:00 (last orders 21:30); closed Sunday, sometimes open on Sundays before public holidays — check Instagram or Google (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 17 seats: 7 at the counter and tables for 4 and 6 (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). In a renovated 70-year-old machiya with a high beamed ceiling (February and November 2025). Just south of Nishinotoin-Takoyakushi; 4 min from the Shijo-Nishinotoin bus stop (Tabelog; February 2025). Open since 6 April 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_magokoro_nishinotoin.notes: [Kyoto izakaya · Nishinotoin, machiya] A warm little izakaya in a 70-year-old townhouse with a high beamed ceiling, from an owner trained in long-established Kyoto izakayas: excellent sashimi, kumoko ponzu, a huge dashimaki and seasonal plates at night, and good-value set lunches like grilled sanma or a seafood bowl. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: A February 2025 reviewer describes a kind owner with experience in long-established Kyoto izakayas. Open since April 2024 (Tabelog). No operator was found.

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 diner came in on the night of a big cold snap and found the old townhouse instantly warm, with genmaicha served in a painted teapot.
A March 2026 couple, struggling to book anywhere on a Saturday, got a same-day table and were surprised by the size of the dashimaki.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 創作京料理 誠ごころ、居酒屋、中京区古西町431-1、月〜土 11:30〜14:00 (L.O. 13:30)・17:30〜22:00 (L.O. 21:30)、日曜定休 (祝日前の日曜は営業することも)、2024年4月6日オープン、カード・電子マネー・QR可、17席 (カウンター7席、4名と6名のテーブル)、禁煙。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 西洞院蛸薬師下ル、築70年の町家、吹き抜けの梁、店主は京都の老舗居酒屋で経験、おまかせの刺身盛り合わせ1,500〜2,200円、地鶏のはりはり鍋1,300円、くもこポン酢、ぐじのかぶら蒸し、天ぷら、九条ねぎのだし巻き、昼の定食 (ポークステーキ、秋刀魚、海鮮丼2,200円)、鯛の炙りポン酢990円、ごぼうのカリカリサラダ880円、だし巻き830円。

cultural_comfort.note: Warm small counter; same-day bookings sometimes possible.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated January 2025 to May 2026.

kyoto_yakiniku_kappou_amano.gf_detail: Ask. Wagyu grilled with salt or sauce, sashimi and yukhoe, kimchi, tongue stew, and a choice of ramen, reimen, curry or bibimbap to finish; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_yakiniku_kappou_amano.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu yakiniku and meat-kaiseki restaurant (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_yakiniku_kappou_amano.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 daily incl. public holidays (food last orders 22:00) (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog, original なし; the English line says otherwise). No same-day cancellations, please (Tabelog). Cards, IC and e-money, QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 34 seats: a counter and private rooms for 2–20 on two floors (Tabelog; April and September 2025). Smoking room (Tabelog). In a Kyoto townhouse, 5 min from Shijo station exit 6 (Tabelog; July 2025).
kyoto_yakiniku_kappou_amano.notes: [Yakiniku kappo · Nishinotoin-Takatsuji, machiya] A polished yakiniku-kappo in a Kyoto townhouse: black-wagyu courses of 12 or 15 dishes (from ¥10,000) grilled over charcoal at the counter, or à la carte yukhoe, lean cuts and offal in private rooms. Pricey; good for occasions and business dinners. Flagged: operator 株式会社天樹, other shops not found.

chef_bio.background: The receipt invoice number on Tabelog belongs to 株式会社天樹 (Nagaokakyo). A December 2025 reviewer praises the chef’s personality and presentation. No other shop of the company was found.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 host chose the “Goku” course in a soundproofed second-floor private room for business, though found one piece of each cut a little light for men.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼肉割烹 天の、焼肉・肉料理・日本料理、下京区西洞院通高辻下る高辻西洞院町805-5、地下鉄四条駅6番出口から徒歩5分、毎日 17:00〜23:00 (料理L.O. 22:00)、サービス料なし、当日キャンセルはご遠慮ください、カード・交通系IC・電子マネー・QR (Alipay、WeChat Pay含む) 可、34席、個室 (2〜20名)、喫煙室あり。適格請求書: 株式会社天樹 (長岡京市)。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 町家、カウンター限定の会席コース (12品 10,000円、特選15品)、刺身、塩焼き、たれ焼き、旬の野菜、タンシチュー、締めはラーメン・冷麺・カレー・ビビンバから、特選会席15,000円 (個室)、2階の防音の個室、生肉、赤身、ホルモン、ユッケ。

cultural_comfort.note: Private rooms; Alipay and WeChat Pay accepted.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated January 2025 to June 2026.

kyoto_cafe_celeste_gojo.gf_detail: Ask. Tiramisu, Basque and matcha rare cheesecakes, Mont Blanc, shortcake and ohagi; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_cafe_celeste_gojo.vegan_detail: Ask. Black coffee and some wagashi may suit, but nothing is described as vegan; most cakes use cream and cheese (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_cafe_celeste_gojo.hours_raw: Wednesday–Sunday and public holidays 8:30–18:00; closed Monday and Tuesday; temporary changes posted on Instagram and Google Maps (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog, original なし). Cards: JCB (Tabelog). 12 seats: 4 at the counter, two benches for two, two terrace tables for two (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Takeaway cakes (October 2025). Opened 6 April 2025 (February 2026).
kyoto_cafe_celeste_gojo.notes: [Café · Gojo, cakes and drip coffee] A bright, compact café with cat illustrations near Gojo-Karasuma, opened in 2025: hand-drip coffee, a big coffee-bean-shaped tiramisu, Basque and matcha cheesecakes, and a few wagashi like ohagi. Counter seats suit solo visits. Open from 8:30; closed Monday and Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: A June 2026 reviewer says the owner is Korean. Opened on 6 April 2025 (February 2026 review). No operator was found.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 visitor was impressed by the size of the coffee-bean-shaped tiramisu and the whole chestnuts inside the Mont Blanc.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: Cafe Celeste、カフェ、下京区藪下町6 More五条II 1F、水〜日・祝日 8:30〜18:00、月・火曜定休、臨時休業はInstagramやGoogleマップで告知、サービス料なし、カードはJCB、12席 (カウンター4、ベンチ2人掛け2、テラス2人掛け2)、禁煙。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 2025年4月6日オープン、ハンドドリップのコーヒー、チョコでコーティングしたコーヒー豆の形のティラミス700円、シチリアンコーヒー700円、バスクチーズケーキ、抹茶のレアチーズケーキ、和栗のモンブラン、おはぎ、いちじくのショートケーキの持ち帰り、柏餅、店主は韓国出身。

cultural_comfort.note: Small café; counter seats suit solo visits.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; opened April 2025; reviews dated October 2025 to June 2026.

kyoto_alpen_rose_higashiyama.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: breads, naan, yakisoba, spaghetti and chiffon cake (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_alpen_rose_higashiyama.vegan_detail: Not vegan: hamburg steak, sausages, eggs, beef stew and cream desserts (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_alpen_rose_higashiyama.hours_raw: 8:00–18:00 (last orders 17:30); closed Wednesday (Tabelog; July 2026). Cash only: no cards or e-money (Tabelog). 23 seats: 3 at the counter, 17 at tables, plus a terrace where smoking is allowed (Tabelog; September 2025). Mini breads to take away (September 2026). On the ground floor of the 滋賀県人会館 building, near Higashiyama station (Tabelog; July 2026).
kyoto_alpen_rose_higashiyama.notes: [Café · Sanjo-Jingumichi, near Heian Shrine] A calm, old-fashioned café for locals near Higashiyama station and the art museum: breakfasts of fresh mini breads from 8:00, hamburg-steak and yakisoba lunches, anmitsu and big slices of chiffon cake. Cash only; smoking on the terrace; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: No operator or owner details were found; reviewers describe a café beloved by locals with smiling staff (September 2025 and 2026).

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 visitor, after the Kyocera Museum of Art, settled in with a tea chiffon cake and coffee.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: あるぺんrose、カフェ・洋食・うどん、東山区三条通神宮道西入西町126 滋賀県人会館 1F、8:00〜18:00、水曜定休、カード・電子マネー不可、23席 (カウンター3席、テーブル17席)、禁煙 (テラスは喫煙可)。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 平安神宮・知恩院の近く、焼きたてのナンのセット、ソーセージのセット、ハンバーグのセット (スープとパンかご飯)、あんかけ焼きそば、クリームあんみつ、紅茶のシフォンケーキ、ベーグルサンドのセット、L.O. 17:30、130円からのミニパン (持ち帰り可)、焼肉やビーフシチューのスパゲッティのランチ、パン3種・スクランブルエッグ・サラダ・ドリンクの朝食が1,000円未満。

cultural_comfort.note: Local café; cash only.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated April 2025 to September 2026.

kyoto_oike_suishin_honten.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tempura, yuba spring rolls, karaage, ramen, nama-fu dengaku and soy-seasoned kamameshi (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_oike_suishin_honten.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sashimi, yakitori, seafood and hamo kamameshi, pork belly; dashi throughout (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_oike_suishin_honten.hours_raw: Mon–Sat and the day before a holiday 17:00–23:30 (last order 23:00); Sunday 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30) (Tabelog). Ordering by touch panel (January and June 2025). Kamameshi takes about 30 minutes — order early (June 2025). Cards, e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). 158 seats with sunken-kotatsu private rooms and a counter; groups and children welcome (Tabelog; June 2025). Basement of the Urbanex Oike Building, reached by the underground passage from Karasuma Oike Station (December 2025).
kyoto_oike_suishin_honten.notes: [Izakaya · Karasuma Oike] A big, family-friendly izakaya straight off the Karasuma Oike underground passage, with sunken-kotatsu private rooms and touch-panel ordering: kamameshi of seafood or hamo, sashimi, yakitori, grilled yuba and other Kyoto dishes at modest prices, plus party courses. Open every evening.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews: the main branch of 御池酔心, with a second shop in front of Kyoto Station, in the basement by Karasuma Oike Station (May 2024).

anecdotes.text: A June 2025 family of eight with two children got a sunken-kotatsu private room, let the nephews order on the touch panel, and preferred the hamo kamameshi to the seafood one.
A December 2025 visitor found it so close to the station it seemed to be inside it, reached through the underground passage.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・焼き鳥・海鮮、中京区車屋御池下ル梅屋町358 アーバネックス御池ビル B1F、月〜土・祝日の前日17:00〜23:30 (L.O.23:00)、日17:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、158席 (掘りごたつ、カウンター)。口コミ (2025年1月〜2026年7月、英語): 本店、タッチパネルで注文、海鮮釜めし968円、鱧釜めし990円 (約30分)、刺身6種1,980円、焼き鳥5本1,078円、湯葉の味噌焼き528円、京湯葉春巻き748円、とうもろこしの天ぷら495円、京都中華そば825円、生麩田楽、鯛のかぶと酒蒸し、わかさぎの天ぷら、にんにくチューハイ、飲み放題のコース、掘りごたつの個室、子ども連れも、地下道から烏丸御池駅直結。

cultural_comfort.note: Order on the touch panel; ask for kamameshi early, as it takes about 30 minutes.

kyoto_cafe_hebaragi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: gochujang-dressed bibimbap, Korean cold noodles, hot sandwiches, ginger pork in soy sauce (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_cafe_hebaragi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: ginger pork, sandwiches, breakfast sets, kimchi (2025–26 reviews); no vegan dish sourced.
kyoto_cafe_hebaragi.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun 9:30–20:00; closed Wednesday; may change (Tabelog). Breakfast sets in the morning (May 2026), lunch sets at midday, Korean dishes and beer into the evening (October 2025). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). On Sanjo-dori in front of Higashiyama Station, under a red awning (November 2017, October 2025).
kyoto_cafe_hebaragi.notes: [Korean café · Higashiyama Station] A small family café under a red awning in front of Higashiyama Station, serving Korean home cooking — bibimbap, cold noodles, ginger pork with gochujang — alongside breakfast and sandwich sets, with K-pop on the stereo. Cash only; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per reviews: a café near Higashiyama Station serving Korean dishes, run by a husband-and-wife team (May 2024, October 2025).

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 pair stopping before a concert ordered beer and kimchi and were given homemade daikon-leaf kimchi on the house, with warm smiles from the owner.
An August 2025 visitor escaping 38°C heat learned the name means sunflower in Korean — "gazing at the sun" — over a ¥500 iced coffee.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 喫茶店・カフェ、東山区分木町63、月火木金土日9:30〜20:00、水曜休み、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可。口コミ (2025年3月〜2026年5月、英語): 東山駅の前、赤いひさし、韓国の家庭料理と K-POP、店名は韓国語でひまわり、ビビンバ1,000円、豚の生姜焼き1,100円、ビールとキムチ1,000円 (大根葉の自家製キムチのサービス)、冷麺、サンドイッチとアイスティーのセット1,200円、ホットサンドの朝食Bセット、アイスコーヒー500円、夫婦で営む (2024年)。

cultural_comfort.note: Bring cash. Ask for gochujang to taste. No English evidence found.

kyoto_hosoo_lounge.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: madeleines and afternoon-tea pastries (2022–25 reviews). No gluten-free claim is sourced.
kyoto_hosoo_lounge.vegan_detail: Not vegan: macarons, chocolates, madeleines, prosciutto and cheese (2025 reviews).
kyoto_hosoo_lounge.hours_raw: Daily 10:30–18:00 (last order 17:30); closed public holidays and over the New Year (Tabelog). No reservations (February 2025). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money (Tabelog). 20 seats, including semi-private rooms (Tabelog; 2022–24 reviews). Ground floor of the HOSOO flagship building on Ryogaemachi-dori, two minutes from Karasuma Oike Station; a gallery upstairs (February 2025).
kyoto_hosoo_lounge.notes: [Tea lounge · Karasuma Oike] The quiet, gallery-like café of HOSOO, a Nishijin weaving house dating back to 1688, on the ground floor of its flagship near Karasuma Oike: tea with macarons themed on kimono colours, house chocolates and afternoon tea, served on craft tableware. No reservations; closed on holidays.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews: the café of the HOSOO flagship store, opened 2 September 2019; HOSOO is a Nishijin textile house founded in 1688 (Genroku 1) (2023 reviews).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per reviews: sweets that tell the story of Nishijin textiles and kimono colours (November 2023).

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 visitor had layered macarons named for kimono colour schemes and a yuzu chocolate with hot coffee, then looked round the second-floor gallery.
A January 2025 guest found the afternoon tea plated like a work of art, Western pastries set beside Japanese flavours.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ・バー、中京区両替町通姉小路下ル柿本町412、毎日10:30〜18:00 (L.O.17:30)、祝日・年末年始休み、カード可、電子マネー不可、20席、2019年9月2日オープン。口コミ (2025年1月〜3月、英語): 元禄元年 (1688年) 創業の西陣織の HOSOO の旗艦店の1階、アフタヌーンティー、重ねの色目のマカロン、白桃のマカロン、柚子のオリジナルチョコレート、生ハムとチーズ、持ち帰りも、予約不可、2階はギャラリー、烏丸御池駅から徒歩2分。

cultural_comfort.note: Walk in — no reservations. Allow time for the gallery upstairs. No English evidence found.

kyoto_mukadeya_honten.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: obanzai and kaiseki dishes seasoned with soy sauce and dashi, red miso soup, takikomi gohan (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_mukadeya_honten.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sashimi, grilled fish, dashi throughout (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_mukadeya_honten.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30) and dinner 18:00–21:00 (last order 20:30) (shop site; Tabelog). Tabelog lists Sunday closed; the shop site says irregular closures; closed over the New Year (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 70 seats, including private tatami rooms and a room with a Noh stage (Tabelog; 2020 review, September 2026). Outdoor smoking area (Tabelog). In a 160-year-old machiya on Shinmachi north of Nishikikoji, in the Gion Matsuri float district (shop site; 2024 reviews).
kyoto_mukadeya_honten.notes: [Obanzai kaiseki · Shinmachi] A restored 160-year-old Meiji machiya in the Gion Matsuri float district serving its own "obanzai kaiseki": tiered boxes of seasonal Kyoto dishes at lunch and vegetable-led courses at night, in rooms around a courtyard with an okudo hearth and a Noh stage. Run by the Kyoto company くろちく.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop site: a 160-year-old townhouse (「築１６０年の町家」) restored to its mid-Meiji frame (「明治中期の骨格をそのままに復元」); run by the Kyoto company くろちく, whose site lists it as its main restaurant beside 京都嵐山嵐丼, its shops and an inn.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the shop site: 「伝統的な京懐石と、…おばんざい料理を織り交ぜた、オリジナルのおばんざい懐石料理」 — traditional Kyoto kaiseki mixed with home-style obanzai.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 return visitor, after several years away, was given a private tatami room on a quiet weekday and ate a seasonal-vegetable kaiseki looking out on the garden.
An April 2026 diner enjoyed eating among the house’s collection of old furniture and keepsakes, and found the closing takikomi gohan generous.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: くろちくの飲食店舗、築160年の町家、明治中期の骨格をそのままに復元、伝統的な京懐石とおばんざい料理を織り交ぜたオリジナルのおばんざい懐石料理、昼11:30〜14:00 (L.O.13:30)、夜18:00〜21:00 (L.O.20:30)、不定休、昼は百足屋御膳、夜は新町・錦・室町のコース。食べログ: 日本料理、中京区新町通錦小路上ル百足屋町381、日曜休み、年末年始休み、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、70席、屋外に喫煙所。口コミ (2024年12月〜2026年9月、英語): 百足屋弁当3,300円 (三段の重箱、刺身、炊き合わせ、焼き魚、黒豆ご飯、赤だし、甘味)、日替わりランチ、京野菜のコース、しめの炊き込みご飯、個室の座敷、庭、おくどさん、能舞台の部屋、祇園祭の山鉾町。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead, especially in Gion Matsuri season, when the upstairs looks onto the floats. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Shop site; Tabelog reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_tsuzuri_ainomachi.gf_detail: Ask. Japanese izakaya dishes with dashi and soy; nama-fu and fried dishes are on the menu (2026 reviews).
kyoto_tsuzuri_ainomachi.vegan_detail: Ask. Morokyu, water aubergine and yuba salad (2026 reviews), but dashi is likely.
kyoto_tsuzuri_ainomachi.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:30–22:30 (L.O. 21:45); closed Sundays, holidays and some irregular days — check Google or Instagram (Tabelog). Cards (Tabelog). 30 seats: sunken kotatsu, counter and tables; groups up to 50 (Tabelog; February 2026 review). Smaller portions on request; off-menu dishes (October 2026 review). 2 min from Karasuma-Oike exit 3-2 (Tabelog).
kyoto_tsuzuri_ainomachi.notes: [Izakaya · Karasuma-Oike] A friendly neighbourhood izakaya near Karasuma-Oike, loved by regulars, with careful Kyoto dishes, a big sake and drinks list, smaller portions on request and summer hamo. About ¥4,000–8,000.

chef_bio.background: A friendly manager and attentive owner with many regulars (June and October 2026 reviews).

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 parent visiting a university-student daughter came on the daughter's recommendation and planned to return many times.
An October 2026 regular asked for smaller portions to try more dishes, and was told to ask about off-menu items.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 綴 ainomachi、日本料理・居酒屋、中京区綿屋町528 鳥丸エルビル1F、烏丸御池駅3-2出口から徒歩2分、月〜土 17:30〜22:30 (L.O. 21:45)、日曜・祝日休み、不定休あり、カード可、30席。口コミ (2026年、英語): 掘りごたつ・カウンター・テーブル、豊富な日本酒、茶碗蒸し、だし巻き、海老とセロリのサラダ、もろきゅう、水なす、鴨のつくね鍋、生麩、unagi maki、量の調整も可、常連が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Ask about off-menu dishes and portion sizes (October 2026 review).
