kyoto_hiroshima_teppan_kamu.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: Hiroshima-style okonomiyaki is layered on wheat noodles and batter (2026 reviews).
kyoto_hiroshima_teppan_kamu.vegan_detail: Not vegan: okonomiyaki with pork, egg and sauce; grilled teppan dishes (2026 reviews).
kyoto_hiroshima_teppan_kamu.hours_raw: Mon–Sat and the days around holidays 11:30–14:30 (L.O. 14:00) and 17:30–23:00 (L.O. food 22:00, drinks 22:30); holidays dinner only; closed Sundays (Tabelog). Cover: grilled vegetables ¥400 (Tabelog Japanese original 「付だし(焼き野菜)400円」). Order by QR code (August 2026 review). 66 seats: counter, sunken-kotatsu seats, private rooms facing a courtyard and a 2nd-floor tatami room for 20–30 (Tabelog; August 2026 review). On Matsubara west of Karasuma, 5 min from Gojo or Shijo (Tabelog; August 2026 review).
kyoto_hiroshima_teppan_kamu.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Karasuma-Matsubara] A long, retro teppan house south of Shijo-Karasuma for Hiroshima-style okonomiyaki on noodles from Hiroshima, grilled at the counter: a ¥1,000 lunch set with rice, teppan dishes and drinks at night, and private rooms by a courtyard.

chef_bio.background: Serves Hiroshima-style okonomiyaki and teppan dishes with noodles shipped from Hiroshima and fresh local vegetables (August 2026 review).

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 business traveller dining alone ordered the Yume-yaki with kone, mochi, pork and cheese, and liked the boiled-then-grilled noodles.
A September 2026 lunch guest found the okonomiyaki set came with rice, with a bigger portion free.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 広島鉄板 叶夢、お好み焼き・居酒屋・鉄板焼き、下京区玉津島町315、地下鉄五条駅から徒歩5分、四条駅から徒歩6分、月〜土 11:30〜14:30・17:30〜23:00、祝日は夜のみ、日曜休み、お通し (焼き野菜) 400円、66席、2階の座敷は20〜30名で貸切、中庭の見える個室。口コミ (2026年、英語): 広島風のお好み焼き、広島から取り寄せる麺、地元の野菜、昼の定食1,000円、焼きそば、鉄板のだし巻き、QR で注文。

cultural_comfort.note: QR ordering (August 2026 review).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated August–October 2026.

kyoto_yaosan_yuzu_miso.gf_detail: Ask. Yuzu miso and Kyoto white miso; the ingredients are not listed in our sources.
kyoto_yaosan_yuzu_miso.vegan_detail: Ask. Yuzu miso and white miso; the ingredients are not listed in our sources.
kyoto_yaosan_yuzu_miso.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Wed, Fri, Sat 10:00–17:00; closed Thursdays and Sundays; hours may change (Tabelog). A take-home shop selling one product, yuzu miso, in several container sizes, plus Kyoto white miso (2022–25 reviews). QR payments; no e-money (Tabelog). In a traditional machiya on Anekoji west of Higashinotoin, under a sign carved by Kitaoji Rosanjin, 1 min from Karasuma-Oike (Tabelog; rurubu; December 2025 review).
kyoto_yaosan_yuzu_miso.notes: [Yuzu miso · Karasuma-Oike] A machiya shop that has sold a single product — yuzu miso — for about 300 years, under a sign by Rosanjin, who favoured it. A take-home Kyoto classic for yudofu and grilled tofu.

chef_bio.background: Founded in the Horeki era (1751–1764), making yuzu miso the same way ever since (mapple); about 300 years of selling yuzu miso, one product passed down from parent to one child, under a sign written and carved by Rosanjin (rurubu). A May 2022 reviewer gives the founding as 1727, after a founder who traded in vegetables and dried goods trained in shojin cooking.
chef_bio.philosophy: One product only, made the same way (mapple; rurubu).

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 visitor was allowed to photograph the original Rosanjin sign inside — the one outside is a replica, another customer explained.
A November 2025 passer-by, unsure what the shop was, was walked through the product and how to eat it by the staff.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 八百三、日本料理、中京区、烏丸御池駅から徒歩1分、月・火・水・金・土 10:00〜17:00、木・日曜休み、QR 可、電子マネー不可、禁煙。マップル: 1751〜1764年から変わらぬ製法の柚子味噌の老舗。るるぶ: 約300年の老舗、看板商品ひとつを一子相伝、魯山人の自著・自刻の看板。口コミ (2022〜2025年、英語): 柚味噌だけを売る、京都の白味噌、湯豆腐に。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff explain the product (November 2025 review).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through December 2025 in the shop (a 2026 review is of a department-store purchase).

kyoto_zakoya_honten_rokkaku.gf_detail: Ask. Seafood bowls with a sauce and soy-based obanzai; kara-age and fried fish are wheat (2026 reviews).
kyoto_zakoya_honten_rokkaku.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seafood bowls and fish plates (2026 reviews).
kyoto_zakoya_honten_rokkaku.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 11:30–15:00 and 18:00–23:00; closed Sundays; hours may change (Tabelog). Lunch at the counter only; queues before opening (August and September 2026 reviews). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Private rooms (Tabelog). In a machiya off Rokkaku west of Karasuma, with no Zakoya sign at the door (Tabelog; October and November 2026 reviews).
kyoto_zakoya_honten_rokkaku.notes: [Seafood bowls · Rokkaku] The renovated and renamed 夢処 漁師めし 雑魚や in a Kyoto machiya: queue-worthy fishermen's seafood bowls with sea urchin, finished as sea-bream chazuke, and a daily eight-item fish plate at lunch; izakaya by night.

chef_bio.background: Reopened on 29 July 2026 after renovation as 雑魚や 本店, formerly 夢処 漁師めし 雑魚や, absorbing the seafood-bowl shop Dontsuki from Kiyomizu-Gojo (PR TIMES; August 2026 review). Opening date on Tabelog: 29 July 2026.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 regular, back after the renovation, was the first to get the day's fresh Hokkaido sea urchin on the bowl.
A November 2026 diner's bowl came with live shrimp that moved, after a 25-minute wait eased by obanzai.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 雑魚や 本店、魚介料理、中京区骨屋町147-3、烏丸御池駅から377m、月〜土 11:30〜15:00・18:00〜23:00、日曜休み、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、個室あり、2026年7月29日オープン。PR TIMES: 夢処 漁師めし 雑魚や が改装して雑魚や 本店に。口コミ (2026年、英語): 漁師めし (海鮮丼) 1,800円・プレミアム2,500円、Zakoya Meshi 1,200円、2,000円のセット、北海道の雲丹、鯛茶漬け、町家の店、オープン前から行列。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter lunch; queues before opening (2026 reviews).

kyoto_sunny_george.notes: [Plant-based café · Nijo] A small, busy café near City Hall, opened in late 2025 by an international couple: espresso drinks made with oat milk, warm rice-flour cinnamon rolls and cardamom buns, banana bread and plant-based sandwiches, from 8:00. chef_bio.background: Per reviews: opened 31 October 2025 by an international couple, one with about 25 years in the coffee business (September 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per reviews: an entirely plant-based food menu (January 2026).

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 regular, on an eleventh visit, found the country bread needed ordering a day ahead, and picked it up the next morning with a cardamom roll and a coffee.
A January 2026 visitor learned that the warm, chewy cinnamon roll is made with the café’s own rice-koji yeast.

kyoto_chugoku_ryori_muromachi_sanjo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: mapo tofu with meat sauce, sweet-and-sour pork, karaage, egg soup (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_chugoku_ryori_muromachi_sanjo.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–14:30 and 17:00–21:30; irregular closures (Tabelog). Lunch is busy with nearby office workers (April 2026); set meals come out fast. No cards or e-money; QR accepted (Tabelog). 45 seats, private rooms (Tabelog). Up a back staircase to the second floor of 白鳥ビル, above a curry shop, on Muromachi north of Sanjo just off Aneyakoji (April 2026).
kyoto_chugoku_ryori_muromachi_sanjo.notes: [Chinese · Muromachi-Sanjo] A no-frills second-floor Chinese restaurant run by a Chinese couple near Karasuma Oike, packed with office workers at lunch for ¥1,000 sets — mapo tofu, sweet-and-sour pork, ramen with fried rice — each with a big portion of karaage; spicy home-style dishes and Shaoxing wine at night. QR payment or cash.

roles: Run by a Chinese couple (April 2025, April 2026)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews: a Chinese restaurant opened 19 August 2011, run by a couple from China (April 2025, April 2026).

anecdotes.text: An April 2025 group ate jellyfish salad, fried shrimp and steamed white fish with Shaoxing wine for about ¥4,000 a head, finding nearly everything spicy except the tofu soup and almond jelly.
An April 2026 visitor followed office workers up a staircase that felt like a fire escape and along a narrow corridor to the dining room.

kyoto_ichimasa_shijo.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tempura, karaage, yuba spring rolls, shrimp mayo, miso dengaku and soy sauce for the sashimi (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_ichimasa_shijo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: aged-fish sashimi is the centre of the menu; pork, chicken and dairy dishes besides (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_ichimasa_shijo.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 17:00–23:00 (food last order 22:00); closed Monday (Tabelog). Reservations advised (September 2025). Courses with all-you-can-drink as well as à la carte (2026 reviews); the bill may be given as a total only (September 2025). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 48 seats: counter, tables, tatami and sunken kotatsu; only e-cigarettes at the counter (Tabelog). A renovated machiya in a back alley near Shijo and Karasuma stations (April and July 2026).
kyoto_ichimasa_shijo.notes: [Aged-fish izakaya · Shijo-Karasuma] A renovated machiya in a back alley near Shijo-Karasuma, built around fish bled and aged by the Tsukamoto method: rich, sticky aged-fish sashimi platters, then creative plates — yuba spring rolls, eggplant dengaku, shrimp mayo — with an unusual sake list. Closed Monday; book ahead.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews: an izakaya opened 17 January 2012, serving fish treated by the Tsukamoto ultimate blood-removal method and then aged (January and April 2025).

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 pair ordered the aged-sashimi omakase — mackerel, saury, sea bream, tuna, young sawara and shark — then found the rest of the menu more modern and creative than expected.
An April 2025 return visitor singled out the kinmedai and sawara in the sashimi platter, lightly seared and salted, to be eaten as served.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・海鮮・日本料理、中京区炭之座町416-1、火〜日17:00〜23:00 (料理L.O.22:00)、月曜休み、カード・PayPay 可、電子マネー不可、48席 (座敷・掘りごたつ・カウンター)、カウンターは電子たばこのみ、2012年1月17日オープン。口コミ (2025年1月〜2026年7月、英語): ツカモト式の究極の血抜きをして熟成させた魚の刺身、金目鯛や鰆の炙り、鯖、秋刀魚、鯛、まぐろ、なすの味噌田楽、湯葉の春巻き、海老マヨ、ミニ海鮮丼、豚バラと野菜のにんにく炒め780円、ベイクドポテトのチーズ焼き680円、若鶏の唐揚げ680円、季節のシャーベット380円、日本酒が豊富、飲み放題のコース、町家を改装、四条の路地。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead and ask for the aged-fish sashimi platter; ask prices if ordering omakase. No English evidence found.

kyoto_weber_kawabata_nijo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: wild boar, venison, pâté, cheese-topped vegetables (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_weber_kawabata_nijo.hours_raw: Daily 15:00–24:00 (last order 24:00); closing days vary (Tabelog). One man cooks and serves (November 2024, July 2026); fully booked by 16:00 on a weekday in August 2026 — reserve online. Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 10 seats: four at the counter, tables for two and four (Tabelog). At Kawabata-Nijo, east of the river, near the ROHM Theatre (January 2025, July 2026).
kyoto_weber_kawabata_nijo.notes: [Italian & game · Kawabata-Nijo] A ten-seat Italian bar near Kawabata-Nijo run single-handed by a friendly owner: wild-boar bolognese and hamburg, venison steak, small pizzas and seasonal salads with wine by the glass, from 15:00 until midnight. Book ahead — it fills early.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed), who runs the room alone (2024–26 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews: an Italian bar opened 10 May 2024 near Kawabata-Nijo; a March 2026 reviewer had eaten the owner’s venison and boar dishes at a previous restaurant.
chef_bio.specialty: Game meat — wild boar and venison.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 first-timer found game dishes with no gamey taste, and with the owner managing the room alone, finished three bottles of wine.
An April 2026 diner booked online for 22:00 and found the late hour a gift, with regulars around and the solo chef keeping the dishes coming at the right pace.

kyoto_crystal_kawaramachi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: lunch plates of fried mackerel, cutlets, hamburg steak with demi-glace and miso soup (2017–2026 reviews).
kyoto_crystal_kawaramachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: daily lunches of salmon, mackerel, meat tofu, hamburg steak and cutlets (2017–2026 reviews).
kyoto_crystal_kawaramachi.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Thu, Sun and public holidays 11:00–17:00; Fri–Sat 11:00–17:30; hours may change. Reservations taken. Cards; no e-money or QR codes. Parking. A Showa-era café-lounge attached to a long-established school-trip inn, with its own street entrance on Kawaramachi-dori east of Takeyamachi; box sofas and a disco ball, and the room connects to the inn lobby. Hard to spot from the street (October 2026). 6 min from Jingu-Marutamachi.
kyoto_crystal_kawaramachi.notes: [Kissaten · Kawaramachi-Takeyamachi, a Showa lounge in a school-trip inn] A time-capsule café attached to an old school-trip inn — box sofas, a disco ball, inn guests drifting in from the lobby — serving hearty ¥900 lunch plates of fish or hamburg steak with salad and miso soup. Under ¥1,000. Easy to miss from the street.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a lounge-style restaurant attached to a long-established school-trip inn, with a separate street entrance and a retro Showa interior that has not changed (2017, October 2026); a May 2017 visitor saw female staff in uniform and a bar counter, and guessed it turns into a lounge for inn guests in the evening. The inn's name is given differently by reviewers and is not confirmed here.

anecdotes.text: October 2025: "I had the daily special lunch for JPY 900, which included salmon sashimi, fried mackerel, and meat tofu, along with salad, rice, and miso soup… All of this for just JPY 900!"
October 2026: "The seating features box sofas, and a disco ball hangs from the ceiling, suggesting it might transform into a lounge at night."

kyoto_soba_shinano.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat udon, soba in soy-based broth, and tempura on most bowls (2024–2026 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_soba_shinano.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi broths, egg-topped bowls, oyakodon and shrimp tempura (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_soba_shinano.hours_raw: Tabelog: Tue–Sun 11:00–20:00; closed Monday; hours may change. No reservations; a queue can form at lunch (November 2026). Cash only. Counter seating; non-smoking; parking (the lot has moved — December 2025). Free delivery nearby in a wooden carrier (December 2025). On Nijo-dori toward Okazaki, in the Imperial Okazaki building, 491 m from Higashiyama Station.
kyoto_soba_shinano.notes: [Soba · Nijo-Okazaki, a 50-year neighbourhood noodle shop] A busy local soba-ya with a warm welcome: pale Sarashina soba or udon with freshly fried tempura (¥1,200), silky egg-drop udon (¥800) and rich egg-topped rice bowls. Cash only. Lunch queues. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: A regular writes that the shop celebrated its 50th anniversary and was refurbished (November 2026); a March 2026 visitor remembers it about 20 years ago beneath an apartment building that is now a supermarket, before it moved across the street. Reviewers praise a cheerful, kind owner and staff who greet guests loudly and give children sweets (December 2025).

anecdotes.text: December 2025: "While many people tend to order the tempura soba, I highly recommend the Kitsune Don and Abutama Don… For those living nearby, you can order delivery for free. They bring it in a traditional food carrier."
February 2026: "The Tanuki Udon featured larger pieces of deep-fried tofu… I personally think it would be better if the pieces were smaller and the sweetness toned down a bit."
November 2026: "The udon noodles were a bit softer than I expected, lacking some chewiness."

kyoto_alloro_mio.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: pici, pappardelle and other pastas, gnocchi and a crepe gratin (2024–2026 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_alloro_mio.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Tuscan meat dishes — charcuterie, venison hamburg, wild-boar and meat ragùs, tripe, pork, chicken (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_alloro_mio.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun 18:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); closed Wednesday. Reservations taken, by phone or online; often full (September 2026). Cards: AMEX only (Tabelog). No e-money. 16 seats: 10 at tables, 6 at the counter. Non-smoking. Half portions possible (October 2026). Shared dishes are plated individually for groups (2024–2025). On Kawaramachi-dori north of Takeyamachi, 7–8 min from Jingu-Marutamachi or Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae.
kyoto_alloro_mio.notes: [Tuscan Italian · Kawaramachi-Marutamachi, a 16-seat trattoria] A friendly little Tuscan place: start with the lavish appetizer plate, then thick handmade pici, wild-boar ragù or the venison hamburg steak, with carafe wine. About ¥4,000–8,000. Books up — reserve. AMEX only for cards. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers (2023–2026) describe a chef they enjoy chatting with at the counter and attentive staff who explain availability by phone. Criticisms: long gaps between dishes for a large group (May 2025), a "bit overpriced" feeling (June 2025) and an average squid gnocchi.

anecdotes.text: October 2025: "The balance of acidity, sweetness, and richness in the tomatoes was simply outstanding!… My partner was surprised by how luxurious the appetizers were, even considering the price."

May 2025: "We ordered an assorted platter of appetizers, four types of pasta, and a risotto to share, and to our surprise, each dish was served individually!… the intervals between the dishes were a bit long."
September 2026: "The mussels were incredibly plump and fluffy—I've never had such delicious mussels before."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: アッローロ ミオ、イタリアン・ハンバーグ・パスタ、中京区河原町通竹屋町上る大文字町242-4、京都市役所前から徒歩8分、月・火・木〜日18:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:00)、水曜休み、予約可、16席 (テーブル10・カウンター6)、禁煙、カードはAMEXのみ、電子マネー不可、ワインにこだわる。口コミ (2023年3月〜2026年10月、英語): トスカーナ料理、前菜の盛り合わせ (1人ずつ盛り付け)、鹿肉のハンバーグ、豚ほほ肉のラグーのピチ、トスカーナのミートソースのパッパルデッレ、猪のラグー、トリッパ、ポルチーニのオムレツ、Awa-odoriの鶏のリゾット、ムール貝、鮎のスパゲッティ、アールグレイのパンナコッタ、ハーフサイズ可、料理の間隔が長いとの声 (2025年5月)、少し高いとの声 (2025年6月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Small trattoria; book ahead; AMEX is the only card listed.

kyoto_maruni_cafe.gf_detail: Ask. Summer kakigori is shaved ice with homemade fruit syrups, shiratama and ice cream, but toppings such as rare-cheese sauce and Earl Grey jelly are not described; the autumn–winter taiyaki are wheat batter (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_maruni_cafe.vegan_detail: Not vegan: most kakigori are milk-based (milk syrups, condensed milk, vanilla ice cream, rare-cheese sauce), and the taiyaki come with cream cheese, cream and butter (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_maruni_cafe.hours_raw: Tabelog: Tue–Sat 11:30–16:00; closed Sunday and Monday, plus irregular days. Seasonal menu: kakigori only from July to September; taiyaki desserts in autumn and winter (from October and again in February); a lunch menu at other times (September 2026). In peak summer you must sign the paper list at the door from 9:00 on the day for a time slot — people queue from 7–8 am; the 2026 sign-up period ended on 8 September. One drink per person (October 2026). Cash only. No service charge (「なし」, Tabelog Japanese original). 30 seats including a counter; non-smoking. 2nd floor of the Tsukuru building on Gojo-dori west of Shinmachi, 250 m from Gojo exit 2.
kyoto_maruni_cafe.notes: [Kakigori café · Gojo-Shinmachi, peach shaved ice and plated taiyaki] One of Kyoto's cult shaved-ice spots: fluffy kakigori piled with whole peaches, figs or Shine Muscat and homemade syrups (¥1,700–2,500), July–September only; plated taiyaki desserts in autumn and winter. In summer, sign the list at the door from 9 am. One drink each. Cash only. Closed Sun and Mon.

chef_bio.background: Regulars (2025–2026) describe calm music, pleasant service and an owner who suggests tea with the taiyaki (October 2026). In July–August it is near impossible to get in without signing up early; quieter from mid-September. One August 2026 diner found the fig milk-tea version weak, and another ran out of syrup before the ice.

anecdotes.text: August 2026: "There are no online reservations; you write your name on a reservation sheet in front of the cafe starting at 9 AM on the day of your visit. A friend of mine lined up around 7 AM and secured the first reservation slot for 2 PM."
October 2026: "This time, we have apple taiyaki… The owner mentioned that this taiyaki pairs well with tea… Please note that there is a one-drink minimum!"
August 2026: "Unfortunately, the figs were just fresh ones on top, and the royal milk tea was quite weak."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: マルニカフェ、カフェ・たい焼き・大判焼き、下京区五条通新町西入西錺屋町25 つくるビル2F、地下鉄五条駅2番出口から西へ約250m、火〜土11:30〜16:00、日・月休み、不定休、予約は当日9時から店頭で記入、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、サービス料「なし」、30席、禁煙。口コミ (2025年9月〜2026年10月、英語): かき氷は7〜9月のみ、夏は朝から店頭の用紙に記名 (2026年は9月8日まで)、桃ミルクバニラ2,200円、いちじくロイヤルミルクティー2,000円、シャインマスカットバニラ2,500円、宇治抹茶1,700円、マンゴー、いちご、秋冬はりんごやさつまいもとクリームチーズのたい焼きの皿、ワンドリンク制、現金のみ、いちじくのミルクティーは味が薄いとの声 (2026年8月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Summer: sign the list at the door from 9 am; one drink each; cash only.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_gojo_coffee_factory.gf_detail: Not GF for food: toast, sandwiches, taiyaki, French toast and gâteau; coffee itself is fine (2022–2025 reviews).
kyoto_gojo_coffee_factory.vegan_detail: Ask. Black coffee is plant-based; food includes egg, cheese and meat; no plant milk mentioned (2022–2025 reviews).
kyoto_gojo_coffee_factory.hours_raw: Thursday–Tuesday 9:00–18:00; closed Wednesday; hours may change (Tabelog). Order and pay at the counter by the entrance first, then sit (October 2024; May 2025). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). No cards or e-money; QR accepted (Tabelog). Non-smoking; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). A coffee roaster on site (June 2024). Just off Higashioji on Shibutani-dori, 2 min from the Umamachi bus stop (Tabelog; November 2025). Opened 23 November 2018 (Tabelog).
kyoto_gojo_coffee_factory.notes: [Coffee · Shibutani-dori near Gojozaka] A stylish, quiet roastery café: fresh-roasted coffee such as the dark Benkei Blend, good-value morning sets, curry and sandwiches, and hot taiyaki made to order. Order at the counter first. No cards (QR OK). Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: a café opened 23 November 2018 with a roasting machine on site, serving house-roasted coffee with breakfast sets, curries, sandwiches and freshly made taiyaki (2022–2025 reviews).

anecdotes.text: A June 2024 visitor recommended the taiyaki, made to order and served hot, alongside freshly roasted coffee.
A May 2023 guest who came for lunch curry found a morning set of toast, salad, fried egg, coffee and an apple instead — a great deal.
A December 2025 coffee break paired the dark Benkei Blend with a gâteau chocolat.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ、東山区常盤町459-13、市バス「馬町」から徒歩2分、清水五条駅から徒歩10分ほど、木〜火 9:00〜18:00、水曜休み、予約可、カード・電子マネー不可、QR 可、禁煙、Wi-Fi、2018年11月23日開店、公式サイトあり。口コミ (2022年4月〜2025年12月、英語): 店内に焙煎機、先に入口のレジで注文と支払い、Benkei ブレンド (深煎り) 400円、カプチーノ、トースト・サラダ・目玉焼き・コーヒー・りんごのモーニング、辛口のカレー、チーズハンバーグサンド、フレンチトースト、注文後に焼くたい焼き、ガトーショコラ500円、静かで落ち着いた店内。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter first; QR payments; no cards.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through December 2025.

kyoto_ura_stand_kushiage.gf_detail: Not GF: breaded kushiage, and dote-ni in a miso-soy sauce (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_ura_stand_kushiage.vegan_detail: Not vegan: beef-tendon dote-ni, duck, shrimp and meat skewers (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_ura_stand_kushiage.hours_raw: Daily including holidays 17:00–23:00 (last orders food 22:00, drinks 22:30); closing days not fixed; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; book ahead at weekends (Tabelog; October 2026). Cash only (Tabelog original 現金決済のみ). Counter and spacious seating; non-smoking (Tabelog). Skewers are served one piece each, so order enough for the table (November 2025). 5 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn. Opened 8 October 2020 (Tabelog).
kyoto_ura_stand_kushiage.notes: [Kushiage and dote-ni · Kawaramachi-Ebisugawa, cash only] A design-minded little bar for creative kushiage — eggplant, big shrimp with pickle tartare — and a yuzu-scented dote-ni platter, with natural wine and a friendly owner. Book at weekends. Cash only.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: a kushiage and stew bar opened 8 October 2020, with carefully chosen plates and chairs, warm service and a friendly owner (2025–2026 reviews).

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 diner expecting an oden stand found a stylish kushikatsu bar serving dote-ni instead.
A December 2025 solo diner was told any time between 5 and 7 p.m. was fine for a weekday booking.
An October 2026 regular calls it a favourite Kyoto izakaya for warm service that fills the heart as well as the stomach.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 串揚げ・おでん、中京区西革堂町190-1、市役所前駅から徒歩5分、毎日 (祝日も) 17:00〜23:00 (L.O.料理22:00、飲み物22:30)、不定休、予約可、現金決済のみ、禁煙、2020年10月8日開店。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年10月、英語): 器や椅子にこだわったおしゃれな店、名物のどて煮の盛り合わせ (大根、こんにゃく、厚揚げ、牛すじ、卵、七味と柚子)、なすの串カツ、大えびとピクルスのタルタル、アスパラの肉巻き、鴨、ポテトサラダ、自然派ワイン、串は1本ずつ、気さくな店主、週末は予約を。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; book at weekends.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_sumiya_pinn.gf_detail: Ask. Charcoal-grilled meats and marinated sardines may suit, but pasta, pâté toasts and sauces involve wheat (2026 reviews). No gluten information.
kyoto_sumiya_pinn.vegan_detail: Not vegan: grilled meats, fish, prosciutto and cheese (2026 reviews).
kyoto_sumiya_pinn.hours_raw: Tuesday–Saturday 17:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); closed Monday; Sunday not stated, so left out; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations advised — often fully booked (Tabelog; February–July 2026). No service or cover charge (Tabelog original サービス料、チャージなし). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and QR (PayPay, Rakuten Pay, au PAY); no e-money (Tabelog). 25 seats, mainly counter, with two semi-private spots for solo diners; non-smoking; sports screenings (Tabelog; March 2026). MsOIKE 1F; 3 min walk from Karasuma-Oike Stn. Opened 10 December 2015 (Tabelog).
kyoto_sumiya_pinn.notes: [Charcoal grill and wine · Shinmachi-Oike] A buzzing, counter-led bar of charcoal-grilled meat and vegetables, a famous appetiser platter, satoimo-blue-cheese potato salad and good pasta, with plenty of wine and a friendly owner. No service charge. Book.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: a charcoal-grill bar opened 10 December 2015 near Karasuma-Oike, a sister of Sake Park Pinn (May 2026), always busy and run by a friendly owner (February 2026).

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 pair liked the two tucked-away seats meant for solo diners and the rich satoimo-blue-cheese potato salad.
A May 2026 fan of Sake Park Pinn discovered this sister shop and its charcoal-grill menu.
An April 2026 diner found some snacks salty but the pasta excellent.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 鶏料理・肉料理・焼き鳥、中京区新町通御池下ル新明町74-5 MsOIKE 1F、烏丸御池駅から徒歩3分、火〜土 17:00〜24:00 (L.O.23:00)、月曜休み、予約可、サービス料、チャージなし、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX・Diners)・QR (PayPay・楽天ペイ・au PAY) 可、電子マネー不可、25席、禁煙、スポーツ観戦、2015年12月10日開店。口コミ (2026年2〜7月、英語): Sake Park Pinn の姉妹店、いつも満席のにぎやかな店、前菜の盛り合わせ、炭火焼、里芋とブルーチーズのポテトサラダ、スペイン風のいわしのマリネ、きのこのパテ、生ハム、カルボナーラ、パスタ、ワインが豊富、一人向けの席が2つ、気さくな店主。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; no service charge; cards and QR.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through July 2026.

kyoto_grill_kinsei_okazaki.gf_detail: Ask when booking — tell the restaurant of allergies or foods you cannot eat a few days ahead (Tabelog). An omakase French kaiseki ending with a curry (2019–2026 reviews). No gluten information.
kyoto_grill_kinsei_okazaki.vegan_detail: Ask when booking. Tabelog lists vegetarian options; the omakase centres on meat and fish (Tabelog; 2019–2026 reviews).
kyoto_grill_kinsei_okazaki.hours_raw: Thursday–Tuesday and holidays 12:00–14:30 (last order 13:30) and 17:00–23:00 (last order 21:30); closed Wednesday; lunch only for reservations made by the previous day (Tabelog). Tell the restaurant about allergies a few days ahead (Tabelog). Service charge 5% per group (Tabelog original 1組当たりサービス料5％). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 16 seats: 8 at the counter, 8 at tables; non-smoking, smoking area outside; wheelchair accessible; take-out (Tabelog). Imperial Okazaki 1F, near Higashiyama-Nijo bus stop, 10–15 min walk from Sanjo Keihan or Higashiyama Stn (Tabelog). Moved here from Gion in 2019 (2019–2023 reviews).
kyoto_grill_kinsei_okazaki.notes: [French kaiseki · Okazaki] A long-loved omakase grill that moved from Gion to Okazaki: course after course of French-leaning dishes eaten with chopsticks, from six appetisers to the famous closing curry, cooked by one chef. Lunch by booking the day before. 5% service. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: a pioneer of Kyoto’s omakase style, first at Shijo-Kiyamachi and then in Gion, reopening at Okazaki in 2019 (May–June 2019; March 2023); now cooked single-handed (August 2025) and loved by long-time regulars (December 2023; October 2026).

anecdotes.text: A May 2019 regular from the Shijo-Kiyamachi days came to the reopening at the new Okazaki address.
A March 2026 guest after the Kyocera Museum of Art called the ¥6,000 lunch with a drink an incredible value.
An August 2025 diner marvelled that one person could turn out such a range of dishes — at Gion-level prices.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 創作料理・フレンチ・ステーキ、左京区仁王門通新高倉東入正往寺町462-2 インペリアル岡崎 1F、東山駅や三条京阪から徒歩10〜15分、木〜火・祝日 12:00〜14:30 (L.O.13:30)、17:00〜23:00 (L.O.21:30)、水曜休み、昼は前日までの予約のみ、アレルギーは数日前までに、1組当たりサービス料5％、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX・Diners) 可、電子マネー・QR 不可、16席 (テーブル8、カウンター8)、禁煙 (外に喫煙所)、車いす可、テイクアウト、ベジタリアンの選択肢あり。口コミ (2019年5月〜2026年10月、英語): おまかせの洋食懐石の草分け、四条木屋町から祇園を経て2019年に岡崎へ、箸で食べるフレンチ、前菜6種、しめのカレー、Royal Copenhagenの器、一人で調理 (2025年8月)、昼のコース6,000円 (1ドリンク付き、2026年3月)、カツサンドの持ち帰り、長年の常連。

cultural_comfort.note: Book (lunch by the day before); tell allergies a few days ahead; 5% service.

staff_allergy_handling: Asks for allergies and foods you cannot eat a few days before the booking (Tabelog)

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_nishimura_eisei_boro.gf_detail: Ask. A 2016 reviewer says the boro is made with potato starch from Minami-Tokachi, Hokkaido, but the shop’s site lists no ingredients, so wheat or other allergens are unconfirmed.
kyoto_nishimura_eisei_boro.vegan_detail: Ask. Ingredients are not listed on the official site; boro biscuits often contain egg — not confirmed here.
kyoto_nishimura_eisei_boro.hours_raw: TAKEAWAY ONLY — a boro biscuit shop with no seating. Monday–Friday 10:00–16:00; closed Saturday, Sunday and holidays (official site; Tabelog). Founded in Meiji 26 (1893) by 西村元吉 (official site); family succession not sourced. Suitable as a baby snack from about 7 months — have water ready (Tabelog). 1 min walk from Marutamachi Stn exit 7 (Tabelog).
kyoto_nishimura_eisei_boro.notes: [Takeaway only · boro biscuits since 1893, Ainomachi-Nijo] A tiny old shop south of the Imperial Palace that has made only eisei boro since 1893: light, gentle biscuits loved by babies and grandparents alike, in plain, vegetable and purple sweet-potato versions. Takeaway only. Weekdays only.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: founded in Meiji 26 (1893) by 西村元吉 south of the Kyoto Imperial Palace, devoted for more than 130 years to eisei boro alone, baked carefully every day from simple ingredients. Family succession is not stated in the sources.
chef_bio.philosophy: Simple ingredients, baked carefully every day (official site).

anecdotes.text: A May 2016 buyer recalled a TV advert with maiko, and bought the original boro made with Minami-Tokachi potato starch for ¥162.
An August 2024 parent says a toddler hunts the boro down wherever it is hidden at home.
A January 2025 visitor drawn in by a sign was puzzled to find no “fresh boro” on the shelves.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 「明治26年、創業者西村元吉の手によって、」、「京都御所南の地に生まれ130有余年。」、「衛生ボーロ一筋に歩んでまいりました。」、「シンプルな材料で毎日丹念に焼き上げております。」、営業 10:00〜16:00、土・日・祝日休み。食べログ: 和菓子、中京区間之町二条上ル夷町580、丸太町駅7番出口から徒歩1分ほど、月〜金 10:00〜16:00、テイクアウト、7か月ごろから赤ちゃんのおやつに (水を用意して)。口コミ (2016年5月〜2026年5月、英語): 北海道の Minami-Tokachi の片栗粉 (2016年)、元祖のボーロ162円 (2016年)、野菜のボーロ、紫芋のボーロ、季節の箱 (クリスマスのブーツなど)、無添加 (2026年5月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Takeaway only; weekdays 10:00–16:00.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog; reviews through May 2026.

kyoto_curry_shirakawa_nijo.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: European-style roux curry, tonkatsu and chicken-katsu toppings, curry doria (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_curry_shirakawa_nijo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: beef-tendon, beef-tongue and keema curries, katsu and egg toppings; even the vegetable curry comes as a roux curry (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_curry_shirakawa_nijo.hours_raw: Monday–Wednesday and Friday–Sunday 11:30–17:00, open straight through; closed Thursday (Tabelog; August 2026). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). About 9 counter seats and two tables (August 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). A step at the entrance (January 2025). 5 min on foot from Karasuma-Oike (Tabelog). Here since September 2022, after moving from Zest Oike; about 25 years in business (Tabelog; April 2025).
kyoto_curry_shirakawa_nijo.notes: [Curry · Nijo near Karasuma-Oike, all-afternoon] A long-running curry house (about 25 years, here since 2022) serving rich European-style curry straight through from 11:30 to 17:00 — handy for a late lunch: red-wine beef-tendon curry, jumbo tonkatsu curry, omurice keema and curry doria. Cash only; closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: An April 2025 reviewer says the shop has been running for 25 years and moved here from Zest Oike three years earlier; Tabelog gives September 2022 for this site. No operator was found.

anecdotes.text: A January 2025 couple returned and, it turned out, ordered exactly the same cheese-omelette and beef-tongue curries as a year before.
An August 2026 lunch-goer got the last bowl of the limited beef-tendon curry.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カレー料理の店白川、カレー、中京区二条通東洞院西入仁王門町26-1 御所南二条ビル 1F、地下鉄烏丸御池駅から徒歩5分・丸太町駅から徒歩6分、月〜水・金〜日 11:30〜17:00、木曜定休、2022年9月11日オープン、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、禁煙。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 創業25年、3年前にゼスト御池から移転、欧風カレー、辛さは甘口・中辛・辛口、昼限定の牛すじの赤ワイン煮カレー (ミニサラダ付き) 1,200円、ジャンボとんかつカレー1,500円と生卵100円、キーマカレードリア (ミニサラダ付き) 1,400円、オムライスキーマカレー1,600円、彩り野菜カレー、チーズオムレツカレーとスパイスのきのこご飯、牛タンカレー、ハヤシライス、無着色の福神漬けは自分で取る、カウンター4席と5席・4人と2人のテーブル、入口に段差。

cultural_comfort.note: Open all afternoon; cash only.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated January 2025 to October 2026.

kyoto_men_kurodo_kiyomizu.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: udon, soba and matcha soba (wheat content not stated), tempura (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_men_kurodo_kiyomizu.vegan_detail: Not vegan: noodles in dashi broth; shrimp tempura (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_men_kurodo_kiyomizu.hours_raw: 11:00–17:00 daily (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Cards, IC and e-money, QR (Tabelog). 50 seats on the second floor, counter seats looking down on the Kiyomizu approach and tables (Tabelog; December 2025; May 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Busy at lunch; quieter mid-afternoon (March and September 2025).
kyoto_men_kurodo_kiyomizu.notes: [Soba and udon · Kiyomizu approach, upstairs] A roomy upstairs noodle shop on the way to Kiyomizu-dera, with counter seats looking down on the street: yuba soba or udon, green-tea soba and tempura bowls at prices that feel fair for the area. Open daily 11:00–17:00; no reservations.

chef_bio.background: No operator or chef details were found.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 solo visitor whose phone had died found a charging spot right outside and stayed for green-tea soba with yuba.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: めん蔵人、麺類、東山区清水2-218-1 2F、毎日 11:00〜17:00、予約不可、カード・交通系IC・電子マネー・QR可、50席、禁煙。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 清水寺への道、観光地にしては手頃、京ゆばそば・うどん (そば・うどん・茶そばから選ぶ)、冷たい茶そば、天ぷらそば・うどん1,760円、とうもろこしの天ぷらの初夏の天ぷらそば1,980円、海老の天ぷらのざるそば、関西の出汁、2階でカウンター席から通りが見える。

cultural_comfort.note: Sightseeing-route noodle shop; many overseas visitors.

kyoto_saltinbanco_oshikoji.gf_detail: Ask. Course lunches and dinners of antipasti, pasta, risotto, mains and desserts; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_saltinbanco_oshikoji.vegan_detail: Ask. A monthly platter of nine vegetables features on the course, but nothing is described as vegan (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_saltinbanco_oshikoji.hours_raw: Tuesday–Thursday last orders 11:30–14:00 (lunch) and 18:00–22:00 (dinner); Saturday, Sunday and public holidays 12:00–15:00 and 18:00–22:00 (last orders); dinner course last orders 20:30; closed Monday and the third Tuesday (Tabelog). Corkage ¥1,000 a bottle, dinner (Tabelog). 26 seats: 4 at the counter, 22 at tables (Tabelog). 2 min from the Karasuma-Oike subway exit (October 2026).
kyoto_saltinbanco_oshikoji.notes: [Italian · Oshikoji near Karasuma-Oike, long-running] A warm, burgundy-walled Italian near Karasuma-Oike that regulars have known for decades: good-value lunch courses from ¥2,700 with a big antipasto plate of Kyoto vegetables, seasonal pasta and an espresso pudding people come back for; dinner courses and some à la carte. Closed Monday and third Tuesdays.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text introduces Chef Isamu Sawada. A June 2026 reviewer ate here weekly 25–30 years ago when working nearby; a May 2026 reviewer calls it a Bib Gourmand selection. No operator was found.
chef_bio.philosophy: Every ingredient is a producer’s pride, and the chef’s role is to pass that quality on to guests (Tabelog shop text, paraphrased).
chef_bio.specialty: Antipasto of seasonal vegetables; espresso pudding.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 diner returned after decades, having eaten here once or twice a week as an office worker next door 25–30 years earlier.
A January 2026 lunch guest said the espresso pudding with Japanese-chestnut sauce alone was worth a return visit.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: サルティンバンコ、記念日や会食、ランチやディナーに、料理はコースが基本 (Aランチ、Bランチ、シェフのおすすめランチ、シェフのおまかせコース、ペアリングワインコース)、イタリアンおせち、パネトーネ。食べログ: サルティンバンコ、イタリアン、中京区押小路通両替町西入ル金吹町460 ベルメゾン 1F、火〜木 11:30〜14:00 (L.O.)・18:00〜22:00 (L.O.)、土日祝日 12:00〜15:00 (L.O.)・18:00〜22:00 (L.O.)、月曜・第3火曜定休、ディナーコースL.O. 20:30、持ち込み料1本1,000円 (ディナー)、26席 (カウンター4、テーブル22)、Isamu Sawadaシェフ「食材は生産者の誇り」、月替わりの9種の野菜の前菜盛り合わせ (フリアリエッリなど)。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): ランチコース2,700円・4,900円、前菜盛り合わせ、九条ねぎのケークサレ、サーモンのカルパッチョ、聖護院かぶらのスープ、ホタルイカと菜の花のアーリオオーリオ、有機レモンのティラミス、秋刀魚のリゾット、枝豆とトリュフのカルボナーラ、サルティンボッカ、栗のエスプレッソプリン、キハダマグロのカルパッチョ1,800円、25〜30年前から通う客、ビブグルマンとの記述。

cultural_comfort.note: Course-based; written descriptions of the antipasti (January 2026).

existence.note: Own site (news to November 2026) and Tabelog listing; reviews dated July 2025 to October 2026.

kyoto_mendokoro_maruto_kiyomizu.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat ramen noodles from a Kyoto noodle maker (own site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_mendokoro_maruto_kiyomizu.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken-bone and katsuobushi broth, pork chashu (own site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_mendokoro_maruto_kiyomizu.hours_raw: 11:00–19:00 daily (last orders 18:30); 18–30 November 11:00–21:30 (last orders 21:00) (Tabelog). Ticket machine with a multilingual menu; cards and QR (Tabelog; October 2026). 26 seats, up a flight of stairs on the second floor of the 栄山堂 building (Tabelog; October 2026). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). Aprons provided (February 2025). Opened 24 April 2023 (Tabelog).
kyoto_mendokoro_maruto_kiyomizu.notes: [Ramen · Kiyomizu-zaka, Japanese-style] A ramen counter up the stairs near Kiyomizu-dera from the team behind the miso-and-washoku restaurant Feliz-團斗: a light but deep chicken-and-dashi bowl with Kyoto noodles and pork, finished with three house misos. Ticket machine with an English menu; open daily. Flagged: sister of Feliz-團斗 (in our data).

chef_bio.background: The shop’s site says its ramen was created by the main restaurant Feliz-團斗, whose washoku chefs pursued umami, and that it uses Kyoto ingredients (local production for local consumption). No operator was found beyond the shop name.
chef_bio.philosophy: Local production for local consumption, with Kyoto ingredients (own site).
chef_bio.specialty: Chicken-and-dashi ramen with miso taste changes.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 visitor found staff unhurried and attentive even with school-trip groups filling the room.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 【京都・清水寺】2023年OPEN！和風ラーメン専門店「麺処RAMEN まると」、東山区清水2丁目226 栄山堂 2階、和食の料理人が旨みにこだわった和風ラーメン、鶏ガラ出汁ベース、麺は京都の有名な製麺所、地産地消、半分ほど食べたら本店Feliz-團斗が厳選した味噌で味変、本店「團斗」は完全個室で御味噌✕和食✕美酒。食べログ: 毎日 11:00〜19:00 (L.O. 18:30)、11月18日〜30日は11:00〜21:30、2023年4月24日オープン、カード可、26席、喫煙可。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 鶏ガラの和風ラーメン1,300円、鰹と昆布の出汁と鶏・野菜のスープ、京都の豚のチャーシュー、京都のお米、多言語の券売機、白味噌・大根おろし味噌・胡麻しそ味噌の味変、着物の客にエプロン、修学旅行生が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Multilingual ticket machine; aprons provided.

existence.note: Own site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated February 2025 to October 2026.

kyoto_noharaya_curry_pan.gf_detail: Not GF: fried curry bread, katsu and curry roux; a Guinness curry (reviews).
kyoto_noharaya_curry_pan.vegan_detail: Not vegan: keema curries and katsu (reviews).
kyoto_noharaya_curry_pan.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 Tuesday–Saturday; closed Monday and Sunday (Tabelog). At night the room runs as a bar (June 2025). Curry bread can be taken away (June 2025). Cards accepted (Tabelog). 60 seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). Karasuma-Nishiki Building 2F, 3 minutes from Hankyu Karasuma (Tabelog). Opened 15 September 2020 (Tabelog).
kyoto_noharaya_curry_pan.notes: [Curry · Karasuma by Nishiki, Guinness curry and curry bread] A daytime curry counter that turns into a bar at night: Guinness curry and sweet keema combinations from ¥1,060, and curry bread fried to order with a crisp shell. Lunch Tuesday–Saturday.

chef_bio.background: A curry and curry-bread shop run with the Irish PUB field — which calls itself Kyoto’s first Irish pub, opened in January 2000 — in collaboration with 後藤パン工房 (official site). Opened in September 2020 (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A June 2025 visitor had freshly fried curry bread with a drink set at the bar counter.
A May 2026 office worker, a “curry refugee” from the company canteen, ordered Guinness katsu curry with a large rice.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: カレーとカレーパンの店 野原屋、野原屋「field×後藤パン工房」のコラボ店、Irish PUB field は2000年1月に開店した京都で初めてのアイリッシュパブ。食べログ: カレーとカレーパン 野原屋、カレー・パン、京都市中京区元法然寺町683 烏丸錦ビル2F、火〜土 11:30〜15:00、月・日定休、カード可、60席、禁煙、2020年9月15日オープン。口コミ (2022〜2026年、英語): 昼はカレーとカレーパン、夜はバー、揚げたてのカレーパン (薄くサクッとした生地、フルーティーなキーマ)、持ち帰りも、カレードリア、カツカレーサンド、あいがけカレー1,060円 (ギネスカレーと甘いキーマ)、カツ+410円、サラダとキーマ2種のレギュラー1,300円ほど、パイナップルのトッピング。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter; curry bread to take away.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through May 2026.

kyoto_yakiniku_stamina_yama.gf_detail: Ask. Yakiniku with tare and salt, a sukiyaki course dish and cold noodles to finish; no gluten information is published (reviews).
kyoto_yakiniku_stamina_yama.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu yakiniku restaurant (reviews).
kyoto_yakiniku_stamina_yama.hours_raw: 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–24:00 Monday, Wednesday–Sunday and holidays (Tabelog); Tuesday is not stated. Staff grill the meat at the table (2026 reviews). Cards (incl. UnionPay) and e-money (Tabelog). 40 seats at tables for 4 and 6; heated tobacco only, outside the front (Tabelog). One minute from Keihan Sanjo (Tabelog; May 2026). Opened 19 October 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_yakiniku_stamina_yama.notes: [Yakiniku · Keihan Sanjo, staff-grilled wagyu] A lively yakiniku room a minute from Sanjo station where the staff grill everything for you: the ¥8,000 Stamina Yama course runs from salted yukhoe through thick wagyu lean steak and sukiyaki beef to cold noodles. Lunch too.

chef_bio.background: Opened in October 2024 (Tabelog). Reviewers (2026) describe energetic, friendly staff who grill every piece at the table, meat bought through the shop’s own channels, and a stated aim to be “the best yakiniku place in my history”.
chef_bio.philosophy: To be “the best yakiniku place in my history”, with high-quality meat at good value (June 2026 review).

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 diner found the salted yukhoe nothing like the usual sweet kind.
A June 2026 guest praised a staff member for the careful grilling and generous service.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼肉スタミナ山、焼肉・ホルモン・居酒屋、京都市左京区法林寺門前町36-3、月・水〜日・祝日 11:30〜14:00、17:00〜0:00、カード (銀聯も)・電子マネー可、40席 (4人卓7、6人卓2)、加熱式たばこは店頭で、2024年10月19日オープン。口コミ (2026年、英語): 京阪三条駅から1分、スタミナ山コース8,000円 (塩ユッケ、赤身のたたき、キムチ、ナムル、和牛赤身ステーキ、すき焼き、冷麺、アイス)、スタッフが目の前で焼いてくれる、元気で気さくなスタッフ、独自のルートの肉、ランチから夜までアラカルトも。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff grill for you; tables for 4–6.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_harapeko_udon_wakatake.gf_detail: Not GF: wheat udon and a fried offal dish (reviews).
kyoto_harapeko_udon_wakatake.vegan_detail: Not vegan: udon in dashi with beef, tendon or egg; fried offal (reviews).
kyoto_harapeko_udon_wakatake.hours_raw: 12:00–17:00 Tuesday–Sunday; closed Monday (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). Horumon yoshoku can be taken away (May 2025). On Hanamikoji south of Sanjo, at the north end of Gion (Tabelog; March 2026).
kyoto_harapeko_udon_wakatake.notes: [Udon · Hanamikoji south of Sanjo, a cash-only town diner] A homely udon diner on Hanamikoji run with Kansai-auntie warmth: cheap bowls of suji or egg-drop udon (¥550–600) and an oddity, “horumon yoshoku” — fried offal in sweet sauce for ¥300. Cash only; afternoons, closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: A long-running udon diner reviewed since 2011 (Tabelog). Reviewers (2025–2026) describe a town eatery with chatty, friendly staff and local regulars.

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 first-timer spotted horumon yoshoku on the back of the menu and ordered it with suji udon.
A March 2025 weekday lunch of egg-drop udon came with a crisp plate of horumon yoshoku.
A June 2025 late-lunch guest felt the friendly Kansai-auntie atmosphere.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: はらぺこ、うどん、京都市東山区花見小路通三条下る若竹町414、火〜日 12:00〜17:00、月曜定休、カード・電子マネー・QR決済不可。口コミ (2011〜2026年、英語): 町の食堂、細くやわらかいうどんとおいしい出汁、すじうどん600円、玉子とじうどん550円、肉うどん、カレーうどん、たぬきうどん、ほるもん洋食300円 (ゆでてから揚げたホルモンに甘いソース、持ち帰りも)、気さくな関西のおばちゃんの雰囲気、地元の常連。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; casual town diner.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through March 2026. The other Tabelog listing named はらぺこ (26043942, 竹屋町麩屋町) is a different shop.

kyoto_saijiki_toshigami.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto cuisine with dashi and soy, tempura, and Western touches such as gratin; no gluten information is published (official site).
kyoto_saijiki_toshigami.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-based Japanese cooking with anago, hamo, fugu, crab and fish (official site).
kyoto_saijiki_toshigami.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00 (last order 14:00) and dinner 17:00–23:00, last order 20:30 for courses (official site; Tabelog), Tuesday–Sunday and holidays (Tabelog); Monday is not stated. Courses must be booked the day before — lunch by 18:00, dinner by 22:00 (official site). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 26 seats: a 10-seat L-shaped counter facing the owner and 16 upstairs; non-smoking (Tabelog; official site; February 2026). On Tsukimi-cho along Higashioji (“Todai Road” in a June 2025 review), about 5 minutes from Yasaka Shrine (Tabelog; June 2025). Opened 12 September 2014 (official site).
kyoto_saijiki_toshigami.notes: [Kyoto cuisine · Higashiyama near Yasaka Shrine, sake pairing] A small wood-lined restaurant near Yasaka Shrine where the owner, trained at well-known Kyoto ryotei, pairs seasonal dishes — Densuke anago, hamo, fugu — with small pours of sake. Obanzai lunch sets from ¥1,850; dinner kaiseki ¥7,700; book the day before.

chef_bio.background: Opened in September 2014 (official site). The owner honed skills for many years at well-known Kyoto ryotei and restaurants and goes to the central market every day to choose the fish (official site); reviewers enjoy the owner’s stories at the L-shaped counter (February 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Pairing Japanese food and sake, with sake chosen to drink with the meal (official site).

anecdotes.text: A June 2025 daytime-drinking pairing ran to seven sakes in small sips, with fried hamo and warabi in the soup.
A February 2026 couple on the seven-dish pairing course chatted with the chef and other guests at the counter.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 歳時記 年神、京懐石と日本酒、テーマは「日本酒とお料理のペアリング」、和食一筋の店主、京都の有名料亭やレストランで長年腕を磨いた、毎日中央市場で仕入れ、名物の伝助穴子、夏は鱧、冬はふぐ・蟹、クリームチーズ入りのポテトサラダ、旬野菜のグラタン、酒粕アイス、自家製プリン、マキコレワイン、木を使った店内、店主正面のカウンター、昼限定コース5,500円 (2名から、前日18時までに予約)、焼き魚とおばんざい定食1,850円、季節の天ぷらとおばんざい定食1,960円、お造りとおばんざいの定食2,180円、ぜいたく定食2,950円、国産鰻の蒲焼き定食5,500円、和牛ステーキ定食6,600円、夜は季節の会席7,700円 (8品、前日22時までに予約)、来店12:00〜15:00 (L.O.14:00)、17:00〜23:00 (L.O.20:30)、2014年9月12日開店。食べログ: 歳時記 年神、日本料理・海鮮、京都市東山区月見町6、火〜日・祝日 12:00〜15:00、17:00〜23:00、カード可、電子マネー・QR決済不可、26席 (1階カウンター10、2階16)、禁煙。口コミ (2018〜2026年、英語): 7種の日本酒を少しずつのペアリング、鱧とわらびの椀、八寸、土鍋ご飯、店主の話が楽しい、L字のカウンター。

cultural_comfort.note: Book courses the day before; site in English.

existence.note: Official site (posts to October 2026) and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through February 2026.

kyoto_kodaiji_matsubatei.gf_detail: Ask. Tea porridge, yudofu, yuba and dashimaki (2025–26 reviews); soy and dashi are likely.
kyoto_kodaiji_matsubatei.vegan_detail: Ask. Tea porridge, yudofu and yuba (2025–26 reviews), but dashi, dashimaki and chirimen sansho (fish) appear.
kyoto_kodaiji_matsubatei.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–14:30 (meals) and 14:30–17:00 (café); irregular closures; hours may change (Tabelog). Evening courses by arrangement and private use (August 2025 review). QR payments; no e-money (Tabelog). 8 seats; shoes off in a machiya, past a small garden and alley (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). By the south gate of Kodaiji, near the Yasaka pagoda (Tabelog; November 2025 review).
kyoto_kodaiji_matsubatei.notes: [Tea porridge & yudofu · Kodaiji] A tiny, hushed machiya below Kodaiji, reached through a garden alley, where a kind okami serves Kyoto bancha tea porridge, yudofu and yuba sets, and warabi mochi with matcha in the afternoon. About ¥2,000–5,000.

chef_bio.background: A kind okami welcomes guests (September 2026 review); the yuba, chirimen sansho and shiitake kombu are made in house and sold as souvenirs (November 2025 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Honest Kyoto cooking that respects the ingredients and the season (April 2026 review).

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 walker was sent in by a departing customer's enthusiastic recommendation and lingered an hour over warm warabi mochi and matcha.
An August 2025 guest, recommended by the okami of an inn, found the whole place reserved for the party, in a private room, for an evening course.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 高台寺 松葉亭、日本料理・喫茶店、東山区高台寺南門前、毎日 11:30〜14:30・14:30〜17:00、不定休、QR 可、電子マネー不可、8席。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 庭と路地の奥の町家、京番茶の茶粥と湯豆腐、湯葉、だし巻き、3,000円のセット (2026年4月)、自家製の湯葉・ちりめん山椒・しいたけ昆布をお土産に、温かいわらび餅と抹茶、やさしい女将。

cultural_comfort.note: Shoes off; very quiet room (2026 reviews).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_pekin_ryori_kayu_saikan.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: dumplings, noodles, spring rolls and soy-sauced stir-fries (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_pekin_ryori_kayu_saikan.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork, beef, shrimp and duck dishes (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_pekin_ryori_kayu_saikan.hours_raw: Tue–Fri and the days around holidays 11:30–13:45 (L.O. 13:30) and 17:30–21:30 (L.O. 21:00); Sat, Sun and holidays 17:30–21:30; closed Mondays; Obon break 10–13 August (Tabelog). Lunch: two ¥1,000 sets on a board; lunch is cash only (January 2025 review). Cards at dinner; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 25 seats: 5 at the counter and 20 at tables; non-smoking (Tabelog). Basement of the Murotako Building at Muromachi-Takoyakushi, by stairs or lift (Tabelog; 2025 reviews).
kyoto_pekin_ryori_kayu_saikan.notes: [Beijing Chinese · Muromachi] A basement local favourite near Shijo-Karasuma where Chinese chefs cook Beijing home-style dishes: boiled dumplings, homemade spring rolls and a ¥1,000 lunch set of two dishes. Mostly older regulars; about ¥1,000 lunch, ¥2,000–3,000 dinner.

chef_bio.background: Local Beijing home-style cooking made by Chinese chefs (September 2026 review), with mostly older local regulars (January 2026 review).

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 business traveller had the ¥1,000 beef ramen and shrimp fried rice set, and the owner called the lift and saw the guest off.
A January 2026 diner came back a month later for the boiled dumplings missed the first time, plus monkfish from the blackboard.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 北京料理 華友菜館、中華料理、中京区、室町蛸薬師、地下1階、阪急烏丸駅から徒歩5分、火〜金・祝日の前日・祝日の翌日 11:30〜13:45・17:30〜21:30、土日・祝日 17:30〜21:30、月曜休み、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、25席 (カウンター5)、禁煙。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 中国の料理人の北京の家庭料理、昼は2種の定食1,000円 (昼は現金のみ)、水餃子、自家製の春巻き、冬瓜と肉団子の煮込み、あんこうの唐揚げ、地元の年配の常連。
